gist: Standard channel disclaimer: the channel does not promote or support drugs, alcohol or intoxicants.
Content is for information and education only, the channel follows community guidelines, and viewers are asked to watch with care.
Namaskar, welcome and thanks to everyone for joining.
A small viewer question has come in and will be taken before the class begins.
Announces that today's class is on the planet Mercury (Budh).
Viewer question: Sikhism is a small religion, yet why does it flourish, make people wealthy, and why do Sikhs not beg.
Question continues: Sikhs respect and protect women; what change in conduct have they made in life.
Question continues: they even got a road named Punjab built in Canada.
Question continues: what rules do Sikhs follow that a small religion, about 2 percent of the world, has risen so high (the numbers in the caption are muddled).
Question continues: the gurudwara is a beautiful sacred place where people of every religion are respected.
Question ends: what is the astrological basis behind Sikhism.

hindi: यह हमारी जन्मपत्री कुंडली के अंदर 12 भाव होते हैं।
says: He starts his answer from the basic frame: a birth chart has 12 houses (bhavas), and he will map Sikh practice onto these houses.
ambiguity: He does not say here whether the 12 houses are sign-based or bhava-chalit; later in the series houses are multi-sign.
classical_check: Agrees: 12 bhavas is the standard Jyotish frame.

hindi: यह 12 भाव में मुख्यतः यह मैं है पहचान
says: Among the 12 houses, one of them is the 'I', the self and identity; this is the first house, the starting point of the map he is drawing for Sikhism.
cells_derived_method: The 1st house shows self and identity, coloured by its sign(s): fire signs give an assertive self, water signs a sensitive one, earth signs a practical one, air signs a social one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, direct and self-assertive identity.
Derived: Pisces lagna, soft and absorbing identity, shaped by surroundings.
Derived: Capricorn lagna, reserved and duty-bound identity.

ambiguity: The house number is not spoken (he is pointing at the chart); 'main / I / identity' is the classical 1st house, so this is an inference.
classical_check: Agrees: the 1st house is self (tanu bhava).

hindi: ये मित्र हुए। सेवा हुई। सेवा कई जगह से है। सेवक कहा जा सकता है इसको।
says: As he walks round the chart he names friends as one house topic and service (seva) as another, and adds that service can show from several houses; a person of service can be called a sevak.
cells_derived_method: Friends and gains are the 11th, service and employment are the 6th, seva and charity also touch the 12th and 10th; the sign(s) on each house change the style: earth signs give practical service, water signs emotional service.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: service house in Virgo (lagna Aries), hands-on dutiful work for others.
Derived: friends house in Libra (lagna Sagittarius), many balanced, social friendships.

ambiguity: No house numbers are spoken; he points at the chart, so which house is 'friends' is inferred (11th classically) and 'service' may be 6th, 10th or 12th.
classical_check: Classical texts give friends and gains to the 11th and service to the 6th; roughly agrees.

hindi: ये दान का खाना है। ये कर्म है। बहुत चीजें हैं। मोटे तौर पे है। ये लाभ।
says: Continuing the walk-round: one house is the place of giving or charity, one is karma (action), one is gains; he says there are many things and he is only giving the broad picture.
cells_derived_method: Charity and loss sit in the 12th, karma in the 10th, gains in the 11th. A sign on each house changes how it shows: Capricorn on the 10th gives disciplined career action, Pisces on the 12th gives generous giving.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 10th (lagna Aries): disciplined, slow-built career karma.
Derived: Pisces on the 12th (lagna Aries): giving and spiritual spending come easily.
Derived: Aquarius on the 11th (lagna Aries): gains through networks and groups.

ambiguity: House numbers are not spoken. 'Daan ka khana' (the box of giving) could be the 12th or the 2nd (food); 12th is the more likely reading.
classical_check: Karma 10th and gains 11th agree with classical texts; 12th as charity agrees with Parashari expenditure house.

hindi: यह धर्म धर्म स्थान यह कष्ट यह शत्रु समस्या साथी पूर्वज सहोदर भाई-बहन जो मुख्य तौर पर बात की जाती है सिख धर्म में
says: He lists more house topics: the dharma place, hardship, enemies and problems, companions, ancestors and siblings, and says these are the matters mainly addressed in Sikh teaching.
cells_derived_method: Dharma and ancestors map to the 9th, hardship and enemies to the 6th (and 8th), companions to the 7th, siblings to the 3rd. Sign on each house colours it: Jupiter-ruled sign on the 9th gives firm dharma, Mars-ruled sign on the 3rd gives fighting siblings.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 9th (lagna Aries): strong faith and teacher-guided dharma.
Derived: Scorpio on the 3rd (lagna Virgo): intense, guarded bond with siblings.
Derived: Cancer on the 7th (lagna Capricorn): nurturing, emotional partner.

ambiguity: No numbers are spoken; 'saathi' could mean partner (7th) or helper; 'kasht' could be 6th or 8th.
classical_check: Houses assignments follow standard bhava significations; matches in outline.

gist: Says Sikhs mostly do not go to astrologers and hold weddings whenever they like.
Jokes that Sunday is a holiday, so it is best; come eat and drink, chicken and liquor too, what a religion.
Says in some places that conduct is called bad and in others good, and asks why it is good here.

hindi: यह शत्रु है। समस्याएं हैं जीवन की।
says: Pointing at the 6th house, he says this is the house of enemies and of the problems of life.
cells_derived_method: 6th house: enemies and obstacles show in the manner of its sign(s). Mars-ruled sign gives sharp open conflict, Saturn-ruled sign gives slow chronic troubles, Jupiter-ruled sign gives enemies who are mild or checked by law.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 6th (lagna Gemini): hidden, intense enemies and deep-seated disputes.
Derived: Capricorn on the 6th (lagna Leo): long, wearing troubles and slow-moving cases.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 6th (lagna Cancer): opponents are dealt with through advice and fair process.

ambiguity: The number is not spoken in this sentence; the next chunk confirms 'sixth house' for enemies.
classical_check: Agrees: the 6th is ari (enemy) bhava.

hindi: जीवन की समस्याएं सिख धर्म के अंदर स्वाभाविक नानक ने शिक्षा दी है। बेटा जितनी भी समस्याएं आती है ना वो बेटा दूसरे की समस्या को अपनी समझना है।
says: Sikhism deals with life's problems (the 6th house) through Guru Nanak's teaching: whatever problem arrives, treat the other person's problem as your own.
cells_derived_method: Taking on others' problems as one's own is a way of working the 6th house through service; it fits signs of service (Virgo) more easily and is harder under signs of competition (Aries, Scorpio).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 6th (lagna Aries): service-minded handling of troubles comes naturally.
Derived: Aries on the 6th (lagna Scorpio): the habit of shared burden is harder, the pull is to fight each problem alone.

ambiguity: A spiritual-ethical teaching presented as an astrological remedy; he does not give a measurable rule.
classical_check: Silent; service as a remedy for the 6th is traditional but this Sikh framing is his own.

hindi: कमाल की बात है। बांट लिया। एक रोटी के टुकड़े में आधी तुझे दे दी। आधी मुझे दे दी।
says: Sharing, such as splitting one roti in half with another person, is the Sikh way of neutralising the 6th house; a shared burden is a smaller burden.
ambiguity: The roti-sharing is an illustration, not a prescribed ritual with count or day.
classical_check: Silent; classical remedies for the 6th are service and charity, so sharing food is in the same family.

hindi: छठा घर सेट। छठा घर शत्रु का है। समस्या का है, कोर्ट का है, कचहरी का है। आपके झंझट है।
says: The sixth house is the place of enemies, problems, courts and legal tangles; all your hassles are read from it.
cells_derived_method: Court and dispute matters depend on the sign(s) of the 6th: Libra on it gives negotiated, balanced settlement, Scorpio gives bitter long fights, Aquarius gives impersonal rule-based processes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra on the 6th (lagna Taurus): cases tend toward negotiation and compromise.
Derived: Scorpio on the 6th (lagna Gemini): bitter, drawn-out litigation with hidden moves.
Derived: Aquarius on the 6th (lagna Virgo): impersonal, procedure-heavy disputes.

classical_check: Agrees: the 6th is the house of enemies, disease, debt and litigation.

hindi: कोई गुप्त शत्रु प्रकट शत्रु ऑफिस के अंदर बहुत शत्रु आपका कार्य ढंग से नहीं चल रहा कार्य स्थान भी यहां से आता है
says: The 6th shows both hidden and open enemies and rivals at the office; if your work is not running properly the workplace and its condition also come from this house.
cells_derived_method: Office enemies and workplace problems show according to the sign(s) on the 6th: Gemini gives talk-based rivalry and gossip, Capricorn gives hierarchy and boss trouble, Pisces gives hidden or confused opposition.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini on the 6th (lagna Capricorn): office rivalry through gossip and talk.
Derived: Capricorn on the 6th (lagna Leo): senior or boss friction at work.
Derived: Pisces on the 6th (lagna Libra): hidden, vague opposition that is hard to pin down.

ambiguity: 'Karya sthan' as workplace is his addition; classically the 6th is service while the 10th is the career.
classical_check: Partly agrees: 6th is service and workplace enemies; career as a whole is the 10th.

hindi: किसी से भी मन में नफरत समस्या है छोड़ यार दफा कर कोई नहीं साथ चल इसको भी खिला
says: If you hold hatred or a problem toward anyone, let it go and take that person along with you and feed them as well; this forgiving, feeding attitude is how Sikh practice defuses the 6th house.
ambiguity: Presented as a behavioural attitude, not a dated ritual.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; feeding enemies is not classical, forgiveness and charity are general remedies.

gist: During Covid nobody asked who is good or bad, low or high caste; eat, enjoy, we even supplied you oxygen.
Garbled caption about life's hardship and death conditions ('ye ho gaya kasht jeevan ka, maut kaisi bhi...'); meaning not recoverable.

hindi: इन्होंने सबसे बढ़िया काम कर डाला, दान कर दिया। यह हो गया हमारा लंगर। इस लंगर ने मौत को धो दिया।
says: Sikhs did the best thing: they gave in charity, and this became the langar (community kitchen). The langar washed away the death house problems, meaning giving food in charity neutralises the 8th-house type troubles.
cells_derived_method: Charity as a remedy for the 8th matters most when the sign on the 8th is hard (Aries, Scorpio) because sudden or violent events are the risk; a Jupiter-ruled 8th (Pisces, Sagittarius) is already softer.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries on the 8th (lagna Virgo): sudden, harsh events; langar-style giving as protective practice.
Derived: Pisces on the 8th (lagna Leo): transformations come in softer, spiritual form; giving deepens it.

ambiguity: He points at a house with 'maut' (death); the 8th is confirmed by his next chunk. Donation is also the 12th-house activity, so the mechanism may be 12th acting on 8th.
classical_check: Silent; charity as a remedy for the 8th is a general tradition.

hindi: यहां पर हमारी मृत्यु है, हमारी बुद्धि है। किसी का अत्यंत कहते हैं ना दिमाग ही खराब हो गया। पागल हो गया क्या? क्या बकवास कर रहा है? मरे जैसी बात हो रही है।
says: At this house sits death, and the mind: when we say someone's brain has gone bad, 'has he gone mad, what nonsense, he is talking like a dead man', that kind of deranged or death-minded talk is read here.
cells_derived_method: 8th-house mind states change with its sign: Scorpio gives morbid, obsessive thinking; Gemini gives scattered, nervous thinking; Pisces gives dreamy withdrawal.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 8th (lagna Aries): obsessive, death-fixated thinking.
Derived: Gemini on the 8th (lagna Scorpio): restless, anxious mind about hidden matters.

ambiguity: Garbled caption: the house is not named in this sentence and 'buddhi' may point to the 5th house instead; 8th is inferred from the next chunk where he says the eighth house governs thoughts of death. This is a description of mood, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Partly agrees: 8th is death and mental distress is read from the 4th and 5th.

hindi: मृत्यु के बारे में सोचना, कत्ल करना, खून खराबा कर देना। यह सारा का सारा आपका अष्टम भाव से होता है।
says: Thinking about death, killing and bloodshed all come from the eighth house.
cells_derived_method: Violence themes strengthen when the 8th has a Mars sign (Aries, Scorpio) or Saturn sign; are weaker in Jupiter or Venus signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio on the 8th (lagna Aries): intense, violent-theme tendencies if afflicted.
Derived: Libra on the 8th (lagna Pisces): conflict tends to be softened and settled.

ambiguity: This describes the house topic only; it is not a rule that predicts crime or death.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: the 8th rules death, violence, secrets and sudden events.

hindi: ये सबसे तीन डेंजरस प्लेसेस हैं। यह 12वा है।
says: The three most dangerous places in the chart are the houses of enemies, death and loss (6th, 8th and 12th); here he points at the twelfth.
cells_derived_method: Dusthana strength depends on the sign: a benefic sign (Jupiter or Venus) on a dusthana softens the danger, a Mars or Saturn sign sharpens it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces on the 12th (lagna Aries): the loss house is softened into spiritual giving.
Derived: Scorpio on the 8th (lagna Aries): sharper danger themes.

ambiguity: He names only the 12th; the other two are inferred as 6th and 8th from the preceding sentences.
classical_check: Agrees: 6, 8 and 12 are the dusthanas.

hindi: हॉस्पिटल जाकर के जितना भी खर्चा होता है वो 12वें घर से होता है।
says: All the expense incurred by going to hospital comes from the twelfth house.
cells_derived_method: Medical spending shows through the 12th combined with the 6th; an earth sign such as Virgo on the 12th brings clinical, routine spending; water signs bring spending tied to emotional stress.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 12th (lagna Libra): regular medical and clinic expenses.
Derived: Cancer on the 12th (lagna Leo): spending around home and family illness.

classical_check: Agrees with 12th as expenditure; hospital stays link to 12th (confinement) classically.

hindi: अब ये क्या करते हैं? हॉस्पिटल के खर्चे भी गुरुद्वारे में ही हो जाते हैं। हमारे देश में गुरुद्वारे हैं जहां फ्री फंड के अंदर सारे टेस्ट हो रहे हैं।
says: Sikhs neutralise the twelfth house: hospital expenses are met inside the gurudwara itself, and in India some gurudwaras run all medical tests free.
ambiguity: A social claim used as an illustration; not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जिसके लिए हॉस्पिटल के अंदर आग लगी हुई है। पैसा नहीं खर्च सकता मनुष्य। क्या किया हुआ है? दान कर करके अति मचा रखी है।
says: For what costs a fortune in hospitals, ordinary people cannot afford to spend; Sikhs pre-empt that by giving so much in charity that the community absorbs the loss.
ambiguity: The caption is rough; it reads as heavy charity compensating for the 12th house expense risk.
classical_check: Silent; charity as a 12th-house remedy is a traditional idea.

hindi: यह धर्म स्थान है। धर्म स्थान क्या है? गुरु का द्वार। यार गुरु द्वारा एक एक गुरु सब शब्द समझना पड़ेगा।
says: This house is the dharma place (the religious site); what is the dharma place? The door of the Guru, the gurudwara; each word, guru and dwara, has to be understood on its own.
cells_derived_method: The dharma house works through the sign(s) on the 9th: Sagittarius gives teacher-led faith, Gemini gives faith through study and debate, Scorpio gives intense, secretive faith.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius on the 9th (lagna Aries): faith led by guru and scripture.
Derived: Gemini on the 9th (lagna Libra): faith explored through study and discussion.
Derived: Scorpio on the 9th (lagna Pisces): intense, private religious life.

ambiguity: The house number is stated a few lines later (ninth).
classical_check: Agrees: the 9th is dharma and guru.

gist: Says this is a separate tangle and he will return to it later.

hindi: गुरु ग्रह होता है बृहस्पति नाइन नंबर।
says: Guru is the planet Jupiter (Brihaspati), whose number is nine, meaning it belongs with the ninth house.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter is the natural significator of the 9th; Sagittarius is the 9th sign from Aries and is Jupiter's own sign. If Jupiter sits in its own or exalted sign it strengthens the 9th matters wherever it falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries): the natural fit, strong dharma and guidance.
Derived: Jupiter in Capricorn (debilitated) in the 9th (lagna Taurus): weakened faith or guidance, doubt.

ambiguity: 'Nine number' could be the sign number (Sagittarius is sign 9) or the house number; both agree here.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the karaka of the 9th.

gist: Garbled caption: 'one, seven, ten, nine, eight, this is called the Kaal Purush kundali'; the list of numbers cannot be relied on.

hindi: जो भाव है वैसे ही ये नौवा घर होता है। नौवां घर क्या है? धर्म का स्थान। धर्म। आपका धर्म क्या है? बृहस्पति ग्रह इसका मालिक है।
says: The ninth house is the place of dharma, your religion and duty, and Jupiter is its owner.
cells_derived_method: Dharma matters in the 9th depend on its sign and where Jupiter sits; Jupiter with the 9th in Cancer (exalted) gives mature faith, Jupiter in Gemini in the 9th is less settled.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio): deeply grounded faith and good fortune.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 9th (lagna Libra): wide but unsettled religious learning.

classical_check: Agrees: 9th is dharma bhava with Jupiter as karaka.

hindi: एक प्रकार से मान के चलें। दिशाओं में भी नॉर्थ ईस्ट की दिशा जो होती है घर की वो बृहस्पति उसका मालिक होता है।
says: Among directions too, the north-east of a house belongs to Jupiter; Jupiter is the owner of the north-east direction.
ambiguity: A vastu link, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Agrees with vastu tradition: north-east is Ishanya, ruled by Jupiter.

hindi: नॉर्थ ईस्ट मींस बुद्धि दिमाग ये वास्तु पुरुष की खोपड़ी धर्म स्थान
says: The north-east means intellect and brain, the skull of the Vastu Purush, and is the place of dharma and worship, tying Jupiter to wisdom and the religious site.
ambiguity: Vastu statement, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Agrees with vastu: north-east is the head of Vastu Purush and the place for the puja room.

hindi: बृहस्पति क्या है? गुरु है। एक देवता है।
says: Jupiter is the Guru and is a deity (devta).
classical_check: Agrees: Brihaspati is the guru of the gods.

hindi: हमारे धर्म में कहा जाता है तस्य प्रतिमा न अस्ति। ईश्वर की कोई प्रतिमा नहीं होती।
says: Our scriptures say there is no image of the Supreme: God has no form or idol.
ambiguity: A religious quotation used as the premise for his Jupiter argument that follows.
classical_check: Agrees: the line 'na tasya pratima asti' is from the Shvetashvatara Upanishad and the Yajurveda.

hindi: लेकिन हमारे अवतार डाल दिए गए हैं। राम है, कृष्ण है इत्यादि। उनको चिजी बना दिया गया है। फेस दे दिया गया है। वो फेस देने से क्या होता है? बृहस्पति पावरफुल हो गया। तो ज्ञान मार्ग खुल गया।
says: In our tradition avatars like Ram and Krishna were given a form and a face; giving the formless a face makes Jupiter powerful and so the path of knowledge opens, as there is someone to follow.
ambiguity: This is his theological argument for why Sikh and Hindu practice strengthen Jupiter; the link is not a classical rule.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; this is his interpretive claim.

hindi: इस्लाम में बृहस्पति ग्रह का मुद्दा आउट है। उसके अंदर सीधा अल्लाह को फॉलो किया जाता है।
says: In Islam the Jupiter issue is out of the picture, because there is no human guru figure and one follows Allah directly.
ambiguity: A comparative statement about religions, offered as astrology-themed explanation; the earlier caption about idol worship is muddled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब बृहस्पति हो जाने से यदि बृहस्पति धर्म अनुसार आप चल रहे हैं। धर्म स्थान के अनुसार आप चल रहे हैं। जकात की जाती है। इस्लाम में भी बहुत सुंदर चीज है। गलत नहीं है।
says: If you live by the Jupiter dharma and the dharma place, the same good conduct appears; zakat (obligatory giving) in Islam is a very beautiful practice and not wrong, an example of the same Jupiter-type charity.
ambiguity: The caption is rough at the start of the sentence; the core is that zakat is acceptable as dharma-led giving.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन बृहस्पति शब्द का अर्थ क्या है? बृहस्पति हो जाने से आपके उपद्रव उड़ जाते हैं। बृहस्पति बहुत दीर गंभीर गुरु है।
says: What does the word Brihaspati mean? When Jupiter is strong your disturbances fly away; Jupiter is a very patient, grave and serious guru.
ambiguity: The sentence plays on the sound of the name rather than a verified etymology.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter removes obstacles; the word play is his own.

hindi: ऐसे ही गुरु शब्द को गुरुद्वारे में लिया गया है कि गुरु की
says: In the same way the word guru was taken into the name gurudwara, the door of the Guru, linking Sikh worship to Jupiter-type guidance (the sentence is cut off at the end of the caption).
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off by the end of the chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Opens with 'vaani' (the Guru's word) and asks what the Guru actually said.

hindi: गुरु ये नहीं कहता लड़ो। कत्ल कर गुरु कहता है शांति करो।
says: The Guru does not tell you to fight or kill; the Guru says make peace. In the 6th-house (enemy) context this means the Sikh teaching handles enemies through peace and not violence.
cells_derived_method: Peaceful handling of the 6th works best when the 6th sign is mild (Libra, Pisces, Sagittarius) and needs more effort when it is a fighting sign (Aries, Scorpio).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra on the 6th (lagna Taurus): disputes are naturally settled by negotiation, peace-making is easy.
Derived: Aries on the 6th (lagna Scorpio): the urge to fight first is strong, peace takes deliberate effort.

ambiguity: The house is not named in this sentence; it follows the earlier discussion of the 6th. Guru here can mean the Sikh Gurus and also Jupiter.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter calming enemies is a general karaka idea.

hindi: अपने शत्रु से लड़ो। स्वयं के जितने व्यसन है, खराबियां है, आपके अंदर अवगुण है, उनसे लड़ो। काम से लड़ो, वासना से।
says: Fight your enemy, but the enemy meant is your own addictions, flaws and vices, desire and lust; the true sixth-house enemy is inside.
cells_derived_method: Inner enemies depend on the 6th sign: Taurus or Libra on the 6th points to indulgence and sense pleasure; Scorpio points to lust and obsession; Gemini points to restless talk and nerves.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus on the 6th (lagna Sagittarius): inner enemy is comfort, food and sense indulgence.
Derived: Scorpio on the 6th (lagna Gemini): inner enemy is obsession and desire.

ambiguity: Reads the 6th as the inner-enemy house; classical texts treat it as outer enemies and disease; this is his reinterpretation.
classical_check: Differs in emphasis: the classical 6th is outer enemies; arishadvarga (kama, krodha) as inner enemies is a Vedantic theme.

hindi: लड़ो कैसे? शांत हो के। कैसे करके? छठा भाव क्षमा कर दो।
says: How do you fight the inner enemy? By staying calm; and the way to set the sixth house is to forgive.
classical_check: Silent; classical 6th-house remedies are service and charity, forgiveness is his version.

hindi: क्षमा शत्रु को जीतना है कैसे जीतेंगे? क्षमा कर देंगे।
says: Forgiveness is how an enemy is conquered: you win over an enemy simply by forgiving them.
ambiguity: The sentence repeats the previous idea with a different emphasis (winning not setting).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब ये सेवा कर रहे हैं। सेवक बन गए। सारे के सारे कार्य सेवा कर रहे हैं।
says: The Sikh community has turned to seva: they have become servants, and every task is done as service, which is how the service house is set.
ambiguity: He does not say which house number holds service; classically it is the 6th, and earlier he said service shows from many places.
classical_check: Classical: the 6th is service (seva); matches.

hindi: मित्र बन करके काम कर रहे हैं।
says: They work as friends: dealing with everyone as a friend is how the friends house is set.
ambiguity: House number not spoken; friends are classically the 11th.
classical_check: Classical: friends and well-wishers are the 11th, partners the 7th.

hindi: पूर्वजों को प्रणाम करके चलते हैं। बुजुर्गों का मान सम्मान होता है।
says: They bow to ancestors and honour elders; respect for forefathers and the old is how the ancestors house is set.
ambiguity: No house number given; ancestors are classically the 9th (pitru) with the Sun, though the 4th is also used for forebears.
classical_check: Partly agrees: 9th is father and ancestors.

hindi: सहोदर भाई बहन की तरह सबको ले करके चलते हैं।
says: They treat everyone like their own siblings and take everyone along; this is how the siblings house is set.
ambiguity: House number not spoken; siblings are classically the 3rd.
classical_check: Classical: the 3rd is co-borns.

hindi: स्त्री साथी का पूर्ण पूर्ण रूप से स्त्री का मान सम्मान किया जाता है। सिख नहीं सुने जाएगा कि रेप करता फिर रहा है।
says: Women and partners are given complete respect; he claims you will not hear of a Sikh going around committing rape. This is the companion or partner house set right (he generalises about a community).
ambiguity: House number not given (partner is classically the 7th). The sentence is a sweeping claim about a community, not a chart rule, and is not verified.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: धर्म स्थान है। धर्म के अंदर ये लोग बैठकर के गुरुद्वारे में जूता भी साफ कर रहे हैं। लंगर भी दे रहे हैं। खिला रहे हैं पिला रहे हैं।
says: At the dharma house, they sit in the gurudwara and even clean visitors' shoes, serve langar and feed people; humble service in the place of dharma is how the ninth is set.
ambiguity: He says 'dharma sthaan' without a number; elsewhere in this batch it is the 9th.
classical_check: Agrees that the 9th is dharma; the service remedy is his.

hindi: किसी भी धर्म में ये काम कर दिया जाए सेम ग्रह सेट हो जाएंगे। ये कुंडली सेट हो जाएगी।
says: If these acts are done in any religion, the same planets get set and the chart is set; the effect does not depend on being a Sikh.
ambiguity: 'Set' is not defined in measurable terms.
classical_check: Silent; remedies are traditionally tied to deeds, not to a named religion.

hindi: आप किसी धर्म को नहीं मानते, मंदिर, मस्जिद, गुरुद्वारे नहीं जाते। ये कर्म कर रहे हैं। आपकी कुंडली सेट हो गई।
says: Even someone who follows no religion and visits no temple, mosque or gurudwara gets the chart set if they do these deeds; the action matters, not the worship.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk break ('kar rahe hain' is continued).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपका कर्म क्या है? ईमानदारी का कर्म है। बृहस्पति सेट हो जाता है।
says: Honest action sets Jupiter: if your karma is honesty, Jupiter gets set.
classical_check: Silent; truthfulness is a traditional Jupiter remedy.

hindi: बृहस्पति वो देवता है जो सेट होने से राहु को कंट्रोल कर लेता है।
says: A well set Jupiter takes control of Rahu; Jupiter is the deity that restrains Rahu.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's restraint of Rahu depends on its dignity and house: exalted or own-sign Jupiter restrains Rahu easily; debilitated Jupiter leaves Rahu unchecked.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio): strong enough to restrain Rahu's excess.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 5th (lagna Virgo): little restraint on Rahu, impulsive and obsessive tendencies.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 1st (lagna Sagittarius): steady guiding self, Rahu kept in check.

ambiguity: Conjunction, aspect or only general strength is not specified.
classical_check: Related to Guru-Chandala yoga, where Rahu with Jupiter is read as a clash; this reverses it to Jupiter controlling Rahu when strong.

hindi: राहु वो देवता है जो रणबीर इलाहाबादियों को यहां से उठा के धक्के मार के पाताल में फेंक रहा है। क्या बक दिया तूने बेवकूफ। बर्बाद कर दिया उसको।
says: Rahu is the deity that lifts people up and then throws them down into the pit; he cites a well-known internet personality ruined by careless talk as an example of Rahu's work.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's lift-and-drop pattern depends on its placement: Rahu in the 10th gives sudden public rise and reversal; Rahu in the 2nd works through speech and money.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo): rapid public fame that can reverse suddenly.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 2nd (lagna Taurus): careless speech brings reputation loss.

ambiguity: A real person is used as an example of a rise and fall; the astrological link to his chart is not given.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Rahu gives sudden rise and fall; no named-case rule.

hindi: आज अगर आज गुरु उसके पल्ले होता सेट होता।
says: If Jupiter (a guru) had been with him and set, he would not have fallen; a strong guide protects from Rahu's downfall.
ambiguity: Guru here may mean Jupiter or a human teacher.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वाहेगुरु यह मेरे टीले वाले बाबा गुरु यह मेरा पेड़ मेरा गुरु कुत्ता मेरा कुत्ता किसी से भी सीखो आपका कर्म शुद्ध हो गया
says: Any guru will do: Waheguru, the baba of the mound, a tree, even a dog; learn from anything and your karma becomes pure.
ambiguity: Whether 'guru' means Jupiter strength or a human teacher is left open.
classical_check: Silent; the Dattatreya idea of twenty-four gurus is the traditional parallel.

hindi: लाभ ही लाभ है जीवन के अंदर आपको लाभ हो गया
says: Once karma is pure, gain follows: there is profit after profit in life.
ambiguity: He means the gains house (the 11th classically) but does not say a number.
classical_check: Classical 11th is gains; agrees.

hindi: लाभ में से क्या करना है दसवंद देना है अरे दसंध दो पांचवा दसवा दो आधा एक चौथाई 100वां हिस्सा लाभ में से क्या दे रहे हो
says: Out of the gains you must give dasvandh, a tenth, or a fifth, a half, a quarter or even a hundredth; the gains house is set by giving a share of profit away.
ambiguity: No fixed fraction; any amount from 1/100 to 1/2 is accepted.
classical_check: Silent; tithing is a traditional practice, the link to the gains house is his.

hindi: कुछ दे रहे हो कुछ नहीं दे रहे भाई अपने तो जेब में रखेंगे बोरे बनाने है हमें अपने आपके जीवन में ये घर सेट नहीं होगा
says: If you give nothing and only stuff gains into your own pocket, hoarding sacks, then this house will not get set in your life.
ambiguity: The house is the gains house by context; 'set' is not defined.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says each house has its own greatness and they will come back to the houses another time.

hindi: यह लंगर है। आपने दान कर डाला। खा यार तू भी खा। खाने की कसर
says: This is the langar: you have donated, now eat too and do not leave anything out; sharing the food is the act that completes the charity.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the chunk edge.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: खाने को नहीं रोकना। खूब खिलाओ। खूब बांटो। मूलाधार सेट कर दो पट्ठे का।
says: Do not hold back food; feed people lavishly and share widely, and this sets the root chakra (muladhara) of the person.
ambiguity: A chakra statement used inside an astrological argument; the chart link is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; chakra yoga is outside Jyotish texts.

hindi: नीचे के चक्र में मूलाधार और स्वाधिष्ठान पे आपकी कुंडलिनी फंसी रहती है। पूरे जन्म फंसी रहती है।
says: For most people the kundalini stays stuck in the two lower chakras, muladhara and swadhisthana, for the whole life.
ambiguity: Yoga claim, not chart-based.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish; consistent with general kundalini yoga teaching.

hindi: इसलिए काम ऊर्जा, सेक्स की इच्छा, पागलपन और हर हालत में मेरा और मैं चजी बनाए चलूं। यह क्लेश चलता रहता है।
says: Because of this lower-chakra stuckness, people live in sexual urge, craziness and constant 'mine and I' feeling, which keeps strife going.
ambiguity: Caption 'chaji' is garbled but the meaning of constant ego-ownership is clear.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Debate on whether eating meat is allowed or not; dirty versus good is duality and it should end.
Do not eat meat, do not drink; leave all that, end the duality of yes and no.

hindi: इदा और पिंगला बीच में कश्यप ऋषि हैं। एक अदिति है। एक दति है। एक दैत्यों की माता है। एक देवताओं की
says: Between the Ida and Pingala channels sits sage Kashyap with his two wives, Aditi the mother of the gods and Diti the mother of the daityas (demons), so the body holds both god and demon energies.
ambiguity: Yogic and mythological body model; no link to any chart cell.
classical_check: Agrees with Puranic story of Kashyap, Aditi and Diti; the Ida-Pingala mapping is his.

hindi: कुंडलिनी नाच रही है और 33 कोटि 33 वर्टिब्रे होते हैं हमारे 33 कोटि देवता और साथ में असुर मिलकर के हमारे शरीर की संरचना कर रहे हैं।
says: The kundalini dances up the spine; we have 33 vertebrae, matched to the 33 (koti) gods, and with the asuras together they build the structure of our body.
ambiguity: 'Koti' means both type and crore; the 33 gods of the Vedas match 33 vertebrae in his analogy.
classical_check: Agrees with 33 devatas; the vertebrae match is a modern analogy.

hindi: असुर क्यों चाहिए? क्लेश है, दिक्कत है। बर्न डाउन करेगा। लिवर बाइल बनाता है।
says: Why are asuras needed? They bring strife and trouble but they also burn down what must be burned, as the liver makes bile to digest; the demonic side has a function.
ambiguity: Physiology is used as an analogy, not a medical claim.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Liver pushes out the yellow bile, which is why both stool and urine have a yellow tinge.
Says a baby cooks in the womb; if the mother is angry or stressed the liver over-cooks and the baby is born yellow, and doctors say put it in an incubator (a medical claim, recorded but not used).

hindi: कोई बात नहीं सेट करते हैं इस बच्चे को। यह बृहस्पति है। यह जीवनदायक है। यही शांति स्थापित करता है।
says: No problem, we will set this child; the yellow here is Jupiter, which is life-giving and establishes peace.
ambiguity: Linking yellow colour to Jupiter is clear; the child's yellowness is an illustration, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is yellow and a life-giver and peacemaker.

hindi: हिंदू धर्म इसी बृहस्पति को पकड़ के चलता है। इसीलिए गुरु धर्म केसरिया रंग ऑरेंज कलर होता है।
says: Hinduism holds on to Jupiter, so the colour of the guru and of dharma is saffron or orange.
ambiguity: Saffron is associated with Jupiter here but the Sun is also saffron in other classical lists.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is yellow; saffron for dharma is traditional.

hindi: वायलेट, इंडिगो, ब्लू, ग्रीन, येलो, ऑरेंज, रेड। ये ऑरेंज हो गया। ये हो गया बृहस्पति।
says: Reading the rainbow order from violet through to red, the orange band is Jupiter in his chakra-colour scheme.
ambiguity: The caption order and position pointing are unclear; chakra colours from root up are red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet.
classical_check: Differs: Jupiter is normally yellow, not orange.

hindi: यह हो गया हमारा बुध। यहां ग्रीन कलर आता है हृदय चक्र पे। शुक्र को मान के चलते हैं।
says: The next band is Mercury, and green falls on the heart chakra; he then says we take Venus there, so the green band is given to both Mercury and Venus in the same breath.
ambiguity: He first calls the green band Mercury and then Venus; the caption does not settle which he finally means (the later green=Venus line and the yellow+blue=green=Mercury argument conflict).
classical_check: Mercury is green classically; heart chakra Anahata is green too; Venus green is his religious link.

hindi: यह ग्रीन कलर हरा। शुक्र एक गुरु है। बृहस्पति दूसरा गुरु दोनों एक दूसरे के शत्रु हैं।
says: Green is the colour of Venus; Venus is one guru (of the asuras) and Jupiter is the other guru (of the gods), and the two are enemies of each other.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter and Venus together tend to clash: in the same house, one tries to restrain the other; in a house like the 7th they pull between ideals and pleasure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign Libra in the 7th (lagna Aries) with Jupiter present: partnership ideals versus pleasures in constant tug.
Derived: Jupiter and Venus together in Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer): both guru energies strong, dharma and desire compete.

ambiguity: Venus green and Jupiter yellow are his colours; classical Jupiter-Venus enmity is one-way (Jupiter sees Venus as enemy).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Parashari friendship tables list Venus as an enemy of Jupiter but Jupiter as neutral to Venus.

hindi: इसलिए इस्लाम हिंदुत्व ये झगड़े चले हुए हैं।
says: Because the two gurus are enemies, the conflicts between Islam and Hinduism keep going; he assigns the saffron-Jupiter to Hinduism and the green-Venus to Islam.
ambiguity: This is a sweeping religious-political claim, recorded only because he links it to the planetary scheme. It is not a chart rule and cannot be tested.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text maps religions to Jupiter and Venus.

hindi: आज बृहस्पति केसरिया रंग मुगल हरे रंग का झंडा लेकर के आए।
says: Jupiter's colour is saffron, and the Mughals came carrying a green flag, again mapping green (Venus) against saffron (Jupiter) in history.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk ('Jupiter sits calmly').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बृहस्पति शांत आराम से बैठा है। कोई बात नहीं मैं करूंगा। रेजिस्ट करूंगा फालतू। प्रथम हमला नहीं
says: Jupiter's nature: it sits calmly, will not attack first, and only resists when attacked.
ambiguity: Said in a historical-political frame; the nature claim is general.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is calm and benefic.

gist: Says Mughals came, started fights and killing; asks why rule another country otherwise.
Says these are matters of literature, the past is past, and what is it to us.

hindi: आपने यह प्लनेट सेट किए राहु कत्लेआम मचाने को राजी है पाप ग्रह है
says: Rahu is ready to cause massacre; it is a papa graha (malefic planet).
ambiguity: The first words ('you set these planets') are garbled; meaning is that setting the planets matters because Rahu is a malefic.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is a natural malefic.

hindi: शनि इसके साथ चलता है शनि का ही एजेंट है काम सारे ये करता है राम काज करीबे को आतुर हनुमान राम के काम करते हैं ऐसे राहु शनि का कार्य करता
says: Rahu travels with Saturn and is Saturn's agent doing all its work, as Hanuman is eager to do Ram's work; so Rahu carries out Saturn's tasks.
cells_derived_method: Rahu acts as Saturn's proxy: Rahu placed in a Saturn-ruled sign (Capricorn or Aquarius) works strongly as Saturn's agent; Rahu aspecting or with Saturn in a house amplifies that house's hardships.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Aquarius in the 10th (lagna Taurus): works as Saturn's agent in career, heavy workload and sudden restructuring.
Derived: Rahu in Capricorn in the 6th (lagna Leo): works through Saturn's discipline to drive hard competition and enemies.

ambiguity: Agent means Rahu acting as Saturn's proxy is his analogy; no classical Parashari rule states it.
classical_check: Agrees in part: classical texts often say Rahu behaves like Saturn.

hindi: शनि बहुत बड़ा दैत्य है बृहस्पति के ठीक पीछे है पीछे रहता डर के रहता है।
says: Saturn is a very big daitya (demon figure) who stays right behind Jupiter, hiding behind it in fear.
ambiguity: 'Behind' could mean the next sign after Sagittarius (Capricorn) in the zodiac order, or the position in the planet order; not specified.
classical_check: Differs: Saturn is the son of the Sun; Jupiter and Saturn are neutral, not afraid of each other.

hindi: इस बृहस्पति को नष्ट करने में भी राहु का काम है और राहु को सेट करने में भी बृहस्पति का ही रोल है।
says: Rahu's work is also to destroy Jupiter, while Jupiter's role is to set Rahu; each acts against the other.
cells_derived_method: Rahu with Jupiter or in the same house disrupts the house's Jupiter matters (guru, dharma, children, wealth); in the 9th it unsettles faith and guidance, in the 5th it unsettles children and learning.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu with Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 9th (lagna Aries): unconventional or disturbed faith and teachers.
Derived: Rahu with Jupiter in Pisces in the 5th (lagna Scorpio): disturbed learning or doubt around children.

ambiguity: Conjunction, mutual aspect, or only general antagonism not specified.
classical_check: Agrees with Guru Chandala yoga as a classical combination that damages Jupiter's results.

hindi: जब ये राहु बेकाबू हो जाता है तो इतनी सी बात से भड़का भड़का के खत्म कर देता है। पागल कर देता है।
says: When Rahu runs out of control it inflames people over a small matter, ruins them and drives them to madness.
ambiguity: 'Madness' is figurative.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu governs obsession and delusion.

hindi: बृहस्पति पीला रंग है। राहु नीला रंग है। नीले और पीले को मिलाया जाए तो हरा रंग बनता है। यह हो गया बुध।
says: Jupiter is yellow and Rahu is blue; mixing blue and yellow gives green, which is Mercury, so Mercury is the blend of Jupiter and Rahu.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's quality as a mix depends on sign: Virgo (exalted) holds the blend steady and intelligent; Pisces (debilitated) lets the Rahu side confuse; Gemini is quick and clever with some restlessness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 10th (lagna Sagittarius): intelligence balanced, a measured career in analysis.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 7th (lagna Virgo): confusion and mixed signals in partnerships.

ambiguity: Conflicts with the earlier green-heart-chakra line that gave the same band to Venus.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Mercury green but do not derive it from Jupiter plus Rahu.

gist: Reminds that today's class is on Mercury only.

hindi: यह बृहस्पति है जो काबू करके चलता है। इसलिए हमें कोई ना कोई गुरु नहीं तो कोई देवता नहीं तो कुछ चाहिए।
says: Jupiter is what keeps Rahu under control, so everyone needs some guru, or failing that some deity or some anchor to hold on to.
classical_check: Silent; having a guru is a general Jupiter remedy.

hindi: आपका बृहस्पति ऑन रहेगा, सेट रहेगा और आप अंधाधुंध किसी भी चीज के पागलपन में नहीं चलेंगे। आपके स्वयं के कर्म अनुसार सेट हो जाएंगे।
says: With Jupiter switched on and set you will not blindly run after any craze, and things settle in line with your own karma.
classical_check: Silent.

Derived: Mercury with Mars in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries): sharp, argumentative and impulsive speech.

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury takes the colour of conjunct planets.

gist: Asks whether our intellect is in our control or not.
Role-play examples: told your mother-in-law is bad, she becomes bad; told the maid took money, she becomes bad; told 'we love you', love appears.

hindi: जिसने जो बोल दिया ये सुना और उसके लिए बहक गए। पागल हो गए। ये हो गया बुध। बहुत मासूम ग्रह लेकिन सुपर चंचल।
says: Whatever anyone says, the intellect listens and is swept away, driven mad; that is Mercury, a very innocent planet that is also super fickle.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is a youthful, changeable planet.

hindi: धरती से बहुत छोटा
says: Mercury is very small compared with the Earth; the caption breaks off here.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk edge.
classical_check: Agrees with astronomy: Mercury's diameter is under half of Earth's.

hindi: चंदा मामा से थोड़ा सा बड़ा।
says: Mercury is only a little bigger than the Moon (Chanda Mama), continuing his description of Mercury's small size.
ambiguity: The subject 'it' is Mercury from the previous caption; size comparison only.
classical_check: Silent; astronomically Mercury is somewhat larger than the Moon, so the remark is correct.

hindi: कहा जाता है कि बृहस्पति की पत्नी तारा के साथ चंद्रमा ने संभोग किया और बुध को पैदा किया।
says: By the traditional story, the Moon united with Tara, the wife of Jupiter, and Mercury was born from that union.
ambiguity: A mythological account that he then tries to re-read as an astronomical event.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic story of Budha as son of Chandra and Tara.

gist: Offers a cosmic-collision story: a boiling fiery Sun was hit by large meteorites, asteroids and planets, and thick hot drops flung out settled into orbits.
In that situation Jupiter became a huge gas giant ball and moved far away.

hindi: चंद्रमा के साथ तारामंडल को तारा कहा जाता है। उसकी पत्नी पत्नी मींस बृहस्पति सब समूचे तारामंडल का मालिक हुआ
says: The star cluster or constellation field is called Tara; calling Tara Jupiter's wife means Jupiter is the owner of the entire star field, with the Moon moving among those stars.
ambiguity: Garbled in the caption; the reading that Tara stands for the star field is his own interpretation of the myth.
classical_check: Silent; classical myth says Tara was Jupiter's wife, the star-field reading is his own.

hindi: और चंद्रमा जहां कक्षा में स्थापित हुआ और टकराया। टकराने के पश्चात बुध पैदा हो गया।
says: The Moon settled in its orbit and a collision occurred there, and after that collision Mercury came into being.
ambiguity: This is a personal cosmological story, not an astronomical fact.
classical_check: Differs from astronomy and from the Puranic story; it is his reinterpretation.

hindi: बुध पैदा कैसे हुआ? संभोग है एक प्रकार का। कॉस्मिक संभोग कहा जाएगा
says: How was Mercury born? Through a kind of union, which he calls a cosmic union: the collision is the physical form of the mythic mating.
ambiguity: A metaphor tying the myth to the collision story.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और बुध ग्रह सूर्य के पास में जाके कक्षा में स्थापित हो गया और चंदा मामा धरती के पास आ गए तो चंद्रमा का पुत्र कहा जाता है ये बुध
says: Mercury went and settled in orbit close to the Sun while the Moon came near the Earth; because of this origin Mercury is called the son of the Moon.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the chunk break.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is the son of the Moon in the classical story.

hindi: लेकिन छोटा वाला यानी अभी तक स्त्री है बिटिया है तो रजस्व वाला नहीं हूं पुरुष है तो वीर्य नहीं बना यानी छोटा मासूम
says: But it is the small child form of the Moon's son: a girl who has not yet had her first menses or a boy who has not yet formed semen, meaning an innocent pre-puberty child.
ambiguity: Presented as a biological image to show Mercury as a not-yet-mature planet; no age is given.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts call Mercury a youth (kumara) and neuter.

hindi: दोनों बच्चों की आप आवाज सुनेंगे चाहे लड़का है चाहे लड़की पतली पतली होगी क्यों होगा ऐसा क्योंकि अभी तक वो बुद्ध है
says: The voice of both children, boy or girl, is thin and high because they are still in Mercury's stage; a thin voice is a Mercury sign.
ambiguity: The caption writes 'Buddh' for Budh.
classical_check: Silent; voice is classically a Mercury matter via speech.

hindi: बुद्ध क्या करता है? बुध चंचल है। चलायमान।
says: The core trait he sets before the dance illustration is that Mercury is restless and in constant motion (chanchal, chalayamaan).
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is restless and mobile.

hindi: म्यूजिक नहीं चल रहा। डांस कर रहा है। छोटे बच्चे देखे अपने डांस निकल रहा है। गाना कहीं नहीं है। म्यूजिक कहीं नहीं है। नाच रहे हैं। ये बुध है।
says: Mercury dances without any music, like small children who burst into dance with no song playing; spontaneous, unprompted play is Mercury.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसके बाद क्या कर रहे हैं? पापा देख रहे हैं मुझे। थोड़ा तमीज से नाच रहे हैं। सूर्य देख रहा है। थोड़ा तमीज सी आ गई।
says: When the child sees father is watching, it dances more properly; the Sun's gaze brings a little discipline to Mercury, meaning Mercury with or under the Sun behaves in a more orderly way.
cells_derived_method: Sun and Mercury together (or the Sun aspecting Mercury) discipline the intellect; the house of the pair shows where. In a fire sign the discipline is confident, in an earth sign practical.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Mercury in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries): self-assured, disciplined, direct intellect.
Derived: Sun and Mercury in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo): a career where thinking and talking are sharply focused.
Derived: Sun and Mercury in Sagittarius in the 5th (lagna Leo): principled, learned study and children-linked guidance.

ambiguity: Whether he means conjunction or aspect is not stated; the story is about being watched, which suggests a looser nearness.
classical_check: Agrees in outline with Budhaditya yoga as a classical Sun-Mercury combination.

gist: Dramatisation: 'the guru has come, we will not dance now, we will wait a bit'.

hindi: बृहस्पति के आते ही बुध सेट हो गया। संभल के तमीज से चल रहा है। बहुत बढ़िया। अच्छे से जाएंगे भाई।
says: As soon as Jupiter arrives Mercury is set: it walks carefully and with manners; a guru's presence settles Mercury completely.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter conjunct or aspecting Mercury calms it, and the house shows where: Jupiter with Mercury in the 2nd steadies speech, in the 5th steadies study.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury (debilitated) with Jupiter in Pisces in the 2nd (lagna Aquarius): wise, steadied speech despite Mercury's weakness.
Derived: Mercury in own sign with Jupiter in Gemini in the 5th (lagna Aquarius): calmed, mature learning.
Derived: Mercury with Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 10th (lagna Pisces): steady, guiding professional intellect.

ambiguity: Conjunction versus aspect is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: Jupiter's association steadies Mercury; it is a benefic combination.

gist: Staging line: in all that time they found there was a commotion on the stage.

hindi: बुध ने कहा ओए शुक्र आ गया। ओए ओए यार डांस निकल गया भाई मेरे अंदर से। डांस निकल गया। ये शुक्र हो गया। शुक्र सेट हो गया।
says: When Venus arrives, Mercury cannot hold the dance back and it bursts out of him; Mercury with Venus brings out dance, art and pleasure and thereby Venus is set.
cells_derived_method: Mercury with Venus gives art, performance and charm; the house shows where it is used: in the 5th as stage or creative talent, in the 7th as charm in partnership, in the 3rd as skill in media.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury and Venus in Libra in the 5th (lagna Gemini): stage, music or creative performance talent.
Derived: Mercury and Venus together in Pisces in the 7th (lagna Virgo): artistic, idealising partner; Venus is at its peak here and Mercury at its weakest.
Derived: Mercury and Venus in Taurus in the 3rd (lagna Pisces): pleasant voice and media or craft skill.

ambiguity: Whether the pairing is conjunction or only both being active together is not specified.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury with Venus is a classical combination for arts and charm.

gist: Sets the scene: the stage is in full swing and the party is in uproar.

hindi: इंद्र आ गया। इंद्र के साथ बुध का सम्मेलन हो गया।
says: Indra, his name for Uranus, arrives, and Mercury meets Uranus in a gathering; this is Mercury in connection with Uranus.
ambiguity: Sammelan (gathering) is a conjunction by reading, not by his statement.
classical_check: Silent; Uranus is not in the classical nine-planet scheme.

hindi: और दारू लाओ ओए जब तक दारू नहीं पिएंगे चढ़ेंगे नहीं नाचेंगे नहीं भाई। फिर नागिन डांस शुरू हो जाता है।
says: Under Indra's influence the cry goes up for more liquor: they will not get up and dance until they have drunk, and then the wild naagin dance starts; Mercury with Uranus links to intoxicated, uninhibited revelry. This records his illustration, not advice to drink.
ambiguity: He does not say the word Uranus here; the scene follows Indra's arrival, so the liquor line is read as Indra's contribution.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नेपच्यून दूर बैठा बुध के साथ यदि कंबाइंड है। क्या कर रहा है? देख रहा हूं यार सब अच्छा लग रहा है। अरे आ गया बेटा मैं भी आ गया। बच्चे मैं भी कर रहा हूं। बस वो इतना वाला करते हैं
says: Neptune sits far off, and if combined with Mercury it watches, enjoys the show, then joins in a little, saying 'I too have come'; Mercury with Neptune gives an onlooker who participates in a small, passive way.
ambiguity: Neptune is called Varuna in his scheme; the caption gives 'Neptune'.
classical_check: Silent; outer planets are outside the classical scheme.

hindi: साथ में प्लूटो खड़ा है दूर कोई मुझे स्टेज पर खींच के नहीं ले जा रहा जब तक खींचेंगे नहीं फिर देखना मैं स्टेज तोड़ दूंगा तब तक मैं जाऊंगा नहीं रेजिस्टेंस बहुत जबरदस्त
says: Pluto stands far away saying nobody is dragging me on the stage and I will not go until pulled, and then I will break the stage; Mercury with Pluto shows a person with huge resistance who must be pulled into action.
ambiguity: Pluto is Yama in his scheme.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: खींच के ले जा रहा है प्लूटो के अंदर का बुध जो है वो रुकावट के साथ चल रहा है अब प्लूटो को घसीट के लाए उसके बाद उसने जो ताबड़तोड़ डांस किया तीन हड्डी तोड़ दी लोगों की
says: The Mercury inside Pluto moves only with blockage; once Pluto is dragged out, the dance he does is frenzied and breaks three bones among the crowd, an uncontrollable outburst after the resistance breaks.
ambiguity: The violence is a story detail meant to show explosive release, not a prediction.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कोई भरोसा नहीं किस-किस के लात पड़ी किस-किस के हाथ पड़े रोकना मुश्किल हो गया तांडव मचा दिया
says: No one can say whose kicks and hands landed on whom; it became hard to stop and a tandava of destruction broke out, showing how an unleashed Pluto-Mercury is unpredictable.
ambiguity: A colourful description with no chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन रेजिस्टेंस यही प्लूटो का स्वरूप है धर्मराज धर्मराज धर्म धर्म स्थापना भाई तरीके से नाचो यार देखो कोई किसी बंदे को नहीं मारेगा दारू पी के लड़की नहीं छेड़ेगा
says: Resistance is Pluto's own nature; Pluto is Dharmaraj (Yama), the establisher of dharma, who makes everyone dance in an orderly way so nobody hits anyone and nobody drinks and harasses girls.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next phrase about order being maintained.
classical_check: Silent; Dharmaraj is a name of Yama, which he assigns to Pluto.

hindi: नहीं यार गलत नहीं तरीके भाई अलग-अलग बिल्कुल व्यवस्था बना रहेगा प्लूटो जब अच्छी पोजीशन में होगा
says: When Pluto is well placed, every kind of behaviour stays within proper limits and the arrangement keeps its order.
cells_derived_method: A well-placed Pluto gives order where it sits: in the 6th it brings discipline to work and rivals, in the 12th it gives control over expenses and hidden things.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini): firm discipline in service and handling of enemies.
Derived: Pluto in Aquarius in the 12th (lagna Pisces): ordered control over losses and foreign matters.

ambiguity: 'Good position' is not defined; he gives no sign or house for it.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: शनि महाराज क्या करेंगे भाई साथ चल रहे हैं अपन देख रहे हैं यार किसने क्या जूते पहने हैं किसने क्या किया हुआ है कंपैरिजन चल रहा है भाई अपन भी लाएंगे हम भी करेंगे हमें भी तो चाहिए होता है
says: Saturn joins and goes along, watching what shoes others wear and what they have done; comparison is running, and he says 'we will get that too, we also need it'; Mercury with Saturn means comparing yourself with others and wanting what they have.
cells_derived_method: Mercury with Saturn shows comparison-driven ambition in the house they sit: in the 2nd it shows in money and speech, in the 11th in networks and gains.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury with Saturn in Aquarius in the 11th (lagna Aries): ambition to match peers, cautious and calculating gain-seeking.
Derived: Mercury with Saturn in Capricorn in the 2nd (lagna Sagittarius): measured, sober speech and money-saving with envy of others' possessions.

ambiguity: The 'comparison' reading is his dramatization.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury and Saturn are friends and combine into practical, sober intellect; the envy angle is his.

hindi: चंद्रमा क्या कर रहा है बस मंदमंद मुस्कुरा रहा है देख रहा है यार कौन बढ़िया कर रहा है उसी के पास जाके खड़ा होगा उसके साथ नाचने फिर ताल से ताल मिला रहे
says: The Moon just smiles softly, watches who is doing best, goes and stands next to that person and dances in step; Mercury with the Moon means a mind that imitates and attaches to the best performer around.
cells_derived_method: Mercury with Moon makes the mind adaptive and imitative, and the house shows the field: in the 4th at home, in the 10th at work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury and Moon in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries): adaptive, sensitive home mind that mirrors family moods.
Derived: Mercury and Moon in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo): changeable, quick-learning career that copies successful models.

classical_check: Agrees in outline: Mercury-Moon gives a reactive, adaptable mind.

hindi: ये अलग-अलग प्लनेट्स का व्यवहार बन जाता है। लेकिन बुध क्या कर रहा है? छिछोरापन।
says: All these dance-floor scenes are the behaviour of the different planets when joined with Mercury; but Mercury's own contribution throughout is chhichhorapan, frivolous juvenile behaviour.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये सारे क्या कर रहे हैं बुध के क्षेत्र में? छिछोरापन। छिछोरापन क्या है? आपके व्यक्तित्व का बचपना। आप युवराज हैं। आप पूर्ण सुरक्षित हैं।
says: Everyone in Mercury's field is doing chhichhorapan, which means the childishness of your personality; you are the crown prince, completely secure, so you may play freely.
ambiguity: Chhichhorapan can mean silliness, shallowness or playfulness; he treats it as a positive childlike quality of Mercury.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is the prince (yuvaraja) of the planets.

hindi: सूर्य अपने से 28 डिग्री दूर बुध को जाने ही नहीं देता। घसीट लेता है वापस अपने गुरुत्वाकर्षण में।
says: The Sun does not let Mercury go more than 28 degrees away and drags it back by its gravity.
cells_derived_method: Because Mercury is never more than about 28 degrees from the Sun, it is always in the Sun's sign or an adjacent sign, so it is in the same or a neighbouring house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) allows Mercury in Aquarius in the 11th, Capricorn in the 10th or Sagittarius in the 9th.
Derived: Sun in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries) allows Mercury in Virgo in the 6th, Leo in the 5th or Cancer in the 4th.

classical_check: Agrees: classical figures give about 28 degrees maximum elongation.

hindi: बुध इतना चंचल है। भाग रहा है। बार-बार वक्री हो रहा है। पापा ने बुला लिया। फिर आ गया भाग के। फिर धक्के मार के बाहर निकल गया। फिर सूर्य ने खींच लिया। इधर को आ
says: Mercury is so restless it keeps running off and turning retrograde again and again; father Sun calls it back, it runs away again and is pulled back, which is how he explains Mercury's frequent retrograde motion.
ambiguity: Retrograde here is given a poetic cause and no numbers.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury retrogrades often; the cause given is his image.

hindi: और सूर्य का इतना भयंकर तेज है यानी आत्मा का इतना भयंकर तेज है। आपकी आत्मा का इतना भयंकर तेज है कि बुद्धि
says: The Sun's brilliance is the brilliance of the soul, and that radiance is so strong that it keeps the intellect (buddhi) from going astray (the sentence finishes in the next chunk).
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the chunk edge.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: भ्रष्ट नहीं होने देता। इसलिए जिसकी आत्मा मर गई यानी सूर्य मर गया उसकी बुद्धि भ्रष्ट हो गई।
says: The soul's radiance does not let the intellect be corrupted; therefore, when the soul is dead, meaning the Sun is dead (very weak), the intellect gets corrupted.
cells_derived_method: A very weak Sun (debilitated in Libra, or heavily afflicted) leaves Mercury unprotected; a strong Sun (Aries or Leo) shields it. The house where the Sun is weak shows the field where judgment fails.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 10th (lagna Capricorn): ethics and judgment in work easily corrupted.
Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 1st (lagna Aries): strong soul-light protects the intellect.
Derived: Sun in own sign in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries): strong guarding of the mind in learning and children matters.

ambiguity: 'Sun dead' is figurative; it is not a defined condition (combust, debilitated, or afflicted).
classical_check: Silent as a rule; follows his Sun-as-soul reading.

hindi: अब उस बुद्धि को यदि कोई गुरु संभालेगा तो संभलेगी नहीं तो आतंकवादी बन सकता है। बर्बादी कर सकता है, कत्ल मचा सकता है।
says: A corrupted intellect settles only if some guru handles it; otherwise the person could turn into a terrorist, cause ruin or kill. This is his sweeping, non-measurable warning and must not be used to label anyone.
ambiguity: Rhetorical exaggeration; no chart condition is named.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए बुध का अपना कोई स्वरूप नहीं। बुध एक नपुंसक ग्रह है।
says: For that reason Mercury has no form of its own; Mercury is a neuter (napunsaka) planet.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is classically called a neuter planet.

hindi: यह जो छोटे बेबीज थे हमने बनाए। यह दोनों छोटे बेबी क्या करते हैं? इन दोनों बच्चों में पुसत्व नहीं है। इनमें पोटेंसी नहीं है। ये दोनों छोटे बच्चे ही हैं।
says: The two little babies he drew (the boy and girl forms of the child Mercury) have no manhood or potency yet; they are only children, which is why Mercury is called neuter.
ambiguity: He earlier named two children near the Sun (Mercury and Venus); here 'both' reads as the boy and girl images of Mercury; unclear.
classical_check: Agrees with Mercury being napunsaka; the child framing is his.

hindi: जिस दिन इसके शरीर के अंदर लड़के के परिवर्तन लड़की के परिवर्तन होगा उस दिन के पश्चात इनका शरीर पुंसत्व को प्राप्त करेगा। अभी ये नपुंसकता ही है।
says: Only after the bodily changes of puberty, in a boy or in a girl, does the body gain maturity; until then it stays in the neuter, pre-mature state, which is the state of Mercury.
ambiguity: The sentence uses puberty as a symbol for planetary maturity; no age is stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसीलिए बुध ग्रह छोटे बच्चे का छिछोरापन यह लेके हम चलते हैं।
says: So we carry Mercury as the silliness of a small child; this is the keynote with which we proceed in reading Mercury.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां हमारा सूर्य स्थापित है। चंद्र स्थापित है। यहां हमारा बुध स्थापित है। बुध खाली जगह सुराख ये खाली है।
says: On his diagram the Sun is placed at one spot, the Moon at another and Mercury at another; Mercury is the empty place, the hollow or hole between them.
ambiguity: He is pointing to a drawing we cannot see; the exact positions of Sun, Moon and Mercury are not stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां कुछ नहीं होता। सारे के सारे सुराख बुद्ध है। बांसुरी में सुराख गुब्बारे के मुंह के ऊपर सुराख कहीं पर भी पाइप है पाइप के मुंह का सुराख
says: Nothing is inside the hollow; every hole is Mercury, whether the holes of a flute, the mouth of a balloon, or the opening of a pipe.
classical_check: Silent; openings and passages are not a classical Mercury list item, though speech and throat are.

hindi: जो पाइप है पाइप के अंदर नोजल लगता है और वो लग जाता है नलके में वो है राहु मुंडी जो पाइप है वो है केतु उसका जो छेद है वो है बुध
says: In a pipe-and-tap picture, the nozzle that fits into the tap is Rahu (the head), the pipe body is Ketu, and the hole through it is Mercury, so Mercury is the passage between the Rahu head and Ketu body.
ambiguity: The caption is slightly garbled around 'nozzle' and 'tap'.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu as head and Ketu as body follows the Puranic story of the severed demon.

hindi: तो बुध ये सुराख है आपके बुध में दोष होगा तो आपके जबान गले में अटकेगी
says: Since Mercury is the hole, a defect in your Mercury means your tongue will get stuck in the throat, meaning speech hesitation. This is a traditional symbol, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Speech hesitation shows most where Mercury is weak or afflicted and the 2nd house of speech or 3rd house of expression is involved.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 2nd (lagna Aquarius): hesitant, unsure speech.
Derived: Mercury afflicted by Rahu in Gemini in the 2nd (lagna Taurus): rushed, tangled speech.

ambiguity: 'Dosha' of Mercury is not defined by a condition.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: afflicted Mercury is classically tied to speech defects.

gist: Mimics a stammer, 'I was saying, my hachak hachak', as a joke about having Mercury defect.

hindi: यानी ऐसा व्यक्ति इतनी चंचल और लल्लू बुद्धि का है उसको कोई भी भटका सकता है। उसकी आत्मा को जागृत करने की जरूरत है या उसे गुरु देने की जरूरत है। तभी सेट होगा।
says: Such a person has a fickle, gullible intellect that anyone can mislead; the remedy is to awaken the soul (Sun) or give him a guru (Jupiter), and only then will Mercury be set.
ambiguity: No measurable test for 'soul awakened' is given.
classical_check: Silent; strengthening Sun and Jupiter for Mercury is a general approach.

hindi: अन्यथा वह व्यक्ति मारा गया। उसको कोई भी कर सकता है। कहीं भी चेंज कर सकता है। बुध जिस ग्रह के साथ बैठ गया वैसा काम करता है।
says: Otherwise the person is finished, since anybody can turn him anywhere; the reading rule is that Mercury works in the manner of whichever planet it sits with.
cells_derived_method: To read Mercury, first note the planet it is with, then read Mercury's output through that planet: Mars gives sharp, aggressive thought, Saturn sober, Venus artistic, Jupiter wise; the house shows the field.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury with Mars in Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini): sharp, combative handling of rivals and cases.
Derived: Mercury with Saturn in Aquarius in the 5th (lagna Libra): sober, systematic study.
Derived: Mercury with Venus in Taurus in the 11th (lagna Cancer): gains through arts, trade and pleasant dealings.

ambiguity: 'Sits with' means a conjunction; aspect is not mentioned.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is classically said to take the nature of the planet it joins.

hindi: यहां गला है जो मर्जी खिला दो। रास्ता है मात्र। लेकिन यही वो द्वार है जहां से आप आत्मा तक जा सकते हैं।
says: The throat is just a passage where you may feed anything you like, but it is the door through which you can reach the soul; Mercury as the throat is the entrance to the atma.
ambiguity: Throat is read as a symbol of speech and of what one takes in.
classical_check: Agrees that the throat is a Mercury area; the soul-door image is his.

hindi: बुध सबसे सशक्त ग्रह है क्योंकि यह पापा का बेटा है। पापा की बिटिया भी है ये।
says: Mercury is the most powerful planet because it is the Sun's own son, and also the Sun's daughter.
ambiguity: Calls Mercury the Sun's child, while the classical parentage is Moon and Tara; 'strongest' contradicts his earlier statement that Mercury has no form of its own.
classical_check: Differs: Mercury is a son of the Moon in classical texts and is not ranked as the strongest planet.

hindi: लेकिन नपुंसक शब्द कहा जाता है इसलिए छोटा है इसलिए स्त्री तत्व में लेते हैं।
says: The word neuter is used because Mercury is small, so Mercury is taken as part of the feminine element.
ambiguity: Classically Mercury is neuter, not feminine; he groups it with the feminine principle for this scheme.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts call Mercury napunsaka (neuter) and do not class it as feminine.

hindi: स्त्री नपुंसक है। यदि आपके बुद्ध की डीएक्टिवेशन हो जाए यानी कार्य ढंग से नहीं करे तो आपको स्त्री तत्व नपुंसकता देता है।
says: He says the feminine element is neuter-natured, and that if Mercury is deactivated (not working properly) in your chart, the feminine principle shows up as impotence or loss of vitality. This echoes Mercury's classical neuter gender. It is a sexual-function claim, recorded as his tradition claim and not as a medical statement.
ambiguity: Opening phrase 'stri napumsak hai' is clipped; unclear if he means women or the feminine element in anyone.
classical_check: Classical texts call Mercury napumsak (neuter) graha; the link to impotence from a weak Mercury is a later sexology-style extension.

hindi: यही थायरॉइड है। स्त्रियों को क्यों होता है? गला घुट जाता है। बोलने नहीं देते। मुझे बोलने नहीं देते।
says: He links an afflicted Mercury to thyroid trouble and explains why it hits women often: their throat is choked because they are not allowed to speak, so suppressed speech lodges in the throat region. Recorded as his psychosomatic tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Does not say which house or sign placement of Mercury; this is a general karaka statement.
classical_check: Classical texts give Mercury the throat, speech and nervous system; thyroid as a named disease is a modern mapping, not in classics.

hindi: थायरॉइड ग्लैंड प्रॉब्लम क्रिएट कर देता है। हाइपोथायरिडिज्म या हाइपर थायरॉइडिज्म हो जाता है और पूरे हॉर्मोंस का इम्बैलेंस शरीर में हो जाता है
says: He says that once the thyroid gland misbehaves (under- or over-active), the whole hormone balance of the body goes off. He treats this as the bodily outcome of a damaged Mercury. Health content, flagged as his claim; the software must not use it as a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: Hypo versus hyper is not tied to any chart condition; he gives no rule to tell them apart.
classical_check: Silent in classical texts; hormonal language is modern.

hindi: स्त्री के शरीर में पुणसत्व खत्म होने लगता है धीरे-धीरे। ये इमंबैलेंस उसके शरीर और मानसिकता को खराब करता है। पुरुष भी इससे ग्रसित होते हैं।
says: He says the hormone imbalance slowly erodes the woman's core vitality (the caption word 'punsatva' is garbled; likely stri-tva or purush-tva), and that it damages both body and mindset. Men suffer the same Mercury-linked imbalance too.
ambiguity: Caption 'पुणसत्व' unclear: could be femininity (stritva), masculinity (purushatva) or vitality; meaning inferred from context.
classical_check: Silent in classics.

hindi: जिस व्यक्ति को ये चिंता फंस जाती है। दुनिया मेरे बारे में क्या कह रही है? दुनिया मेरे बारे में क्या सोच रही है? उसका बुध डिस्ट्रॉय होना शुरू हो जाता है।
says: Someone who gets stuck worrying what the world says and thinks about him starts destroying his own Mercury. A behavioural cause is given for Mercury damage: preoccupation with others' opinion, not a planetary placement.
ambiguity: Mercury is 'destroyed' in functional terms; he does not mean combustion or debilitation.
classical_check: Silent; a modern psychological reading of Mercury as the mind.

hindi: बुध डिस्ट्रॉय का मतलब क्या? पढ़ाई के स्थान में बैठा है पढ़ाई खराब। कमाई के स्थान में कमाई खराब। आपके जीवन में साथी के स्थान है साथी खराब।
says: A damaged Mercury ruins whichever life area its house governs: if it sits in the study house, studies suffer; in the earnings house, income suffers; in the partner house, the partner relationship suffers. Friendship, love and cash balance also go bad. So Mercury damage is read by the house it occupies.
cells_derived_method: Take the damaged Mercury's house and read that house topic as hurt: 4th/5th for study, 2nd/11th for earnings, 7th for partner. The sign it sits in decides how the damage looks (sign nature x house topic).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not stated by him: Mercury damaged in Gemini in the 5th house (lagna Aquarius) would show up as spoiled studies and poor judgement in children or romance matters.
Derived: Mercury damaged in Virgo in the 7th house (lagna Pisces) would show as a critical, nagging or unreliable partner and trouble in business partnerships.
Derived: Mercury damaged in Virgo in the 11th house (lagna Scorpio) would show as faulty income streams from trade or service and unstable friendships.

ambiguity: He names 'study place', 'earning place', 'partner place' without house numbers; which exact houses he means is assumed from classical topics.
classical_check: Agrees with the general principle that a malefic-afflicted planet harms the bhava it occupies; house numbers are not given here.

gist: Anecdote of a small child dancing with no music playing; asked why, the child says the music is playing in his head.
Closing line of the dancing-child story: the music is running inside the child's skull.

hindi: आपके दिमाग की वाइब्रेशन इतनी स्ट्रांग है कि आपको परवाह नहीं कि आप सड़क पर भी जा रहे हैं तो आप मस्त हैं। आपकी इस मस्ती को कोई बदल नहीं सका।
says: When the mind's vibration is strong, the person stays cheerful and carefree even in public, and nobody can change that mood. He presents this as the sign of a healthy, self-contained Mercury that others cannot disturb.
classical_check: Silent; behavioural reading of strong Mercury.

hindi: अन्यथा बुध जिसके साथ बैठ गया, जिसके साथ आप बैठ जाते हो, वैसी बुद्धि हो जाती है। चार दिन आप शराबियों के बीच बैठे। थोड़े दिनों में आप कहोगे हम भी पी ले।
says: Otherwise Mercury takes on the colour of whoever it sits with, and your intellect takes on the colour of the company you keep. Sit with drinkers for a few days and you will soon say you will drink too. Mercury is a mirror of company, both as conjunction in a chart and as everyday association.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in a house with another planet takes that planet's nature, and the house topic decides where the influence plays out. Mercury with Saturn in the 10th makes work-mind heavy and slow; with Venus in the 7th, partner talk becomes affectionate.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury joined by Saturn in Capricorn in the 10th house (lagna Aries) would take Saturn's sober, cautious tone in career decisions.
Derived: Mercury joined by Venus in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries) would take Venus's sweetness in partner dealings and business talk.
Derived: Mercury joined by Mars in Scorpio in the 8th house (lagna Aries) would take Mars's aggression, giving sharp, secretive or argumentative thinking.

ambiguity: Mixes two meanings: planetary conjunction and real-life company. He slides between them.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts say Mercury yields the results of the planet it is conjunct.

hindi: किसका बुध काबू में है। जिसने यह कहा शराबियों के बीच बैठ के मेरा क्या लेना देना? देखना हफ्ते में तो वो छोड़ देंगे मेरे मेरी वजह से। वह लीडर है।
says: The person whose Mercury is under control sits among drinkers without being pulled in, and within a week they quit because of his influence; he is the leader. A mastered Mercury makes you influence the group instead of being influenced.
classical_check: Silent; behavioural reading of strong Mercury and leadership.

hindi: बुद्ध ओरेटर है। आप वाणी के द्वारा जितने नेताओं को देखते हो ना बुद्धि चेंज कर देते हैं। वह बुद्ध है।
says: Mercury is the orator: the politicians you see changing people's minds through speech are showing Mercury at work. Mercury is assigned to public speaking and persuasion by voice.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the classical karaka of speech, debate and persuasion.

hindi: बुद्ध नकलची है ना काल। झूठ बोलने में माहिर है। अगले 5 साल में आपको यमुना के अंदर डुबकी लगा दूंगा।
says: Mercury is the copycat and an expert at lying; he gives the example of a politician promising to take you for a dip in a clean Yamuna in five years. Mercury covers imitation and glib false promises. The word 'ना काल' is a garbled caption.
ambiguity: 'ना काल' is unclear caption text, possibly 'na kal' or 'nakal'; the political example is illustrative.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classics give Mercury cleverness and mimicry; lying is a shadow side usually tied to affliction.

hindi: बुध इतना पावरफुल इन्फ्लुएंसर है। आपको झूठ, सच बोल-बाल करके कुछ भी कर सकता है। आपकी बुद्धि परिवर्तित हो सकती है।
says: Mercury is a very powerful influencer: by mixing lies and truth it can get you to do anything, and your own thinking can be altered. He is warning that Mercury is both the tool of persuasion and the weak point through which you get manipulated.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; consistent with Mercury as mind and speech.

hindi: आपके जीवन के अंदर पेपर देते हुए जो नकल मार रहे हैं वो बुध ग्रह है। मैथमेटिक्स का सब्जेक्ट बुध ग्रह है।
says: Copying in exams is Mercury, and mathematics as a subject belongs to Mercury. Two karakatwas: exam cheating and the maths subject.
classical_check: Maths is classical Mercury; cheating is his own extension of Mercury's trickery.

hindi: बहन, बुआ, साली, भतीजी यह बुध ग्रह है।
says: Sister, father's sister, wife's sister and niece are all Mercury relations. Female junior or collateral relatives are given to Mercury as karaka.
ambiguity: Sentence starts here and its last word sits under the next timestamp.
classical_check: Classics give Mercury maternal uncle and young relatives; sister and niece are commonly Mercury, the others are his extension.

hindi: आपके जीवन में आपकी बुद्धि जो भ्रष्ट है जो आप एकदम भन्ना जाते हो।
says: A mind that corrupts quickly into sudden fits of fury is his diagnostic of a spoiled Mercury. He is naming the symptom first (instant flaring up) before the conclusion that follows below.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; behavioural reading.

gist: Says he had once put the first gear on a bike, a passing quip before returning to the Mercury point.

hindi: इस प्रकार से यदि आपका दिमाग भन्ना जाता है तो आपका बुध डिस्टर्ब है।
says: If your mind goes into this kind of sudden spin or rage, then your Mercury is disturbed. A tests-style rule: quick-flaring temper is the observable sign of Mercury disturbance.
classical_check: Silent; he does not tie it to any placement.

hindi: बुध डिस्टर्ब का मतलब क्या है? आत्मा इसी में व्यस्त हो गई बाकी चीजों का सत्यानाश अन्य ग्रह कर डालेंगे।
says: A disturbed Mercury means the soul gets busy handling this one problem, and the other planets then wreck everything else. Mercury trouble absorbs attention so the other life areas fall apart. The caption word 'पापा' before it is garbled and omitted here.
ambiguity: Caption word 'पापा इसी की संभाल में लग जाएंगे' is garbled (probably 'aap'); meaning inferred.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बुध क्योंकि सबके नजदीकी मामला है। पूरे स्पेस एलिमेंट को कवर करता है। सारी ग्रीनरी, पेड़, पौधे, सारे के सारे पंछी यह सब बुध है।
says: Mercury, being closest to everyone, covers the whole space element, and all greenery, trees, plants and birds belong to Mercury. He assigns Mercury the akasha (space) element, which differs from the classical assignment, plus plant and bird karakatwa.
ambiguity: 'Space element' may be his own scheme; not sure whether he means akasha or physical open space.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Mercury the earth (prithvi) element; plants and greenery agree, birds are not commonly listed for Mercury.

hindi: यदि आप मान और सम्मान लेकर चलते हैं। अपनी बुद्धि का समझदार बनते हैं तो दूसरे के पास आपका बटन नहीं होता।
says: If you carry self-respect and become the master of your own intellect, others cannot press your buttons. Self-respect and discernment are the practical way to keep Mercury under your control.
classical_check: Silent; advice, not a chart rule.

hindi: 99% लोगों की लाइफ में बुद्ध की खराबी क्या है?
says: He claims that in 99 percent of people's lives Mercury is faulty, and goes on to show the fault is being easily provoked. It is a sweeping claim about the population, unmeasured.
