ambiguity: The 99% figure is rhetorical, not statistical.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Role-play of a boy going to anger his maternal uncle (mama) and the uncle snapping; ends with the child being the slave of whoever teases him.

hindi: आपका बुध काबू आपको कोई भी गुस्सा दिला सकता है। आप कोई भी लालच दे सकता है।
says: If your Mercury is not under control, anyone can make you angry, and anyone can tempt you with greed. Lack of control over Mercury is the exact point of weakness for provocation and temptation.
ambiguity: The caption drops a negative; the sentence only makes sense as 'if Mercury is not in control'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Illustration of being tempted by a pile of notes and a car seen on the road, thinking I want that car too.
Two plates of chole bhature arrive and each person wants the other's plate until one says take mine; illustration of greed and release.
Small children are innocent: one asks for a toffee, the other simply says take it.

hindi: लोग सिखाते हैं उससे छीन छीन के उसका बुध बिगाड़ते हैं कि जब तक छीन के नहीं लेंगे मजा नहीं आएगा। फिर वो बिगड़ैल बुद्ध बन जाता है।
says: People teach a child to snatch things, and by that spoil the child's Mercury, because he learns snatching is the only fun; the grown person then carries a spoiled, unruly Mercury. Teaching grab-over-give damages Mercury at the root.
classical_check: Silent; upbringing advice.

gist: Aside that women keep four wardrobes at home and men one, half of which is also occupied by the wife; he apologises, not against it.

hindi: बांट बाहर निकालो दे डालो बांट दो फिनिश आपका बुद्ध इंप्रूव होगा।
says: Remedy: take out and distribute what you are holding, give it away and finish with it, and your Mercury will improve. Decluttering by giving possessions away is prescribed as a Mercury remedy.
classical_check: Not a classical remedy; classical Mercury remedies are different (donations of green items, mantra).

hindi: अन्यथा क्या रहेगा सारे टाइम खिचड़ी चल रही है दिमाग में मैं क्या करूं मैं क्या करूं
says: If you do not release things, your mind keeps cooking a mess all the time, constantly asking what to do. Hoarding is tied to a jumbled, indecisive mind through Mercury.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मुझे रास्ता नहीं दिख रहा मुझे रास्ता नहीं दिख रहा क्योंकि आप चीजों को निकाल नहीं रहे
says: The feeling of not seeing any way ahead comes from not letting go of things. The repeated sentence belongs to the confused mind and he blames retained belongings for lack of direction.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह जो एलिमेंट है यहां स्पेस एलिमेंट है शिव नीलकंठ बुद्ध दुर्गा माता है इष्ट बुद्ध दुर्गा है।
says: This element is space, with Shiva as Neelkanth as its deity, and Mercury's presiding goddess is Durga, so Durga is the ishta deity for Mercury. A deity map for the space element and for Mercury.
ambiguity: Caption jumbles 'Shiv Neelkanth, Budh Durga'; unclear whether Shiva belongs to the space element only or to Mercury too.
classical_check: Differs: classical deity for Mercury is usually Vishnu; Durga for Mercury appears in some modern schemes.

hindi: इस जगह कुछ नहीं टिकना चाहिए ना टिकता है।
says: Nothing should stay or be stored in this space place, and nothing does stay there. He links the space element, Mercury, to an open place that should stay clear. This is a vastu-style claim; the exact location is unclear from the caption.
ambiguity: 'इस जगह' unclear: could be the centre of the home (brahmasthan) or the cupboard he was discussing.
classical_check: Vastu texts keep the brahmasthan open, which agrees in spirit; link to Mercury is his.

hindi: आपके जीवन में जो प्रवाह में चल रहा है आपका बुध फिट है। और बुध फिट का मतलब समझ लो दिमाग चल रहा है।
says: If life is moving in a flow, your Mercury is fit; Mercury fit means the mind is working well. Flow of life and working mind are his sign of a healthy Mercury.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: डिमेंशिया अल्जाइमर्स खोपड़ी खराब बुद्धि भ्रष्ट जबान में बदतमीजी तेज बोलना हिसाब गलत भूल जाना भुलक्कड़पन सारा बुध है।
says: Dementia, Alzheimer's, a spoiled head, corrupt thinking, rude tongue, fast talk, wrong calculation and forgetfulness are all Mercury. He lists cognitive decline and speech/calculation faults under Mercury. Recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Classics tie Mercury to intellect, memory and speech; named diseases are modern.

hindi: आप अपने जीवन में जितना दोगे उतना अधिक आपका 12वा घर सेट होता है।
says: The more you give in life, the more your 12th house gets set right. Giving and charity are tied to a healthy 12th house, the house of expenditure and release.
cells_derived_method: The 12th house is touched by 2 or more signs; the sign on it shapes the manner of giving. House 12 of lagna Aquarius is Capricorn, of lagna Cancer is Gemini.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 12th (lagna Aquarius) suggests giving that is structured and dutiful, such as regular fixed donations or service.
Derived: Gemini on the 12th (lagna Cancer) suggests giving through words, teaching, sharing information or writing.

ambiguity: He may be counting house numbers or sign numbers; context (giving) points to house 12 as expenditure.
classical_check: Agrees that the 12th is the house of expenditure and charity; setting it by giving is his remedy idea.

hindi: 12वा छठा ये दो घर प्रमुख है जो सिखिस्म की बात हमने की उसमें सेट किए गए हैं।
says: The 12th and the 6th are the two main houses here, and they were the ones set in the Sikhism discussion done earlier. The 6th and 12th are the pair that matter for this giving and service theme.
cells_derived_method: 6th is service, debt and daily work and 12th is loss, charity and moksha. The sign on each decides the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 6th (lagna Aries) gives service shaped by analysis and detail, with health and routine as the sphere.
Derived: Pisces on the 12th (lagna Aries) gives giving and release in a devotional or compassionate way.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 12th (lagna Capricorn) gives giving linked to teaching, pilgrimage and philosophy.

ambiguity: Refers to an earlier talk on Sikhism not in this slice; houses versus signs not clear.
classical_check: 6th and 12th are both dusthana in classics; as the two main houses for giving it is his framing.

hindi: बुध ग्रह के पास दो राशियां हैं। एक तीन नंबर राशि है और एक छह नंबर राशि है।
says: Mercury owns two signs, sign number 3 (Gemini) and sign number 6 (Virgo). Here he gives Mercury both signs and no Rahu rulership of Virgo.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's house lordship depends on the lagna: Gemini and Virgo become the houses counted from the lagna sign, so the same Mercury rules different house topics for each lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for lagna Gemini, Mercury rules the 1st and 4th houses and sits in own sign in the 1st, strongest on self and mind.
Derived: for lagna Sagittarius, Mercury rules the 7th and 10th and sits in own sign Virgo in the 10th, strong for career and trade.
Derived: for lagna Capricorn, Mercury rules the 6th and 9th and sits in own sign Gemini in the 6th, mixing luck with service, debt and rivals.

ambiguity: Sign numbering Aries=1 confirmed: 3 is Gemini, 6 is Virgo.
classical_check: Agrees with classical rulership of Gemini and Virgo.

hindi: तीन नंबर मिथुन है। मिथुन से ही मैथुन बना है। आपने मिथुन राशि देखी होगी। दो जोड़ा साथ खड़ा हुआ है।
says: Sign 3 is Gemini, and he links the word mithuna to maithuna; the Gemini symbol is a pair standing together. Definition of Gemini's symbol as a couple.
classical_check: Agrees: Mithuna means pair; the symbol is a man and woman.

hindi: मिथुन यानी बुध को दूसरा कोई चाहिए। कोई ना कोई व्यक्ति साथ चाहिए।
says: Gemini, meaning Mercury, always needs a second person; some companion must be with it. Mercury in Gemini is a companion-seeking nature.
cells_derived_method: The need for company shows in the house where Mercury in Gemini sits: 7th makes it partnership, 11th makes it a friend circle, 3rd makes it siblings and talk.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) makes the partner a talking companion, with an urge for constant conversation in marriage.
Derived: Gemini in the 11th (lagna Leo) makes a wide friend circle the main support and the source of gains.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Gemini is a dual sign and Mercury is sociable.

hindi: बात करने को हम कह सकते मैथुन क्रिया सेक्स की क्रिया होती है। लेकिन मिथुन राशि उसका प्रतीक मात्र है। इन द सेंस के कोई साथ चाहिए।
says: He admits the word maithuna points to the sexual act, but says the Gemini sign is only a symbol of it, in the sense of needing a companion. He cautions against reading Gemini literally as sex.
classical_check: Classical Gemini is the pair symbol; sexual reading is secondary and he correctly calls it symbolic.

hindi: दो लोग तो दो व्यक्ति चाहिए होते हैं। ऐसे लोग अकेले नहीं रह सकते। साथ चाहिए।
says: Natives of this Mercury or Gemini type need two people in the picture and cannot live alone; company is a must. This is his behavioural prediction for Mercury-heavy, Gemini-type people.
ambiguity: Unclear if 'such people' means Gemini lagna, Mercury in Gemini or anyone with strong Mercury.
classical_check: Silent as a rule.

hindi: जिसने अकेला जीना सीख लिया उसका बुध सध गया। यानी बृहस्पति ऑन है। उस व्यक्ति को अकेले इतना मजा आता है कि यार माय टाइम कहां है भाई?
says: Someone who has learned to live alone has mastered Mercury, which means Jupiter is switched on, and such a person enjoys solitude so much he asks where is my time. Mastery of Mercury's need for company turns into Jupiter's inward, self-sufficient quality.
ambiguity: Jupiter 'on' is a loose phrase; no placement is given.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as inner wisdom fits Mercury-to-Jupiter growth in his scheme.

gist: Anecdote of an uncle at home who stretches two 30 ml pegs over three hours listening to Jagjit Singh ghazals, enjoying his own company.

hindi: अकेले बैठ के तो दिखाओ अकेले सो के तो दिखाओ बिना दीवार की साइड के अकेले रह के तो दिखाओ आपका बुद्ध सेट है
says: A test of Mercury being settled: can you sit alone, sleep alone and stay alone without a wall at your side? If you can, your Mercury is set. Ability to be alone and unsupported is the measure of a mastered Mercury.
ambiguity: 'Without a wall at the side' is colloquial; means without any support.
classical_check: Silent; behavioural test, not a classical rule.

hindi: इसीलिए जितने संत हैं ज्ञानी हैं वो अकेले चले जाते हैं और खुले में रहते
says: This is why saints and wise people go off alone and live in the open: they have mastered Mercury's need for company. Renunciants living outdoors are offered as proof of the Mercury-solitude link.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; Jupiter and Ketu are the classical signifiers of renunciation.

hindi: स्पेस एलिमेंट बुध बाहर का बाहर का तत्व बाहरी दुनिया खुला इलाका
says: Mercury is the space element, which he describes as the outside element: the external world and open ground. He places Mercury as the planet of what lies outside the self.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Mercury earth element; space is generally Jupiter. Repeats his own scheme from the previous slice.

hindi: छेद एक ऐसी चीज है उस छेद को आप जितना कुरदोगे बढ़ता जाएगा छोटा नहीं हो सकता
says: A hole is a thing that grows the more you dig it and can never become smaller. He uses the hole as the picture of the space element: it only expands.
classical_check: Silent; an analogy.

hindi: इसलिए बुद्धि को जितना कुरेदोगे बुद्धि बढ़ती जाएगी छोटी नहीं हो सकती इसलिए बुद्धि खूब कुरेदो
says: Likewise the more you probe the intellect the more it grows and it cannot shrink, so keep probing the mind hard. Advice to exercise the intellect constantly as the way to strengthen Mercury.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical remedy.

gist: Gesture illustration of what we do when troubled: the hand goes to the head, with a garbled mention of hip bone and mooladhara, and an invocation to the third eye to open and the skull to work.

hindi: आपके दिमाग में जो दही बन गई कहते हैं ना मुंह में दही जमा रखा है। ऐसे दिमाग में जो दही जम गई मींस विचारों का कचरा फंस गया। कहां से निकलेगा? बाहर
says: When curd has set in the mind, meaning a garbage of thoughts is stuck, it has to come out through the outside. The mind blocked with thoughts is cured by expelling them outward, consistent with Mercury as the outer, open element.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप जैसे ही अपने क्लेश दुख परेशानी बक देते हो, बोल देते हो, सुना देते हो हल्के हो जाते हो।
says: As soon as you blurt out and tell your quarrels, grief and worries to someone, you feel lighter. Speaking out one's troubles is presented as the practical release for a congested Mercury.
classical_check: Silent; psychological advice.

hindi: मल त्याग दिया जैसे यहां कुछ खाना फस गया नीचे नहीं यह द्वार है जब तलक आपका यह सेट नहीं होगा आपकी बुद्धि भ्रमित रहेगी भ्रष्ट रहेगी
says: He compares venting to passing stool: like food stuck that has not gone down, there is a gate that must be set, and until it is set the intellect stays confused and corrupt. The point is that release must flow through the outlet, else the mind stays muddled.
ambiguity: Garbled: 'यह द्वार है' is unclear; could be the mouth or the lower outlet; the body part meant is not certain.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mentions he is teaching this in classes and asks the audience not to pre-leave or leak the material.

hindi: हमारे जीवन के अंदर क्या हो रहा है त्यागा नहीं जा रहा क्यों काबू नहीं क्योंकि बृहस्पति सेट नहीं
says: The reason you cannot renounce or let go in life is that you have no control, and that happens because Jupiter is not set. Jupiter is made the planet of restraint and renunciation that a restless Mercury needs.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Jupiter is the karaka of wisdom and restraint.

hindi: यह बृहस्पति की नाजायज औलाद है बृहस्पति क्या है बड़ा धीर गंभीर बुद्ध क्या है? महा चंचल फुदकु।
says: Mercury is Jupiter's illegitimate offspring: Jupiter is grave and patient while Mercury is extremely restless and hopping about. He uses the myth of Budha being born of Jupiter's wife to contrast the two temperaments.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic story: Budha was born to Tara, wife of Brihaspati, and Chandra, so Brihaspati is the legal but not true father.

hindi: तो वो बाप की तो सुनता ही नहीं लेकिन बाप तो बाप है। उसको क्षमा जरूर करता है।
says: Mercury never listens to his father Jupiter, but the father is still the father and always forgives him. Jupiter's forgiveness of Mercury is the setting for what follows when Mercury enters Jupiter's house.
classical_check: Classical texts call Jupiter and Mercury mutual enemies or neutral in different schemes, not father and son as such.

hindi: लेकिन बुध पापा के घर जाकर के कोहराम मचाता है। पापा के घर में सब व्यवस्थित रखा है। बुध कहता है मैं आग लगा दूंगा।
says: But when Mercury goes to his father's house he creates uproar: everything there is neatly arranged and Mercury says he will set it on fire. The house of Jupiter is the place where Mercury becomes disruptive.
ambiguity: Father's house is explained next as Jupiter's signs.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Mercury in Jupiter's signs as an enemy-sign placement and the effect is weaker; the tone of chaos is his.

hindi: इसलिए 12 नंबर राशि और नौ नंबर राशि जो बृहस्पति केतु के साथ लेता है। के 12 नंबर और बृहस्पति की अपनी राशि नौ। लेकिन यूजुअल ज्योतिष में नौ और 12 बृहस्पति के कहे जाते हैं।
says: Sign 12 (Pisces) and sign 9 (Sagittarius) are Jupiter's: Jupiter shares sign 12 with Ketu and owns sign 9 on its own. He notes that in usual astrology 9 and 12 are simply Jupiter's, so Ketu's share of Pisces is his own addition.
ambiguity: Numbers 9 and 12 are sign numbers (Sagittarius and Pisces) by the confirmed Aries=1 order.
classical_check: Differs: classics give Pisces to Jupiter alone; Ketu as co-lord is a modern scheme (he says so himself).

hindi: वहां बुध कोहराम मचा देता है। अत्याचार मचा
says: In Jupiter's signs, Sagittarius and Pisces, Mercury creates an uproar. The placement of Mercury in these two signs is read as disruptive.
cells_derived_method: Disruption shows in the area of the house where Mercury stands; the lordship Mercury holds for that lagna adds the second layer, and the two Jupiter signs differ: Sagittarius is a fiery mutable sign, Pisces is the sign of Mercury's debilitation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Sagittarius in the 4th (lagna Virgo), where it rules the 1st and 10th, would disturb the home peace and the self-image with restless talk.
Derived: Mercury in Sagittarius in the 7th (lagna Gemini), where it rules the 1st and 4th, would bring a loud, argumentative partner or business dealings.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 10th (lagna Gemini), debilitated and ruling the 1st and 4th, would give a confused, unreliable public image and career talk.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 1st (lagna Pisces), debilitated and ruling the 4th and 7th, would blur the thinking and make the self scattered.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury in Pisces is debilitated; in Sagittarius it is not debilitated and results are mixed.

hindi: अत्याचार मचा देता है। छिछोरापन कर सकता है।
says: Mercury there can bring oppression and cheap, frivolous behaviour. He lists the shapes the uproar takes: harassment and low conduct.
ambiguity: Whom the oppression is directed at is not said.
classical_check: Silent; classical results for these placements are milder.

hindi: एव्री ह्यूमन सब में थोड़ा-थोड़ा सब प्लनेट्स होते हैं। सब में सब सारे प्लनेट पूरे-पूरे होते हैं अलग-अलग कॉम्बिनेशंस में।
says: Every human has all the planets in them, each fully present, only in different combinations. In his view no chart is missing a planet; people differ in how the planets are combined.
ambiguity: This part may be an audience member speaking; the speaker is not clear from the caption.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical fact that all nine planets are placed in every chart; the 'full strength' part is his own.

gist: Audience member asks what a ruling planet is, after a yes.

hindi: उसमें मतलब सारे रूलिंग प्लनेट हैं। कॉम्बिनेशंस चेंज होते रहते हैं लगातार।
says: In the answer, all the planets are ruling planets, and the combinations keep changing continuously. He rejects the idea of one fixed ruling planet for a person.
ambiguity: Speaker unclear; reads as his reply to the audience question.
classical_check: Silent on the modern ruling-planet idea; classics use lagna lord and dasha lord.

hindi: तो जैसे कोई मुझे बोलता है कि मेरा रूलिंग प्लनेट्स। वो ऐसे ही बोलते हैं ना उनको उतनी अकल है। कहीं तो कुछ शब्द बोल के खत्म करें।
says: When people tell him their ruling planet is X, they just say it casually because that is as much understanding as they have; they should end the topic with a few words. He treats ruling-planet talk as shallow.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो पंडित जी ये बोल रहे हैं देखो तुम्हारा सूर्य ऐसा है, मंगल ऐसा है, बुध ऐसा है। वो आपको बेवकूफ बना रहे हैं। वो अपना ज्ञान पेल रहे हैं कि मुझे आता है।
says: Pandits who say your Sun is like this, Mars like that, Mercury like the other are fooling you and just showing off knowledge. Describing each planet in isolation is, in his view, not real astrology.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with classical reading by combinations, not single planets; wording is his criticism.

hindi: मुझे बहुत लोग कहते हैं जन्मपत्री देखते हुए अच्छा जी मेरे ग्रहों के बारे में बताएं। मेरा सूर्य मैं कहता हूं पैसे वापस। तुम प्रेडिक्शन पे ध्यान दो।
says: When clients ask him to describe their planets one by one he jokes he will refund the fee and tells them to focus on predictions. His method is event prediction, not a planet-by-planet description.
ambiguity: The refund line is sarcastic, not literal.
classical_check: Silent; a statement of his own method.

gist: Banter that letters and secrets are being opened, and that otherwise he would be called an ill-mannered man who does not speak politely.
Proverb: eat the mangoes, why count the trees; take the benefit.
Asks rhetorically how Gangajal became pure.
Says do not debate it, enjoy; Gangajal put in pickle prevents fungus and stays for years without rotting or smell, so something miraculous is in it.

hindi: तीन नंबर राशि मिथुन राशि है। बुध की अपनी राशि है ये। और छह नंबर राशि इसने राहु महाराज के साथ शेयर की है। राहु की राशि है ये। छह नंबर।
says: Sign 3, Gemini, is Mercury's own sign, while sign 6 (Virgo) is shared with Rahu, so Virgo is also Rahu's sign. Here he gives Virgo to both Mercury and Rahu, in line with his 12-planet scheme.
classical_check: Differs: classics give Virgo to Mercury alone; Rahu as co-lord of Virgo is a modern scheme.

hindi: अब राहु के घर बुध जाता है, उच्च हो जाता है। यानी कमाल का फल मिलता है।
says: When Mercury goes into Rahu's house, Virgo, it becomes exalted and gives a remarkable result. He ties Mercury's exaltation to Virgo as Rahu's house.
cells_derived_method: Mercury exalted in Virgo gives its best results by the houses it rules for each lagna; the house in which Virgo falls decides which life area it lifts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 1st house (lagna Virgo), ruling the 1st and 10th, would give sharp intellect, clear speech and career success.
Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 10th house (lagna Sagittarius), ruling the 7th and 10th, would favour trade, analysis and public dealing.
Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 8th house (lagna Aquarius), ruling the 5th and 8th, would give research, occult or inheritance gains, with the 8th house still a hard place.

classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is exalted in Virgo; the Rahu link is his.

hindi: और राहु बुध के घर जाता है तो भाई कमाल का फल मिलता है।
says: And when Rahu goes into Mercury's house it also gives a remarkable result. Rahu in Gemini or Virgo is treated as strong and fruitful.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in a Mercury sign gives results through that house's topic, amplified; Gemini and Virgo sit in different houses for each lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 5th (lagna Aquarius) would amplify intellect, speculation, learning and children matters.
Derived: Rahu in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries) would amplify competition, service and the fight against enemies, usually in the native's favour.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo) would amplify career through communication, media and trade.

ambiguity: 'बुध के घर' could be one or both of his signs; read as both.
classical_check: Partly agrees: some texts treat Rahu as strong in Gemini or Virgo; others differ on which sign is exaltation.

hindi: अब राहु यदि बृहस्पति के इन्फ्लुएंस में हो तो बुध को कमाल की शिक्षा देता है। ज्योतिषी बना देता है बुध को।
says: If Rahu is under Jupiter's influence, it gives Mercury excellent education and makes Mercury an astrologer. Rahu plus Jupiter influence turns Mercury's skills towards learned fields.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's influence on Rahu can come by conjunction or aspect; the house where this happens decides whether it shows as education (4th, 5th), speech (2nd) or advice.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 4th (lagna Virgo), in Jupiter's own sign, suggests foreign or higher schooling with an unusual stream.
Derived: Rahu in Pisces in the 5th (lagna Scorpio) suggests deep study of subtle subjects, astrology or spiritual lore.
Derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 2nd (lagna Scorpio) suggests speech and income built on teaching or advising.

ambiguity: The nature of the influence (conjunction or aspect) is not specified.
classical_check: Silent; Guru-Chandala is classically a mixed yoga, which he does not mention.

hindi: यानी आपकी वाणी आप ज्योतिषी हो लेकिन क्या आपके पास वाणी है, बोलने का वक्तव्य है?
says: Being an astrologer is not enough, he says: do you have a voice and the ability to deliver a statement? Success as an astrologer depends on speech, which is Mercury.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Mercury as speech karaka.

hindi: क्योंकि बुद्ध वाणिज्य है, व्यापार है। बोलने की ताकत है। आपके शब्द कितने खुले हैं, साफ है।
says: Mercury stands for commerce and trade and for the power of speaking, and the test is how open and clear your words are. Business and clear speech are put under one karaka.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the karaka of trade, speech and communication.

hindi: अगर कोई व्यक्ति हकलाता है, तुतलाता है, बुध का महान दोष है। वो कभी ठीक नहीं हो सकता। इतना भयंकर दोष बन जाता है आपका
says: A person who stammers or lisps has a great Mercury fault and, he says, it can never be fixed. He calls it so severe a defect. Speech impairment is read as a Mercury defect; the never-curable claim is his and not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Sentence trails into the next timestamp.
classical_check: Classics link speech defects to afflicted Mercury and the 2nd house; 'never curable' is his own strong claim.

hindi: राहु आपको भड़का के आतंकवादी बना सकता है और यही आपको देवता पर यह पक्की बात है दुनिया फॉलो करेगी आपको
says: Rahu can provoke you into becoming a terrorist and the same Rahu can make you godlike, and the world will follow you either way. Rahu amplifies influence over followers in both a destructive and an uplifting direction. The wording is partly broken in the caption.
ambiguity: Caption garbled around 'देवता पर'; reading is inferred. Link to the preceding Mercury defect line is unclear.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu amplifies extremes; the terrorist label is his example.

hindi: राहु के घर जब बुध जाता है तो नक्षत्र के अंतर्गत छह नंबर कन्या राशि कहा जाता है इसको कन्या
says: When Mercury goes into Rahu's house, that is sign number 6, Virgo, which is called Kanya (the maiden). He names the sign by its Hindi name and moves to the nakshatras of the sign.
classical_check: Agrees: Kanya is the Sanskrit name of Virgo.

hindi: कन्या छोटी सी कन्या हमने बनाई या बड़ी स्त्री जो पूर्ण रूप से अपने आप में ब्रह्मचारिणी है वो कन्या ही मानी जाएगी तभी तो बुद्ध के लिए माता की पूजा की जाती है।
says: Kanya may be a small girl or a grown woman who is fully celibate within herself; either counts as kanya. This is why the Mother goddess is worshipped for Mercury. Virgo's maiden symbolism is used to justify goddess worship as Mercury's remedy.
classical_check: Virgo's maiden symbol agrees; goddess worship for Mercury is not the classical remedy (Vishnu is).

hindi: दुर्गा के दिनों के अंदर आप छोटी-छोटी कंजक जो अभी तक जिनको रजस्वला नहीं हुई है उनके चरण धोते हैं। उनको दक्षिणा देते हैं, भोजन देते हैं कि माता यानी बुध को प्रसन्न कर रहे हैं आप।
says: During the Durga days people wash the feet of little girls who have not yet reached puberty, give them money and food, and thereby please the Mother, which means pleasing Mercury. Kanya pujan during Navratri is presented as a Mercury remedy.
classical_check: The custom is real; treating it as a Mercury remedy is his reading, not a classical remedy.

hindi: बुध प्रसन्न करने से क्या होगा? आपके अंदर चंचलता रहेगी।
says: What happens when Mercury is pleased? Liveliness and playful restlessness will stay within you. A pleased Mercury keeps you agile and spirited.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Mercury as youthful.

hindi: आपके हवा के स्थान, सारा नर्वस सिस्टम, दांत, आंत ये सब बुद्ध के पास है।
says: Mercury holds the air places in the body, the whole nervous system, the teeth and the intestines. A body-part karaka list for Mercury; recorded as a tradition claim, not medical advice.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classics give Mercury the nervous system and skin; intestines are usually Virgo and the 6th house, teeth the Sun, Venus or the 2nd.

hindi: अगर आपको इन चीजों की प्रॉब्लम आ रही है, बुध की दशा की तगड़ी मार है कहीं ना कहीं।
says: If you are having trouble with these body parts, there is a heavy hit from a Mercury dasha somewhere. Trouble in nerves, teeth or intestines is taken as a sign of Mercury's period acting. A health reading recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Whether current or past dasha is meant is not said.
classical_check: Silent as a rule.

hindi: इसलिए खूब देना शुरू करो और विशेष तौर पे हरे नोट पे ध्यान दें। हरे रंग का होता है बुद्ध नोट।
says: So start giving a lot, paying special attention to green notes, since Mercury's note is green in colour. Remedy is charity, with the green currency note linked to Mercury through its colour.
ambiguity: Unclear which Indian note he means; the point is its green colour.
classical_check: Agrees that green belongs to Mercury; giving of green items is a classical remedy, giving green notes is his extension.

hindi: और देने कहां है? इसका इशारा समझ लेना।
says: And where should the giving go? He asks you to catch the hint, which points to the next topic, the maiden sign Virgo and its nakshatras. The destination of the donation is not stated outright.
ambiguity: No explicit recipient is named; the hint is left to the listener.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कन्या राशि के पास उत्तरा, फाल्गुनी, हस्त नक्षत्र और चित्रा यह राशि है। उत्तरा फाल्गुनी के तीन चरण हैं। हस्त के चारों चरण होते हैं और चित्रा के दो चरण हैं।
says: Virgo contains the nakshatras Uttara Phalguni (three padas), Hasta (all four padas) and Chitra (two padas). He gives the nakshatra make-up of Virgo.
ambiguity: Caption writes Chitra as 'और्रा / औरित्रा'; read as Chitra.
classical_check: Agrees: Virgo holds the last 3 padas of Uttara Phalguni, all of Hasta and the first 2 of Chitra.

hindi: इस राशि की जो योनि है जो शेप है अंतरिक्ष के अंदर उसमें गौ महष और व्याघ्र है।
says: The yoni, meaning the animal form of these nakshatras in space, is cow, buffalo and tiger. He gives Virgo's three animals for Uttara Phalguni, Hasta and Chitra in that order.
ambiguity: Caption 'महष' read as buffalo (mahisha).
classical_check: Agrees with the yoni list: Uttara Phalguni cow, Hasta buffalo, Chitra tiger.

hindi: व्याघ्र जो होता है इसको हम क्लियर कर दें। टाइगर होता है।
says: He clears up that vyaghra means tiger. The third animal of Virgo's nakshatras is the tiger, linked to Chitra.
classical_check: Agrees: vyaghra is the tiger.

hindi: महिषासुर मर्दिनी महेश ने गौ को खाया। अत्याचार किया सुंदरता बेहतरी पे लाजवाब पने पर गाय बृहस्पति के अंतर्गत। जैसे ही उसने दोष किया महेश ने खाया।
says: A mythic picture: the buffalo (Mahisha, caption says Mahesh) ate the cow, doing violence to beauty and goodness, and here the cow is placed under Jupiter. As soon as the cow was at fault, the buffalo ate her. Symbolic reading of Virgo's animals as a story of planets.
ambiguity: Caption jumbles 'Mahesh' for 'Mahish'; he later gives the cow to Venus, which contradicts this.
classical_check: Silent; classical cow karaka is Venus or the Moon; he contradicts himself within a few lines.

hindi: माता कन्या कन्या राशि कौन स्त्री कौन स्त्री जो पूर्ण रूप से वे वैष्णवी है दुर्गा का पति नहीं है पार्वती का पति है
says: Durga is shown riding a tiger; Kanya sign stands for the woman who is wholly Vaishnavi, and Durga has no husband, while Shiva is the husband of Parvati. He separates Durga the virgin from Parvati the wife to explain the Virgo symbol.
ambiguity: Caption broken at 'महेश को टाइगर शेर के ऊपर सवार माता'; first part of this sentence is hard to read.
classical_check: Silent; mythology, not a chart rule.

hindi: इसलिए दुर्गा कौन है भगवती भग को धारण करने वाली योनि को धारण करने वाली माता कौन है वर्जिन लेकिन मां समान माना जाता है
says: So Durga is Bhagavati, the one who holds the bhaga, the womb or yoni, yet she is a virgin and is regarded like a mother. This defines the Virgo goddess as virgin and mother together.
classical_check: Silent on Durga for Mercury; the epithet Bhagavati is classical.

hindi: स्त्री को वो दर्जा दिया गया है केवल आदर का उसके प्रति भावनात्मक रूप से काम, क्रोध इत्यादि खत्म।
says: The woman is given only the status of reverence, and emotionally lust, anger and the like towards her are finished. Seeing the Virgo woman as the Mother removes desire and anger from the mind.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वह अगर इतनी पवित्र बुद्धि आपकी होगी तो एकाग्रचित बुद्धि होगी। वन पॉइंट अटेंशन जानेगी और मैनिफेस्टेशन कर सकती है।
says: If your intellect is that pure it will be single-minded, will know one-point attention and will be able to manifest what it wants. A pure Mercury gives concentration and the power of manifestation.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: महिषासुर नाम के राक्षस को मार सकती है। महिष भैंसा शनि तक को काबू कर लेता है।
says: Such a pure intellect, as the goddess does, can kill the demon Mahishasura; and the buffalo (mahisha) is the one that can bring even Saturn under control. So a pure Mercury, as Durga, overcomes the Saturn force.
ambiguity: Subject of 'काबू कर लेता है' is unclear: the buffalo or the one who kills it.
classical_check: Silent on Mercury overcoming Saturn; mythology.

hindi: ये काला भैंसा शनि का स्वरूप होता है।
says: The black buffalo is the form of Saturn. He assigns the buffalo to Saturn.
classical_check: Agrees in popular tradition: the black buffalo is associated with Saturn and Yama.

hindi: गाय शुक्र का स्वरूप यानी इन दोनों ग्रहों के द्वारा यदि आपको आनंद लेना और जेब में कहते हैं ना पैरों में लक्ष्मी आके गिर रही है।
says: The cow is the form of Venus, so through these two planets, Saturn and Venus, you can enjoy life and money comes to you. He gives the cow to Venus here, which contradicts the earlier line placing the cow under Jupiter.
ambiguity: Which two planets are meant is inferred as Saturn (buffalo) and Venus (cow).
classical_check: Agrees that the cow is Venus or Moon; contradicts his own earlier statement of the cow under Jupiter.

hindi: एक लक्ष्मी पैर में आती है एक जेब में और एक सिर पर। सिर पर वो आती है जो फ्री फंड में मिल गई। जेब में आती है मेहनत करके पैरों में आती है जो आशीर्वाद से मिली।
says: Wealth comes in three ways: to the head, which is free windfall money; to the pocket, which is earned by effort; and to the feet, which comes by blessing. A classification of Lakshmi by how money arrives. No investment advice is implied.
classical_check: Silent; folk classification, not a chart rule.

hindi: इसलिए लोग बोल-बोल के कमाते हैं। बोल-बोल के क्या कमाते हैं? जनता दुनिया फॉलो कर लेती है।
says: That is why people earn by speaking, and what they earn by speaking is followers: the public follows them. Speech-based earning, Mercury's domain, brings a following.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is the karaka of earning through speech and trade.

hindi: बोल-बोल के बातें कर कर के कमीशन एजेंट्स होते हैं। व्यापार वाणिज्य करने वाले बड़े-बड़े व्यापारी ये मीटिंग्स करते हैं। सिर्फ बातें करते हैं। एक मीटिंग हॉल में कंसल्टेशंस करते हैं। ये सब बुद्ध है।
says: Commission agents, big traders and consultants who earn just by talking, holding meetings and consultations in a hall, are all Mercury. Professions that live on talk and negotiation are given to Mercury as karaka.
classical_check: Agrees: classical Mercury karakatwa includes trade, brokerage, speech and negotiation.

hindi: ज्योति भी यही बनाता है। सीए ये बनाता है।
says: Mercury also makes astrologers (caption says 'jyoti', read as jyotishi) and chartered accountants. Both professions of calculation and advice are attributed to Mercury.
ambiguity: Caption word 'ज्योति' is clipped; read as jyotishi (astrologer).
classical_check: Agrees: accountancy and astrology are classical Mercury professions (with Jupiter for astrology).

hindi: जितने वाणिज्य व्यापार बनिया कम्युनिटी पूरा बुद्ध है।
says: All commerce and trade, and the whole Baniya trading community, is Mercury. He ties the merchant caste to the planet of trade; taken as a karaka for business, not a verdict on people.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury governs the vaishya or trading varna.

gist: Remarks on Baniya families: they keep elders, even great-grandfathers, at home and daughters-in-law press the mother-in-law's feet whether or not they like her.
Generalisation that traders hold money tightly, swallow crores quietly, and business is in the blood because the community moves together.

hindi: बनिए दान बहुत करते हैं। ब्राह्मणों की विशेष सेवा करते हैं।
says: Traders give a great deal of charity and serve Brahmins specially. He presents merchant giving and respect to priests as the working method of a Mercury-strong group.
ambiguity: A community generalisation used as an example, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ब्राह्मण कौन है? बृहस्पति। बनियों ने तो सेट किया। ब्राह्मण के पांव पूज लेंगे। रामचरितमानस करा लेंगे। यह करा लेंगे।
says: The Brahmin is Jupiter, and the merchants have set Jupiter right by worshipping a Brahmin's feet and having Ramcharitmanas and other rituals performed. Mercury is stabilised by keeping Jupiter, his father, satisfied through religious acts.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the karaka of Brahmins, priests and rituals.

hindi: धर्म का कार्य जैसा जिसका जो धर्म हो तो जो किसी भी धर्म में बनियों के समान कार्य कर रहा है शनि सेवक ही सेवक मिलेंगे महिष सेवक हो गया
says: Religious work according to one's own faith, done the way the merchants do, applies in any religion. Saturn then gives servants, the buffalo standing for the servant. The middle of the sentence about Lakshmi is garbled in the caption.
ambiguity: Caption 'लक्ष्मी माता जेम में उसकी का बुआ है' is unreadable; only the Saturn-servant-buffalo part is taken.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn is the karaka of servants and labour; buffalo as servant fits his earlier buffalo-Saturn line.

hindi: लक्ष्मी माता गाय हो गई और व्याघ्र टाइगर शेर के ऊपर सवार हो के माता यानी बुध उच्च का हो गया तो कोई भी कन्या
says: Lakshmi is the cow, and when the Mother rides the tiger, meaning Mercury, it is exalted, so any maiden is such a Mother. He lines up the three animals of Virgo's nakshatras with the planets: cow Venus or Lakshmi, buffalo Saturn, tiger as the mount of the exalted Mercury goddess.
ambiguity: Sentence trails into the next line; 'कोई भी कन्या' is cut.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is exalted in Virgo; the goddess-on-tiger picture is his symbolism.

hindi: क्यों घर में बैठी सब पत्नियां जो शेर पे सवार हैं उनके आगे हाथ जोड़ के चलें
says: All wives sitting at home are the goddess seated on the lion, so walk before them with folded hands. He treats the wife as the Mercury goddess and asks for reverence at home.
ambiguity: Said half in jest; the practical point is respect for the wife.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए आपको क्या बनना है आज से आपको शेर बनना है ये पुरुषों के लिए है शेर बनो
says: Men are told that from today they must become the lion. The lion is the mount of the Mother, so the man's role is to carry and support her.
ambiguity: Gendered advice; meaning is to be strong and steady, not literally a lion.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Joke on how to become a lion: never wash your face, because his mother says lions do not wash their faces.

hindi: इसीलिए आपको शेर बनना है ताकि माता शेर पर सवार हो जाए। उस सम्मान मात्र से आप बुद्ध वाणी के द्वारा कमा लोगे।
says: Become the lion so that the Mother can ride on you; by that honour alone you will earn through Mercury, meaning speech. Earning through speech and business follows from giving the women of the home their seat of respect.
classical_check: Silent; a traditional-folk remedy.

hindi: इसीलिए पत्नियों की एक विशेष समस्या होती है। बात नहीं करते। उसे बकड़ बकड़ बात चाहिए बहन को। जब तक बातें नहीं करेंगे बुद्धि संतुलित नहीं होगी।
says: A typical complaint of wives is that the husband does not talk to them; a woman needs endless chatter, and until there is talk her intellect will not be balanced. Regular conversation is needed to keep Mercury balanced, especially for women.
ambiguity: Generalisation about women in a light tone.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इस संतुलन के होने के पश्चात में आपको शुक्र का भी आशीर्वाद मिलेगा। तब आपको चाय और पकोड़े मिलेंगे। अन्यथा आपको डंडे पड़ेंगे।
says: Once that balance is reached you also get Venus's blessing, and in the household that means tea and pakoras; otherwise you get the stick. Mercury balance through conversation brings domestic harmony, which is Venus's domain.
ambiguity: Humorous; do not read the stick literally.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A listener remarks that it would be nice if there were no need to speak at all, and he says that is a lovely thought.
Poses the question how to set Mercury without speaking, leading into the next practical remedy.
Introduces a simple, quick practical measure; people will try all the experiments tonight, he says he knows it.

hindi: यह हमारा सूर्य का स्थान है। यह हमारा बुध देवता का स्थान है। अब बुध यह खाली स्थान है। बुद्ध यहां वास करता है। माता दुर्गा इष्ट है।
says: Pointing to the body, he says one place is the Sun's seat and another the seat of the Mercury deity, which is an empty space. Mercury dwells in empty spaces and its ishta deity is Mother Durga. Body-based placement of Mercury in the vacant spaces.
ambiguity: Gestures are not captured; which body parts he points to as Sun's and Mercury's places is unknown.
classical_check: Differs on the deity: classically Mercury's deity is Vishnu; Durga is his scheme, repeating the earlier line.

hindi: खाली स्थान कहां आ गया? ये आ गए नाक के दो छिद्र। कान के ये छिद्र आ गए। यह हमारे जो मोरी है बिल्कुल कोना। यह बुध है।
says: The empty spaces of the body are the two nostrils, the openings of the ears and the lowest drain-like outlet; these are all Mercury. He maps Mercury onto the body's orifices.
ambiguity: 'मोरी' (drain) is the lowest bodily outlet by implication.
classical_check: Silent in classics; orifices as space are tantric body-lore.

hindi: अब बुध की एक्टिवेशन बुद्धि को शांति लाना।
says: Activating Mercury means bringing peace to the intellect. Setting Mercury is not stimulation but calming the mind.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: रात को सोते हुए तकिए को बोल दो। रात को आप बेड को बोल दो। अच्छा अपने पेट को बोल दो। अपने शरीर से बात करो। मुन्ना से सेटिंग करो। बातचीत करो।
says: Remedy he has taught before: at night talk to your pillow, your bed, your stomach, your body, as if to a little child; make settings with it and converse. Talking to oneself or the body is the speaking-free way to set Mercury.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' means the inner child or the body; not literal.
classical_check: Not a classical remedy; his own practice.

hindi: घर के अंदर एक नन्हा बच्चा बुध की बात हो रही है। छोटा बेबी पैदा हुआ है। उस छोटे बेबी को हमें ट्रेंड करना है कि गुड बेबी बन जा, बढ़िया बन जा।
says: Mercury is likened to a newborn in the house, a little baby that we have to train to be a good baby. The mind or Mercury is to be trained gently, as a parent trains an infant.
classical_check: Silent; Mercury's youthful nature is classical, the training method is his.

hindi: तो पहली बात आपके बृहस्पति में जान होनी चाहिए। आप धर्म अनुसार नियम अनुसार होने चाहिए। धर्म को समझ ले।
says: First, your Jupiter must be strong and alive: you must live by dharma and rules, and understand what dharma is. A strong Jupiter is the precondition before Mercury can be trained.
ambiguity: Caption 'बृहस्पति चित्रण में' is garbled and left out.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is the planet of dharma.

hindi: धर्म क्या है? सूर्य का धर्म है चमकना। आग फेंकूंगा। अच्छी गंदी बुरी बात गई भाड़ में। बस खत्म।
says: Dharma, for a planet, is its own nature: the Sun's dharma is to shine and throw fire, whatever people call good or bad. Each planet follows its nature without apology.
classical_check: Silent; a definition of dharma as svabhava.

hindi: लोग हनुमान जी की पूजा करते हैं। जय हनुमान। और उसके बाद बाहर निकलते हैं हनुमान मंदिर से यह मोटा टीका लगाए। उनको हक ही नहीं है किसी स्त्री को माता बहन के अतिरिक्त कुछ सोच लें। क्योंकि आप ब्रह्मचारी देवता को इनवोक कर रहे हैं।
says: People worship Hanuman and leave the temple with a thick tilak, but they have no right to look at any woman other than as mother or sister, because the deity invoked is celibate. A do-and-don't: worship of a celibate god demands pure conduct towards women.

hindi: यदि आप ऐसी स्थिति करते हैं तो हनुमान तो अलग रुष्ट होंगे और आपका सत्यानाश अलग पिटेगा। इसलिए आप पुनः नहीं जा सकते उस देवता को नाराज करने के लिए। किसी हालत में भी।

hindi: यह मत सोच के चलना भगवान हमारे जो हैं वो सिर्फ प्रेम और आशीर्वाद ही देते हैं। वो आप उनको रुष्ट भी कर सकते हैं आपके कर्मों के द्वारा।

hindi: तो आपने अपने बुध के साथ किसी किस्म की नेगेटिविटी नहीं करनी। कैसे होगा? आपकी नाकों के साथ आपके हवा के द्वार घर के अंदर।

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके कान के साथ आपको कान की प्रॉब्लम है, नाक की प्रॉब्लम है, नाक फंस रही है, गले में चल रहा है। कहीं ना कहीं बुध का दोष बन गया है।
says: Ear problems, nose problems, a blocked nose or throat trouble all point to a Mercury dosha somewhere in the chart. Recorded as his claim and not a diagnosis.

hindi: अब कोई गुरुजी आते हैं। गुरुजी इस बच्चे को आशीर्वाद दो। इसके कान में कोई मंत्र फूंक दो। कैसी विचित्र बात है।
says: A guru comes and the parents ask him to bless the child and blow a mantra into its ear, which he finds curious. The custom of whispering a mantra into an infant's ear is raised as an odd practice worth explaining through Mercury's ear opening.

hindi: आपने देखा रात को सोते सोते भी आपको कोई जगा देता है। बुद्धि चलाए माने रात को भी जगा पड़ा है। यह टेलीफोन की घंटी सुना दी। कोई आया है यार। कैसे पता लगा?
says: Even in sleep a sound wakes you, because the intellect keeps working and stays awake at night; you hear the phone ring or someone arrive. He uses this to show Mercury's watchfulness is on all the time through the ear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एक चक्र बना के रखता है आपके गले के पास एक घेरे का जो सिर तक कवर करता है। वैक्यूम क्रिएट करता है कि मैंने कंसंट्रेशन से यही काम करना है।
says: Mercury keeps a ring near your throat, a circle that covers up to the head, creating a vacuum so that you can concentrate on one task. The throat zone with its enclosing field is credited with focus.
ambiguity: The subject is implied to be Mercury, not stated.
classical_check: Silent in classics; the throat chakra link is tantric.

hindi: मैथमेटिक्स का सब्जेक्ट इसके पास है। बुद्ध डिस्टर्ब मैथ्स वीक। आपके हिसाब किताब यू उंगलियों पर चलते हैं। बुद्ध लाजवाब है।
says: Mathematics belongs to Mercury: a disturbed Mercury means weak maths, while a good Mercury makes calculation run on your fingertips. Calculation ability is used as the visible test of Mercury strength.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the karaka of mathematics and accounts.

hindi: आपने छोटी उम्र में दादाजी गुरु जी से कान में मंत्र फुकवा दिया।
says: In your childhood your grandfather had a guru blow a mantra into your ear. He treats this early ear initiation as an action done onto the Mercury opening of the child.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह गुरु के द्वारा जब हम शिक्षा लेते हैं कि गुरु मंत्र दिया जाए। कान में फूंका जाता है।
says: When we take learning through a guru, a guru mantra is given, and it is blown into the ear. Initiation by mantra goes through the ear, the Mercury and space organ.
classical_check: Agrees with the practice of guru-mantra deeksha in the ear.

hindi: यह ब्राह्मण जनेऊ निकालते हैं और कान पर लपेट लेते हैं। आकाश यह सदैव पवित्र रहता है। यह आकाश तत्व है।
says: Brahmins take off the sacred thread and wind it around the ear because the ear, being the space element, always stays pure. He gives the thread-on-ear custom as proof that the ear is ether and ever clean.

hindi: गला ये आकाश आकाश एलिमेंट है। ये धरती हो गई हमारी अर्थ भूमि ये जल अग्नि वायु आकाश कान ये आकाश तत्व है। कान भी आकाश तत्व है।
says: The throat is the space element, and going up the body the elements run earth, water, fire, air and space, with ear and throat as space. He maps the five elements onto the body with ether at throat and ear.

hindi: हमारा यहां पर भी ये पांचो चक्र चलते हैं। ऐसे ही पांचो एलिमेंट्स चलते हैं। आकाश तत्व हमारे कान रेडी है। ऑल द टाइम्स आकाश में सब एक्सेप्टेड है।
says: Five chakras and five elements run together in the body, and the ear is always ready as the space element, in which everything is accepted. The ear accepts every input at all times, which makes it open to what is said into it.
classical_check: Silent as chart rule; chakra-element correlation is traditional.

hindi: बच्चे के कान में मंत्र फूंकते हैं। बड़े के कान में गुरु जी मंत्र फूकते है। चलो बेटा ओम स्वाहा जो भी बोला वो कान में गया।

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: छोटा पैदा हुआ बच्चा सो रहा है। रेस्ट कर रहा है। उसी समय उसके कान में बोल दो। कोई बात बोल दो छोटे बच्चे के। बेटा बड़े
says: A newborn lies asleep and resting; at that moment speak into its ear, say some word to the little child, such as the start of a wish for the child to grow big. Speaking into a sleeping infant's ear is offered as a way to plant good programming. The sentence is cut off.

hindi: होके अपने शरीर को बहुत स्वस्थ रखना। वो बच्चा बड़ा होने तक शरीर स्वस्थ रखेगा। उसे पता ही नहीं। मंत्र फूंक दिया क्या कान में?

classical_check: Silent; a parenting-practice claim, not a classical rule.

says: Tell the child he will grow up to be a billionaire and he will become one, without knowing why. He claims whispered wealth suggestions work. Recorded as his claim; it is not financial or investment advice.

hindi: किसी भी एनर्जी से ही तो नहीं बोले। बृहस्पति की एनर्जी चाहिए तभी सुनेगा। यानी आप शुद्ध विचार होना चाहिए। आपने यूं ही बक दिया। उससे नहीं चलेगा।
says: It does not work to speak with just any energy; you need Jupiter's energy for the child to listen, meaning your thoughts must be pure. Mere casual blurting will not work. The whisper only takes effect when it comes from a pure, Jupiter-like state.

hindi: लेकिन बोलेगा कौन गुरु जी बोलेंगे जो सिद्ध हो चुका है जो इस चीज को काबू और सेट कर सकता है वही तो बोलेगा
says: Who is to speak the mantra? The guru, one who has already attained siddhi and can control and set this faculty. Only someone who has mastered Mercury can speak effectively into another's ear.

says: The ear is always open with its sky-route to the intellect and listens for 24 hours; it is a receiver, an acceptor. It cannot refuse input, which is why it is the doorway of Mercury.

hindi: यहां कान में जो मंत्र फूंक दिया जाए गुरु द्वारा वो बच्चे की खोपड़ी में घुसता है। मामा के द्वारा चाचा के द्वारा

says: The innocent child-like Mercury takes on the nature of whoever it is with: with Saturn it does Saturn's work, with Mars it runs Mars's temperament, with Rahu it shows Rahu's nature. ambiguity: The comic-book clause is garbled in the caption; the chameleon point is clear.
classical_check: Agrees with Mercury's adaptable, mimic nature.

hindi: छोटे बच्चे के कान में शुरुआत से संस्कार दें सुंदर भजन दे सुंदर बात
says: Give a small child good values from the start through the ear: beautiful bhajans and fine words. Positive early input is the constructive use of the ear channel.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एक बच्चा है तीन चार साल का वो गीता के श्लोक करता है कृष्ण की भक्ति करो कान में जो घुस गया इंफॉर्मेशन बन गई और वो बोल रहा है समझ हो ना हो

hindi: तुम कितने बड़े बच्चे हो और तुम अभी तक बड़ी बात करना नहीं सीख पाए क्योंकि तुम्हारे कान में मंत्र गलत फूंके गए हैं बचपन से।

says: Whatever is said into one person's ear becomes a mantra for that person alone. A private whisper works as an individual mantra on its listener.

says: Your command may be at fault, but the functioning of this planet can never be at fault. If the whisper fails, blame the command, not Mercury; the faculty always executes what it is given.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके अपने मूड में खराबी हो सकती है। क्या आपके अंदर अजपा तो कुछ और चल रहा है। सिर्फ बोलने के लिए आप बोल रहे हैं बेटा सबसे अच्छे नंबर ला। उसे ग्रीडी बना सकते हो। उसको भिखारी बना सकते हो। उसको बर्बाद कर सकते हो।
says: Your own mood may be faulty and something else may be running inside you, in the unspoken ajapa; if you merely say top marks, you can make the child greedy, a beggar or ruined. The inner state behind the words is what the child absorbs, not the words.
ambiguity: 'अजपा' is read as the unspoken inner current; caption is loose.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसी गलत कमांड दे सकते हो कि बच्चा बर्बाद भी हो जाए। बेटा औरों से ऊपर उठना है तूने वो ऊपर ही उठ जाएगा।
says: A wrong command can even ruin the child: if you say you must rise above others, he will indeed rise above, meaning he may set himself apart from everyone. The example shows how a careless ambitious command misfires.
ambiguity: The consequence of 'rise above' is cut at the slice break and may be separation or arrogance.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बड़े ध्यान से समझ के चलना। इसलिए समझदार व्यक्ति सही कमांड दे सकता है। अन्यथा नहीं।
says: Proceed with great care: only a wise person can give the right command, otherwise not. Competence in commanding comes from understanding and not from just wanting.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब आपको अपने ही कान में बात बोलनी है। ऐसी कई बातें हैं जो किसी से बोली नहीं जा सकती। बहुत गुप्त परेशानियां होती हैं। मानसिक पीड़ा होती है।
says: Now you must speak into your own ear, since many things cannot be told to anyone: secret troubles and mental pain. Self-addressed speech is the outlet for private distress.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप अपने मन में मनन कर रहे हैं और कह रहे हैं कि हे मेरे तकिए मुझे रात को डीप स्लीप में ले जा। तो वो डीप स्लीप में ले जाता है।
says: If you mentally address your pillow and ask it to take you into deep sleep at night, it does take you into deep sleep. The pillow-talk practice is claimed to work for sleep.
classical_check: Silent; his own practice.

hindi: ऐसे ही आपने अपने कान में खुद को ही बुदबुदा के बोलना है। शांति, शांति, प्रेम, आनंद, स्वास्थ्य, लाभ अपने आप होगा।
says: Likewise murmur into your own ear the words peace, peace, love, joy and health, and gain will come on its own. The self-whisper remedy is a set of calming words which bring benefit as a by-product.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप स्वयं से जब बोलना शुरू करेंगे एक अकेले कमरे में बैठकर के सबसे सुंदर जगह बोलने के लिए नॉर्थ है। बुध की दिशा नॉर्थ है।
says: Begin speaking to yourself sitting alone in a room; the best place to do it is the north, because north is Mercury's direction. He assigns Mercury to the north in vastu, with the self-whisper practice best done there.
ambiguity: A caption phrase about no specification being needed sits in the middle and is left out.
classical_check: Agrees: classical vastu and Jyotish give Mercury the north.

hindi: घर के अंदर N4 N5 यह बुध का स्थान है। आप अपने ही घर के अंदर नॉर्थ में बोल सकते हैं।
says: Inside the house the zones N4 and N5 are Mercury's place, and you can do the speaking in the north of your own home. A vastu zone link: Mercury occupies N4 and N5 in the house's sector grid.
ambiguity: The N4/N5 zone numbering scheme is not defined in this slice; probably the north-sector divisions of the 16 or 32 zone vastu grid.
classical_check: Differs in detail: classical vastu uses 16 or 32 zones, and this numbering is not in classical texts; north for Mercury agrees.

hindi: अन्यथा आप अपने ही घर के किसी भी कोने में बैठ के अकेले एकांत में
says: Otherwise sit in any corner of the house in solitude. If the north is not available, any quiet corner will do. The sentence continues into the next slice with the reason.
ambiguity: Reason given at the start of the next slice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बुध अकेला बड़ा घबराया हुआ होता है। इसको साथ कोई चाहिए। लेकिन अकेला जिसने साध लिया मींस गुरु है
says: Mercury alone is very nervous and needs somebody with it, but one who has mastered being alone is a guru. This continues the earlier solitude test: untrained Mercury is anxious in solitude, mastery of it marks a teacher.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नहीं तो साथ में कृष्ण को बुला लो हे कृष्ण आओ बैठो आपको साक्षी करके मैं अपने आप को यह बोलता हूं
says: If you cannot be alone, invite Krishna to sit beside you and take him as witness before you speak to yourself. Calling a deity to keep company is the aid for those who find solitude hard.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आज से मैंने अपने को क्षमा किया उसको क्षमा किया मुझे शांति प्रदान करूं मैंने खुद को शांति प्रदान करी
says: The declaration to say is that from today you have forgiven yourself and forgiven the other person and have granted yourself peace. A forgiveness affirmation is the content of the self-whisper.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मैंने किसी और से नहीं कराई मैंने रामकृष्ण को नहीं बोला है मैंने खुद को बोला है तो यह आपके कान में ध्वनि गई है
says: The peace was not given by someone else and was not requested of Ram or Krishna; you addressed it to yourself, and so the sound has entered your own ear. The ear-sound of your own voice is what acts.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह कान पवित्र होते हैं कभी कभी पवित्र नहीं होते। इसलिए ब्राह्मण अपना जनेऊ उठा के यहां टांग देते हैं कि जनेऊ ऊपर उठ गया। आपको मल मूत्र त्यागते हुए नीचे टच नहीं होगा तो शुद्धता रहनी चाहिए।
says: Ears are pure but at times they are not, which is why Brahmins hang the sacred thread over the ear so it stays raised and does not touch below during excretion; purity must be kept. The thread-on-ear custom keeps the ear's purity.
classical_check: The custom is real in dharmashastra (thread on right ear while relieving oneself); his link to Mercury is his own.

hindi: तो कान जनेऊ शुक्र होता है। नग्न होकर के संभोग नहीं करना चाहिए। ब्राह्मणों ने ये चीज अपने साथ रखी है। इसलिए जनेऊ डाल करके रखते हैं ताकि आने वाली संतान में शुक्र का समावेश रहे।
says: Ear, thread and shukra go together: one should not have intercourse naked, and Brahmins keep the thread on so that the coming child has shukra, the vital seed, in it. A conduct rule linking the thread to progeny; shukra here means the seed and Venus together.
ambiguity: 'शुक्र' may mean semen or Venus; he uses both senses together.
classical_check: Silent on this; a customary rule, not a chart rule.

hindi: शुक्र अकेला ग्रह है जो मृत संजीवनी लेकर बैठा है। आपकी बीमारी को भी सेट करता है।
says: Venus is the only planet that sits holding the mrit-sanjivani, the life-restoring knowledge, and it can also set your illness right. Venus is credited with healing and revival. Recorded as his claim, not as a medical statement.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic story that Shukracharya holds the Mrit-Sanjivani vidya.

hindi: शुक्र के पास हृदय है। हम शुक्र की क्लास में बात करेंगे इस बारे में।
says: Venus holds the heart, and he will take this up in the Venus class. He gives the heart to Venus as a body-part karaka and defers the detail. A health-organ claim, recorded as his, not medical.
classical_check: Differs: classical karaka of the heart is the Sun; Venus rules kidneys, reproductive organs and sometimes the heart in the sense of love.

hindi: आपका बुध आकाश है। आपके अंदर दी गई कोई भी कमांड इससे सेट होगी। यही कमांड का देवता है।
says: Your Mercury is the space element; any command given inside you gets set through it, and it is the deity of command. Mercury is the planet through which every instruction to oneself is installed.
classical_check: Differs on the element: classical Mercury is earth; the command idea is his own.

hindi: इसलिए बुध सबसे ज्यादा इंपॉर्टेंट है। यह इतना शक्तिशाली है।
says: For this reason Mercury is the most important planet and is extremely powerful. He ranks Mercury above the others because it installs commands for all other planets.
ambiguity: A ranking claim; no classical text puts Mercury first.
classical_check: Differs: classics rank the Sun and Moon as luminaries first and Jupiter as the greatest benefic.

hindi: चट्टान के जैसी ताकत वाले दांत है। दांत बेसिकली नपुंसक है। दांतों को पता ही कुछ नहीं।
says: Teeth have rock-like strength but are basically neuter and know nothing. He ties teeth to Mercury's neuter, mindless side: hard but without awareness.
ambiguity: Link to Mercury is implied by the earlier line that teeth belong to Mercury.
classical_check: Differs: classics give teeth to the Sun, Venus or the 2nd house; Mercury as neuter graha is agreed.

hindi: तो सर इसीलिए ऐसा होता है बच्चा पैदा होता है। उसको शहद चेताया जाता है। ऐसा कहा जाता है कि जिसने चिताया वो वैसा बनेगा।
says: Custom: a newborn is given honey on the tongue, and it is said the child becomes like the person who feeds it. He explains the honey custom as the first command put into the baby's space element. The first sentence may be a listener's prompt.
ambiguity: Speaker unclear: the opening 'sir, that is why' may be an audience member; 'चेताया/चिताया' is the caption's spelling of 'chatāyā' (made to lick).
classical_check: The honey-on-tongue ritual (jatakarma, medha janana) is classical; the Mercury reading is his.

gist: Brief exchange: yes, that is the reason; yes.

hindi: उसके स्पेस एलिमेंट में सबसे पहले यहां पर वो चीज डाल दी जाती है।
says: The very first substance put into the baby's space element, the mouth, is placed there at birth, and that first input shapes the child. The mouth and ear are the first openings through which something is installed in a new life.
ambiguity: 'यहां पर' is a gesture; read as the mouth.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब शहद का बड़ी महिमा है। मंगल ग्रह है यह।
says: Honey has great glory, and it is Mars. He assigns honey to Mars as a karaka.
classical_check: Not in the standard classical lists, where honey is usually Sun, Jupiter or Venus; this is his own assignment.

hindi: बुध मंगल के साथ जब आ जाता है तो बड़ी पराक्रम की बात करता है। उसकी बात में भयंकर वजन होता है। लीडरशिप बन जाती है। और वो कमांडिंग अथॉरिटेटिव पोजीशन पे आता है।
says: When Mercury joins Mars the person speaks of valour, the words carry enormous weight, leadership forms and he reaches a commanding, authoritative position. Mercury plus Mars gives weighty, commanding speech.
cells_derived_method: The house where the two sit sets the arena of command: 3rd for courage and writing, 10th for public authority, 7th for partners and clients; the sign adds tone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury with Mars in Scorpio in the 3rd house (lagna Virgo) would give forceful, intense writing and speech and an initiative-driven career.
Derived: Mercury with Mars in Aries in the 10th house (lagna Cancer) would give authority and bold command in public work.
Derived: Mercury with Mars in Aries in the 7th house (lagna Libra) would give a dominating voice in partnerships and negotiations.

ambiguity: Conjunction is implied by 'साथ'; aspect is not excluded.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars with Mercury gives sharp, bold speech; leadership is his emphasis, and classics also warn of harshness.

gist: Remark that everyone wants a person in a good commanding position in the family.

hindi: बुद्ध के पास सारा कागज है। कोरा कागज बुध होता है।
says: All paper belongs to Mercury, and blank paper in particular is Mercury. Paper is assigned to Mercury as karaka, with the blank sheet as its purest form.
classical_check: Partly agrees: writing, books and paper are Mercury in standard lists.

hindi: आप कागज को बच्चे को देंगे। वो सुंदर-सुंदर लिखाई कर रहा है कि खचड़ू पचू कर रहा है। अभी तक बुध वैसा है उसका। इतनी चेकिंग है। सिंपल।
says: Give a child a sheet of paper: if he writes neatly his Mercury is in good shape, and if he scribbles randomly his Mercury is still that way. Handwriting on blank paper is a simple checking method for Mercury.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next slice.
classical_check: Silent; his own test.

hindi: ये पेन जो है बुध है। सारी स्टेशनरी बुध है।
says: The pen is Mercury and all stationery is Mercury. Writing tools and stationery are listed under Mercury.
classical_check: Agrees: writing instruments are Mercury.

hindi: नपुंसक लोग बुध है। सारे हिजड़े बुध हैं।
says: Neuter people, meaning eunuchs and the hijra community, are all Mercury. Mercury is given as karaka of the third gender, in line with its classical neuter nature.
ambiguity: Uses blunt, dated words; meaning is the third-gender community and impotent persons.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts call Mercury napumsak and assign it eunuchs.

hindi: हिजड़ों का सम्मान करें। क्यों करें? ताकि बुध का सम्मान हो।
says: Respect the hijra community, so that Mercury is honoured. A remedy: showing respect to the third-gender community pleases Mercury.
classical_check: Folk remedy widely found in Mercury remedies; not in the old texts.

hindi: यह शुक्र में दोष नहीं देता। जब पति पत्नी शुक्र संभोग की क्रिया में प्रेम में है, रोमांस में है, खाने पीने में, बढ़िया-बढ़िया महंगे पर्स खरीद रहे हैं। भोजन कर रहे हैं तो लड़ाई कब होती है? गबड़ गबड़ गबड़ गबड़।
says: This does not harm Venus. When husband and wife are in Venus mode, in lovemaking, romance, eating and shopping for nice things, the quarrel only comes when the talking starts, the 'gabad gabad' babble. Fights come through Mercury's talk, not Venus's pleasures.
ambiguity: Garbled: what 'this' refers to is unclear, and the answer to when fights occur is only the sound 'gabad gabad'. Reading is inferred.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए हिजड़ों की सेवा मात्र से क्या होगा? बुद्ध, शांत, प्रसन्न। इसलिए उनको क्या दिया जाता है? पैसा। हरी-हरी चीजें।
says: Merely serving them makes Mercury calm and pleased, and so the customary gift to them is money and green things. Charity to the hijra community, in cash and green items, is the Mercury remedy.
classical_check: Agrees with the popular Mercury remedy of giving green items and money to eunuchs.

hindi: आपका सबसे अच्छी चेकिंग क्या है? पालक ले लो। गाय को खिला के देखो। देखो गाय मुंह फेर लेगी। आपकी बुध डिस्टर्बड है। ओरा खराब है।
says: Best check: take spinach and offer it to a cow; if the cow turns her face away your Mercury is disturbed and your aura is bad. A folk diagnostic test for Mercury trouble.
ambiguity: The sentence 'you feed green things, your aura is disturbed' just before it is only a lead-in.
classical_check: Silent; a folk test, unmeasured.

hindi: औररा जी रीजनरेट करो। नमक से नजर उतार के करो। दान करके आओ अपने हाथ से।
says: Regenerate the aura by removing the evil eye with salt and go and donate with your own hand. Two steps: salt nazar-removal and personal donation.
classical_check: Salt nazar-removal is a folk practice, not in classics.

hindi: हरे रंग की मूंग साबुत दाल यह बुध है। हरा कागज का नोट बुध है।
says: Whole green moong dal is Mercury and a green paper note is Mercury. Two items to donate for Mercury, linked by colour.
classical_check: Agrees: green moong is the classical grain for Mercury.

hindi: यदि कुंडली अलव करती है हरा कागज का नोट देकर आओ।
says: If the horoscope permits, go and give a green paper note. Donation of a green note is conditioned on the chart allowing it.
ambiguity: 'अलव करती है' is read as allows; he does not say what in the chart decides it.
classical_check: Silent on the condition.

hindi: नहीं तो हरे नोट कोई भी कागज नोट हरा जरूरी नहीं पीला नीला गुलाबी कोई भी दे दो। वो भी आप दान कर सकते हैं। आपको छोड़ना है।
says: Otherwise any paper note will do, it need not be green, yellow, blue or pink are fine; the point is that you let it go. Letting go matters more than the colour.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गुप्त दान शब्द ऐसा बनाया गया है जिसमें यदि आप किसको दान दे रहे? कहां जाएगा किसको दिया नहीं गया पता ही नहीं वो गुप्त दान आपका अभी सब अलाउड है कोई भी कुंडली में कहीं भी कोई ग्रह बैठा
says: Secret donation means you do not know who receives it or where it goes; this kind is allowed for everyone, whichever planet sits wherever in the chart. Anonymous giving is safe in any horoscope.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical praise of gupta-daan.

gist: Mocking example of a fan costing 1,21,500 rupees with names of grandfather, great-grandfather and grandmother written on each blade, and a stone on the stairs with a deceased person's name.

hindi: गुप्तदान कहां है? ये बुध कहां है? ये तो शोष है टशन है।
says: Where is the secret donation, where is Mercury in that? A donation with names displayed is only show and swagger. Named, advertised giving is not a Mercury remedy.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical rule that charity done for show loses its merit.

hindi: शनि इन्वॉल्व कर दिया आपने। टशन मार दी बीच रास्ते में। आपके तोते उड़ा देगा वो। कौन बखान करता फिरता है।
says: By showing off you have involved Saturn; swagger on the road will make him scare you out of your wits. Who goes around advertising? Ostentatious giving brings Saturn's punishment.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn as the punisher of pride fits popular tradition.

hindi: बुध गुप्त रखवाता है सारी चीजें। चोरी कराता है। झूठ बुलवाता है।
says: Mercury makes you keep everything secret, makes you steal and makes you lie. Secrecy, theft and falsehood are Mercury's shadow side.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the classical karaka of thieves, deceit and secrecy when afflicted.

hindi: लोग थूकते हैं। थू ये बुध का दोष है।
says: People spit, saying 'thu'; this is Mercury's fault. Spitting out of disgust is counted as a Mercury dosha of the mouth and speech.
ambiguity: The slice break splits the sentence; the sense is that spitting reflects Mercury's affliction.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A listener remarks that gurudwaras often donate whole green moong and brooms, and salt bags.

hindi: नमक सूर्य हो गया। झाड़ू केतु हो गई। जो मूंग दाल है वो बुध हो गया। ये सब अपने ग्रही सेट कर रहे हैं।
says: Salt is the Sun, the broom is Ketu and moong dal is Mercury, and by donating these the people are setting their own planets. Three donation items are mapped to three planets, so gurudwara giving works as planet remedies.
classical_check: Differs for salt and broom: classically salt goes to Saturn or Venus and the broom is not a standard Ketu item; moong for Mercury agrees.

hindi: अब ये किसको जा रहा है पता नहीं। कौन खा रहा है? और किसने लिया उसे देने वाले का पता नहीं। इसलिए दोष नहीं है। क्योंकि भाई एहसान नहीं है ना।
says: The giver does not know who receives it or who eats it, and the receiver does not know the giver, so there is no dosha, because no favour is being done. Anonymous giving carries no obligation and hence no fault.
classical_check: Agrees with the principle that obligation-free anonymous charity is faultless.

gist: People say a note was found lying somewhere and ask whose it is; a sarcastic remark that merit went off to fetch oil and we simply got it.

hindi: बुध सेट है आपका। नहीं तो आप इफ एंड बट में फंसे हुए। क्या सही है? क्या गलत है? क्या पाप
says: If your Mercury is set you do not worry; otherwise you are stuck in ifs and buts over what is right, what is wrong and what is sin. A settled Mercury frees you from moral dithering.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: द्वैत से अद्वैत की ओर उठने की यात्रा कुंडलिनी है। और यह आपका आखिरी इलाका है। जहां पर आपका पांचवा एलिमेंट पंचभूत तत्व है।
says: Kundalini is the journey from duality to non-duality, and the throat is the last region of it, where the fifth of the five elements, space, sits. The throat is the final station before the non-dual.
ambiguity: 'यह' points to the throat by gesture.
classical_check: Agrees with the tantric account: the throat chakra is the ether chakra.

hindi: उसके पश्चात यहां से आगे सिंगुलरिटी आएगी। सिंगुलरिटी है। जहां से बिग बैंग हुआ है। 4.5 बिलियन इयर्स एगो और फूट करके पूरा ब्रह्मांड बना है।
says: Beyond that point lies the singularity, from which the Big Bang came, bursting out 4.5 billion years ago to form the whole universe. The figure is wrong: the universe is about 13.8 billion years old and 4.5 billion is the age of the Earth.
ambiguity: Mixes cosmology numbers.
classical_check: Silent; cosmology claim, with an incorrect number.

hindi: ब्रह्मा की परिवर्तन होता है 3.01 ट्रिलियन इयर्स में। फिर पुनः सिंगुलैरिटी आती है।
says: Brahma's cycle changes in about 3.01 trillion years, after which the singularity returns. The cycle of creation and dissolution is said to be repeated. The number looks garbled from the classical 311 trillion years of Brahma's life.
ambiguity: Figure 3.01 trillion is probably a garble of 311.04 trillion years.
classical_check: Differs: Puranic Brahma's lifespan is 311.04 trillion human years.

hindi: ये जो दो कहानियां गोल-गोल घूमती है इदा पिंगला ये आकर के यहां खत्म थर्ड आई पे जब तीसरा नेत्र खुल गया तो आपने डिसीजन सही लिया और बक दिया।
says: The two currents spiralling up, Ida and Pingala, end at the third eye; when the third eye opens you take the right decision and speak it out. The two nadis meet at the brow and clarity of decision and speech follows.
ambiguity: Caption 'दो कहानियां' read as two channels (nadis).
classical_check: Agrees with the yogic account that Ida and Pingala meet at the ajna chakra.

hindi: आपको बोलना आना चाहिए जो आपके मन के अंदर है। इसलिए हम बकवास कहते हैं। अगर आप बकवास कर सकते हैं आपका बॉडी माइंड सिंक है।
says: You must be able to say what is in your mind, which is why he calls it bakwaas, free talk; if you can talk freely your body and mind are in sync. The ability to speak out is the sign of body-mind synchrony.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके अंदर तो गाना चल रहा है लेकिन बॉडी आपने ऐसे तान रखी है। बॉडी माइंड सिंक टूट गया। लेकिन आपका मन है अपनी मर्जी से आप परिवर्तन कर सकते हैं।
says: A song is playing inside you but you hold the body stiff, so the body-mind sync breaks; still, the mind is yours and you can change it at will. Stiffness against your own inner mood breaks sync, and the mind can be changed by choice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो आपके जीवन के अंदर सेटिंग हो गई। यह आपकी छोटी उंगली है बुध की।
says: Then the setting in your life is done; the little finger is Mercury's finger. He assigns the little finger to Mercury, as in palmistry.
classical_check: Agrees with palmistry: the little finger is the Mercury finger.

hindi: ये उंगली इससे जोड़ी। क्या ये तीनों सीधे हैं? अब बुध सेट है। ये उंगली यूं भागती है। ये उंगली यूं भागेगी। ये सीधी नहीं कर पाओगे। बहुत कम लोग हैं रेयर लोग हैं जो
says: Finger test: join the little finger with its neighbour and check whether the other three stay straight; Mercury is set only if it does. The little finger runs away and you cannot straighten it, and very few rare people can. The ability to keep the little finger steady is a physical test of Mercury being set.
ambiguity: Hand gestures are not in the caption; exact finger pairing is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; not from classical palmistry.

hindi: सीधी कर पाए। यानी उनको पता है क्या बोलना है कब बोलना है।
says: Those who can keep it straight know what to say and when to say it. Control of the little finger is read as the sense of right speech and timing.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये होने नहीं देगा। देखो भाग रही है। आगे भाग गई। ये जोड़नी नहीं है खोलनी है। हां जोड़ के तो सारे कर लेंगे। ये खोल के जिसने कर लिया उसकी बुद्धि।
says: The finger will not allow it and runs ahead; the drill is not to join the fingers but to open them, since everyone can manage it joined, and whoever manages it open has the intellect. Doing the finger exercise with fingers apart is the real test.
ambiguity: Visual drill; details lost in the caption.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Fragmented finger-drill instructions about making a circle and straightening, with an unclear remark that all are gods.

hindi: ये उंगली मुड़ी रहेगी। मुड़ी और फिर ये सीधे जाएंगे तीनों। ये तीन सीधे कठिन है।
says: Variation: keep the little finger bent while the other three go straight, which is hard. A second finger-independence test for Mercury control.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन ये उंगली यूं भागती है आगे। ये बुध सूर्य सूर्य इसको साथ बुद्धि क्या स्वतंत्र है।
says: The little finger still runs ahead; Mercury and the Sun, the neighbouring ring finger, go together, and he asks whether the intellect is independent. A garbled remark linking Mercury and the Sun through the fingers and asking about the intellect's independence.
ambiguity: Caption is broken; reading is inferred from the palmistry link of the ring finger to the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees that the ring finger is the Sun's; the conclusion is unclear.

hindi: आपके जीवन में स्विच ऑन स्विच ऑफ की कला आप जानते हैं। अभी के अभी आप रो लेंगे और अभी आप हंस लेंगे। एक फोन पर दुख की बात के लेकर के फिर पुनः काम पर आएंगे। यह आपका बुध काबू है। सेट है।
says: If you know the art of switching on and off, crying now and laughing the next moment, or taking sad news on a phone call and then returning to work, your Mercury is under control and set. Emotional agility is the behavioural proof of a mastered Mercury.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और ये बुध अगर काबू है आपके पास हरे-हरे नोट आते रहेंगे। वाणी आती रहेगी।
says: If Mercury is under control, green notes will keep coming to you and speech will keep flowing. A controlled Mercury brings money and eloquence. Recorded as his claim; it is not investment advice.
classical_check: Agrees in general: a strong Mercury supports trade income and eloquence.

hindi: व्यापार आता रहेगा। कार्य होता रहेगा। आप उड़ रहे हैं।
says: With Mercury in control, business keeps coming, work keeps getting done and you feel as if you are flying. The sentence completes the earlier claim that a settled Mercury brings steady trade and a buoyant state.
ambiguity: Continues the previous slice's 'green notes keep coming'.
classical_check: Agrees in general that a strong Mercury supports trade; the 'flying' wording is his.

hindi: सूझ नहीं रहा क्या करें? राहु ने गजब तरीके से बुध की बैंड बजा रखी है। इसलिए बृहस्पति चाहिए।
says: If nothing occurs to you and you do not know what to do, Rahu has wrecked Mercury in a big way, and therefore Jupiter is needed. Rahu's affliction of Mercury produces mental blankness, and Jupiter is the corrective.
ambiguity: The form of the Rahu-Mercury link (conjunction or aspect) is not stated.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu with Mercury confuses the intellect and Jupiter's influence helps; the exact phrasing is his.

hindi: पैसे का धोखा, गारंटी का धोखा, जेल जाने की कहानी, कोर्ट कचहरी लिख लिख के जो गलत बयानबाजियां कर रखी है सब बुध की है।
says: Money fraud, guarantee fraud, stories of going to jail, court cases and false statements written down are all Mercury's doing. Fraud, legal trouble and false documentation are listed as afflicted-Mercury matters.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical link of afflicted Mercury to forgery, fraud and false writing.

hindi: हम यहां इरिस्पेक्टिव लेके चल रहे हैं कि ये कुंडली 1/2 है या 1/2/3 12 / 1/2 इस प्रकार का पॉइंट छोड़ के ले रहे हैं जो मास्टर कुंडली है।
says: Here he proceeds irrespective of whether the chart is split across two signs or across three, such as 1/2, 1/2/3 or 12/1/2, and takes the master chart, meaning the main sign. For the remedy discussion he sets aside the multi-sign overlap and uses only the dominant sign of each house.
ambiguity: The notation 1/2 means a house touched by signs 1 and 2; it is a shorthand for multi-sign houses, which he deliberately ignores here.
classical_check: Silent; he is simplifying his own multi-sign house scheme for remedies, which conflicts with the project rule that each house be read by all its signs.

hindi: हर उपाय जितने भी होंगे वो मेजर इस कुंडली से ही चलेंगे। भले 29 डिग्री का लग्न है चाहे 0° का लग्न है 0.1 का जो मेजरली यहां नंबर आ गया उसी नंबर के अनुसार उपाय होंगे।
says: All remedies will run from the major chart only: whether the lagna sits at 29 degrees or at 0 degrees, the number that comes up as the major one decides the remedy. Remedy choice follows the main sign, regardless of how near a boundary the lagna falls.
ambiguity: '0.1' is unclear, probably a fraction of a degree near the start of a sign.
classical_check: Differs from careful classical practice, where a lagna at 29 or 0 degrees is treated as a sensitive sandhi point needing checks.

hindi: तो कुंडली में तीन नंबर और छह नंबर बुध की बिलोंगिंगनेस के दो ग्रह घर ये है राशियां यहां है।
says: In the chart, numbers 3 and 6 are the two places that belong to Mercury, the two signs where it is at home. He is restating that Gemini and Virgo are Mercury's before giving the houses where it should not sit.
ambiguity: 'ग्रह घर' may mean sign or house; context shows signs, since he says 'राशियां'.
classical_check: Agrees with classical rulership of Gemini and Virgo.

hindi: छह आठ 12 यहां बुध नहीं होना चाहिए। यहां बुध रहेगा तो शत्रु।
