says: Mercury should not be in the 6th, 8th or 12th; if it sits there, enemies result. Mercury in the three dusthana houses is read as enemy-producing.
cells_derived_method: The sign on each dusthana changes how the enemy-making appears: own sign softens it into skilful arguing, a Jupiter sign shifts it toward confusion, and the house topic (disease and debt, hidden danger, loss) sets the area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 6th (lagna Aries), in its own sign, would show as sharp argumentative skill, with rivals easily made but also outmatched.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 8th (lagna Scorpio) would show as secrecy, gossip and hidden quarrels with in-laws or partners' families.
Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 12th (lagna Libra) would show as foreign or hidden-enemy trouble, with disputes spent in loss and isolation.

ambiguity: 6, 8, 12 are taken as houses; the sentence could also be read as sign numbers, but later talk of the 6th house supports houses.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury in dusthanas is weakened classically, but results depend on lordship and sign; he states it flatly.

hindi: शत्रु बनाने में उस्ताद रहेगा ऐसा आदमी। लड़ता रहेगा, बहस करता रहेगा, भय-भय करता रहेगा। बहुत ही क्लेश मचाएगा। इसलिए शत्रु कारक है बुध।
says: Such a man will be expert at making enemies, will keep fighting and arguing and create a great deal of strife; hence Mercury is an enemy-karaka. He describes the personality that comes from Mercury in the dusthanas and names Mercury as significator of enemies.
classical_check: Differs: the classical karaka of enemies is Mars (and Saturn); Mercury as enemy-karaka is his scheme.

hindi: शादी ब्याह के अंदर हम यह विशेष तौर पर देखते हैं कि लड़का और लड़की में से छठे घर में बुध तो नहीं है। अगर वो खिसक कर भी यहां आ गया है तो भी कहते हैं शादी मत ही करना।
says: In marriage matching he specially checks whether either the boy or the girl has Mercury in the 6th house; even if Mercury has only shifted into the 6th (as in a bhava chalit chart), he says do not marry. A Mercury-in-6th match check that counts the shifted position too.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 6th decides how the sharpness appears; the shifted position means the planet counts if the bhava chalit puts it in the 6th even if the rashi chart does not.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 6th (lagna Capricorn) would give a quick-tongued, cutting partner, a partner who argues cleverly.
Derived: Mercury in Scorpio in the 6th (lagna Gemini) would be Mercury in a Mars sign, giving harsh, stinging speech and suspicion in the partner.

ambiguity: 'खिसक कर' read as shifting across a house boundary in a bhava chart.
classical_check: Silent: classical matching uses ashtakoota and Mars/dosha checks, not Mercury in the 6th.

hindi: बहुत गुस्से वाला या गुस्से वाली लड़की मिलेगी भैया। जबान तेज होगी।
says: You will get a very angry boy or girl as spouse, and the tongue will be sharp. The consequence he gives for Mercury in the 6th in a match is a short-tempered spouse with harsh speech. Advice to avoid the marriage is his tradition claim.
classical_check: Silent as a rule.

hindi: 12वा बुध सर एक जैसे न्यूमोलॉजी में भी होता है तीन और छह का आपस में 36 का होता है।
says: The 12th-house Mercury is the same story in numerology too, and numbers 3 and 6 are in a 36 relationship with each other, meaning mutual hostility. He says numbers 3 and 6, Mercury's pair, are enemies of each other in numerology. The first words may be a listener's remark.
ambiguity: Speaker unclear; '36 का होना' is the Hindi idiom for being at odds, not a calculation.
classical_check: Silent: numerology is not part of classical Jyotish.

gist: Asks where you are putting numerology; says it would take a full class but he will give a brief note.

hindi: जिस व्यक्ति का लग्न एक नंबर है उसके लिए छह नंबर महाशुभ है।
says: For a person whose lagna is number 1, number 6 is highly auspicious. This is said in the numerology aside, so it may mean number 6 as a friendly number for 1 or sign 6 for an Aries lagna.
ambiguity: Could mean numerology number 6, sign 6 (Virgo) or 6th house for an Aries lagna; it also sits oddly beside his rule that Mercury in the 6th is bad.
classical_check: Silent in classics; in numerology 1 and 6 are indeed commonly seen as compatible.

hindi: अशुभ और न्यूमरोलॉजी में एक तीन पांच और छह ये कहते हैं बस ये अच्छे ही हैं। सात गंदा चार गंदा ऐसा कुछ नहीं है। बकवास है।
says: In numerology the numbers 1, 3, 5 and 6 are said to be good, and calling 7 or 4 dirty is nonsense. He rejects the popular bad-number labels while keeping a short list of good numbers.
ambiguity: The caption word 'अशुभ' at the start is a stray.
classical_check: Silent; numerology is outside the classical texts.

hindi: हो सकता है आपका जो नंबर गंदा बता रखा है वही सबसे अच्छा आठ नंबर चेंजिंग है। आठ नंबर बढ़िया जगह बैठा होगा कुंडली में आपके लिए। ये केस स्पेसिफिक है।
says: The number someone has called bad for you may be your best; number 8 is the changing one and may sit in an excellent place in your chart, since it is case specific. A number's value depends on its placement, not on a fixed label.
ambiguity: Whether '8' means the number, the 8th house or Saturn is not clear.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit that placement decides results; numerology link is his.

hindi: ऐसे तो हमने नौ नंबर लिए। नौ किस्म की धरती पे लोग बना दिए। सारे अलग-अलग है। ऐसे थोड़ी होता है।
says: If we took just nine numbers, we would have made nine types of people on earth, but everyone is different and it does not work that way. He rejects nine-fold numerology as too coarse to classify people.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: छह नंबर राशि जो है यह शत्रु के पास पहुंच गई है। बुध यहां पर बैठ गया।
says: Sign number 6 has landed in the enemy's place, and Mercury has sat there. He reads Mercury placed where the 6th house, the enemy house, is as dangerous. 'Sign 6' and the 6th house are used together here.
ambiguity: Mixes sign 6 (Virgo) and house 6; the enemy sense belongs to the 6th house.
classical_check: Agrees that the 6th house is the house of enemies.

hindi: महाशत्रु कारक अगर बुध यहां से यहां ट्रांजिट कर गया। यहां से यहां ट्रांजिट या यहां भी बैठा है तो भी आप लड़ा के रहोगे।
says: As a great enemy-maker, if Mercury transits through those places, or even just sits there, you will end up fighting. Both natal placement and transit of Mercury through the enemy house are read as bringing quarrels.
ambiguity: 'यहां से यहां' is gesture only; the span of houses for the transit is not given.
classical_check: Silent: classical gochar for Mercury counts the 6th as favourable from the Moon, so this differs.

hindi: कोई लड़की 12वां बुध है। 12वां बुध किसी भी राशि का है। उसको संतान ही नहीं होने देगा।
says: For a girl with the 12th Mercury, in any sign, it will not let her have children at all. A strong progeny claim about Mercury in the 12th house, recorded as his tradition claim and not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: The 12th house is touched by 2 or more signs; he says the claim holds for any sign, so the sign does not soften it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 12th (lagna Libra) would, by his rule, carry the same progeny trouble despite being in its own sign.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 12th (lagna Cancer), own sign again, would be read the same way under his 'any sign' rule.

ambiguity: Whether the same applies to boys is not said.
classical_check: Differs: classics do not give Mercury in the 12th such a flat result; the 5th house and Jupiter are the progeny indicators.

hindi: सेक्स लाइफ डिस्टर्ब करेगा। बाहर भटकाएगा। छठे से लिंक करेगा।
says: It will disturb the sex life, will make the person stray outside the relationship, and will link to the 6th. Mercury in the 12th is also credited with marital-intimacy trouble and wandering, connected to the 6th house. Tradition claim.
ambiguity: 'छठे से लिंक' is unclear: could mean a link through the 6th house, or to the 6th-house Mercury problem.
classical_check: Agrees in general that the 12th house governs bed pleasures; the straying claim is his.

hindi: यही कहानी तो यह बड़ी भारी समस्या पैदा कर देता है। इरिटेशन दे देता है। मानसिक तनाव दे देता है। बेड कंफर्ट डिस्टर्ब। यह बेड कंफर्ट्स है।
says: This creates a very heavy problem: irritation, mental tension and disturbed bed comforts, the 12th house being the house of bed comforts. Mercury in the 12th is a strain on mental peace and on comfort in bed.
classical_check: Agrees that the 12th is the house of bed pleasures (shayya sukha).

hindi: 12 नंबर का बुध हाइली नेगेटिव माना जाता है। 12 नंबर के बुध की हाइली नेगेटिविटी क्या है? वह यहां बैठ गया, यहां बैठ गया, यहां बैठ गया, तो गंदा है। अगर 12 नंबर का बुध कहीं और बैठ गया तो गंदा नहीं है।
says: Mercury of number 12, meaning in Pisces, is considered highly negative, but only if it sits in certain places, which he indicates by gesture; if it sits elsewhere it is not bad. The harm of Pisces Mercury depends on the house it occupies, apparently the dusthanas.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Pisces is debilitated and mixed with Ketu and Jupiter's sign; the bad houses are probably 6, 8 and 12 from his earlier rule, while Pisces in other houses is called not bad.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 6th (lagna Libra) would be a doubly bad placement under his reading, enemies plus confusion.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 8th (lagna Leo) would be a bad placement, hidden troubles with clouded judgement.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 10th (lagna Gemini) would, by his remark, not be bad, giving a dreamy but harmless career mind.

ambiguity: '12 नंबर का बुध' here means sign 12, while in the earlier lines it meant the 12th house; the gesture 'यहां' does not name the houses.
classical_check: Differs: Mercury in Pisces is classically debilitated in any house, though cancellation can occur; he says it is harmless except in some places.

hindi: क्योंकि बुध ने बृहस्पति के घर में जाके केतु का घर है। ये चंचलता छोड़ दी है। बुध का स्वभाव क्या खचर पचर नौटंकी चंचलता छोड़ दिए।
says: The reason is that Mercury went to Jupiter's house, which is also Ketu's house, and gave up its restlessness, its fidgeting and theatrics. In Pisces, Mercury loses its playful, talkative nature and turns still and withdrawn.
classical_check: Differs on Ketu as co-lord of Pisces; agrees that Mercury is out of its element in Pisces.

hindi: अब यही बुध यदि मान लेते हैं बुध तीन नंबर का है। तो यहां बैठा तीन नंबर का बुध तो बहुत अच्छा हो गया। अपने घर का है। ये नुकसान नहीं करेगा।
says: If instead Mercury is in sign 3, Gemini, sitting in its own house, it becomes very good and does no harm. Mercury in its own sign is the favourable counterpart to the Pisces case.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is strong in its own sign Gemini.

hindi: अपने घर का बैठा बुध जो है बहुत धन देगा। खर्चे कराएगा। जितना जब जो पैसा चाहिए जब कमाल करेगा। वाणी जो है बांध देगा।
says: Mercury seated in its own house will give a lot of wealth, make you spend, provide exactly the money needed when needed, and bind the speech, that is keep it controlled and effective. Own-sign Mercury brings money flow and command of words.
cells_derived_method: The money and speech result shows most where the house links to wealth or speech; the lagna decides which houses Mercury rules.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 2nd (lagna Taurus), ruling the 2nd and 5th, would strongly boost wealth and speech.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 11th (lagna Leo), ruling the 2nd and 11th, would give steady gains and a wide network.
Derived: Mercury in Gemini in the 1st (lagna Gemini), ruling the 1st and 4th, would give a strong self, a persuasive voice and domestic comfort.

ambiguity: Own house is taken as Gemini, since he said sign 3; Virgo is not mentioned in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees in general with own-sign strength; the wealth claim is his emphasis.

hindi: अब अगर यही चार नंबर का है, पांच का है, कोई और है तो राशि बदल गई। सारी कहानी कहीं की कहीं हो गई। ऐसी स्थिति में बुध के इंपैक्ट्स चेंज हो के डिस्टर्ब हो जाते हैं।
says: If Mercury is in sign 4, 5 or any other sign, the sign has changed and the whole story changes; Mercury's impact changes and gets disturbed. The sign it sits in decides the result, so one cannot read Mercury without its sign.
cells_derived_method: Mercury takes the temperament of the sign's lord: in Cancer a moody, emotional mind; in Leo a proud, ego-led mind; the house decides the arena.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra) would give a moody, sensitive public image and work involving care or home.
Derived: Mercury in Leo in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius) would give proud, authority-seeking opinions on dharma and teachers.

ambiguity: He says 'any other' sign; Cancer and Leo are the only two he names.
classical_check: Agrees: results of a planet change by the sign it occupies.

hindi: तो हमारा अलग-अलग राशि अलग-अलग ग्रह के अनुसार बुध का इफेक्ट आता क्या है? और ये मूव भी करते हैं ना। हां मूविंग का पॉइंट हम नहीं ले चल रहे हैं। अभी हमारे को दूसरे हिसाब से ही चलना है।
says: He asks what Mercury's effect is for each sign and for each other planet it is with, and admits the planets also move, but he is not taking transit movement into account now; the discussion proceeds in a different way. This sets the scope: Mercury by sign and by companion planet, static chart only.
ambiguity: The exact meaning of 'दूसरे हिसाब से' is not stated.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यूनिवर्सली अगर आपका बुध 12 नंबर का है। कहीं पर भी बैठा है तो आपको नाक के सेंटर में छेद करवाना है। हर लड़की को नाक छेदन जरूरी है। साइड में कर सकती है लड़की।
says: Universal remedy: if your Mercury is in sign 12 (Pisces), wherever it sits, get a hole made in the centre of the nose; every girl needs nose piercing, and a girl may do it on the side. A piercing remedy for Mercury in Pisces, stated as a tradition claim.
ambiguity: Here '12 नंबर' is sign 12 (Pisces), not the 12th house.
classical_check: Silent in classics; nose piercing is an ornamental custom, not a Mercury remedy.

hindi: इसलिए अफोर्डेबिलिटी की बात। लड़के आज नहीं कर सकते। पहले तो नाक छिदवाते थे पुराने समय। नाक को सेंटर से छिदवा लो।
says: It is a matter of what is socially affordable: boys cannot do it today, although in old times they did pierce the nose, so pierce the nose at the centre. He concedes the social barrier for men but keeps the centre piercing as the correct form.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह नाक का जोखरी कोना यह बुध है।
says: This corner of the nose, the septum point he is touching, is Mercury. The mid-nose spot is given to Mercury as the place to pierce.
ambiguity: 'जोखरी' is garbled; read as the septum or central nasal point.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब यह बुध क्या कर रहा है? चंचल हो गया है। चंचलता खो भी दी है।
says: What is this Mercury doing now? It has become restless and has also lost its restlessness. He describes the Pisces Mercury as both agitated and drained of its usual playfulness at once.
ambiguity: Self-contradictory wording; earlier he said Mercury gave up restlessness in Pisces.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर खराब जगह बैठा है तो नाश करेगा। अच्छी जगह बैठा है तो सुस्त आनंद हो जाएगा। बेरोजगार भी कर सकता है।
says: If it sits in a bad place it will destroy; if in a good place it becomes lazy and blissful, and it can even cause unemployment. Pisces Mercury is ruinous in bad houses and sluggish in good ones, either way risking idleness.
cells_derived_method: Good or bad place is the house; in kendras and trikonas the effect is lazy comfort and in dusthanas destructive.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 8th (lagna Leo) would be the destructive case, with losses through confusion.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 5th (lagna Scorpio) would be the comfortable case, with a dreamy, passive intellect and slow effort.

ambiguity: 'Good place' and 'bad place' are not defined; read as house type.
classical_check: Silent as phrased.

hindi: तो बुध के दोष के लिए इस नाक के हिस्से छेद को पीियर्स करा लो 100 घंटे के लिए। चार दिन 4 घंटे में 100 घंटे हो गए। चार दिन पूरे हैं। 96 घंटे भी कहा जाता है। हम 100 लेके चल रहे हैं कि कन्फ्यूजन और एरर आउट।
says: For Mercury's dosha, have this nose spot pierced for 100 hours, which is about four days and four hours; some say 96 hours but he uses 100 to avoid confusion. A time-bound piercing remedy with a stated duration.
ambiguity: Whether this is only for Pisces or any Mercury dosha is not clear; context ties it to sign 12.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical remedy.

hindi: सेंटर से छिदवाओ। कील डाल दो इसमें चांदी की। बाद में चार दिन बाद निकाल लो। डॉक्टर के पास जाओ। सर्जिकल थ्रेड डलवा लो। सर्जिकल थ्रेड से बंद।
says: Get it pierced at the centre, put a silver stud in it, remove it after four days, go to a doctor and have a surgical thread placed to keep the hole closed. A procedure for the 100-hour piercing; he sends it to a doctor, so the medical part is not his advice.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर यही बुध नौ नंबर का भी है तो यह भी बृहस्पति की राशि है। यह भी उसी की लोन दी हुई केतु की राशि है। तो भी नाक जरूर छिदवाओ। यह यूनिवर्सल कर दो।
says: If Mercury is in sign 9 as well, that too is Jupiter's sign and the one lent to Ketu, so pierce the nose then as well and make it universal. Mercury in Sagittarius is brought under the same piercing remedy.
ambiguity: He calls sign 9 'Ketu's lent sign', but earlier he gave Ketu a share of sign 12; possible slip between 9 and 12.
classical_check: Differs: classics do not give Ketu a share of Sagittarius; he contradicts his own earlier line placing Ketu in Pisces.

hindi: 100 घंटे के लिए तो नाक छिदवानी है। अन्यथा परमानेंट।
says: The nose is to be pierced for 100 hours, or else permanently. Two options are given for the piercing remedy: a temporary 100-hour one or a permanent one.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर आप भीख नहीं मांग रहे हैं। आप भीख नहीं मांगते। मान सम्मान में किसी की कमी नहीं छोड़ते हैं तो बुध आपका वैसे भी ठीक है।
says: If you do not beg and you leave no shortfall in giving respect, your Mercury is fine anyway. Self-respect and courtesy make the remedy unnecessary.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: फालतू में जमीन पे थूकते नहीं है। अटक अटक के बात नहीं करते। फालतू में बीच में नहीं बोलते तो बुध इंप्रूव है।
says: If you do not spit on the ground for no reason, do not stammer in speech and do not interrupt needlessly, Mercury is improved. A short do-and-don't list for Mercury: no spitting, no stuttering, no cutting into others' talk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बुध मौन से बहुत सुखी होता है। बहुत बेहतर।
says: Mercury is made very happy by silence, which is much better for it. Keeping quiet is offered as a Mercury pacifier.
classical_check: Silent; a folk remedy.

gist: Says for anyone who talks too much, make him compete with me; he has nothing on me.

hindi: बुध जो ग्रह है वह मरकरी है। एम ई आर सी यू आर वाई मर्यूरियस रोमन देवता है जिसके नाम पर मरकरी रखा गया।
says: The planet Budh is Mercury, spelled M-E-R-C-U-R-Y, named after the Roman god Mercurius. He links the Indian planet to the Western name and its Roman god.
classical_check: Agrees: the planet is named after the Roman messenger god Mercury.

hindi: मरकरी आजकल थर्मामीटर में पहले होता था। अब नहीं रहा। इसका इतना लो मेल्टिंग पॉइंट है कि रूम टेंपरेचर में भी पानी की तरह होता है। मेटल है ये।
says: Mercury, the metal, used to be in thermometers though mostly not now, and its melting point is so low that it is liquid like water at room temperature. He gives the metal as Mercury's substance and notes its liquid, restless nature.
classical_check: Agrees that quicksilver (parad) is the metal of Mercury in some traditions; the physics is correct.

hindi: लेकिन इतनी ज़हरीली मेटल है। स्किन से टच हो के बॉडी के अंदर चली गई। टॉक्सिक हो जाएगा। तो आपने बुध बुध मरकरी है। ये मरकरी आपकी बॉडी के अंदर चला गया।
says: Yet it is a highly poisonous metal: if it touches the skin and gets inside the body it becomes toxic. He treats mercury entering the body as the physical picture of Mercury turning harmful. The toxicity point is a general health fact, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent; mercury toxicity is a modern medical fact.

hindi: सबसे ज्यादा अटैक कहां करता है? आपके नर्वस सिस्टम पे और आपकी किडनी। किडनी में क्या है? पानी। नर्वस सिस्टम खोपड़ी क्या है? पानी। चंद्रमा को खा जाता है।
says: It attacks the nervous system and the kidneys most, and both are made of water, so it eats the Moon. The poisoning is used as an analogy for Mercury consuming the Moon's watery domain. Health content is his analogy, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Whether the Moon-eating is a rule for a chart or only an analogy is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; the Moon rules water and fluids in classics, Mercury the nerves.

hindi: तो बुध जो है ये स्त्री ग्रह है। स्त्री नपुंसक है। इसलिए बुध कौन है? बहू। चंद्रमा कौन है? सास।
says: Mercury is a feminine planet, neuter in nature, and so it is the daughter-in-law, while the Moon is the mother-in-law. He gives Mercury and the Moon the household roles of bahu and saas.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mercury is neuter (some say eunuch) and the Moon is the mother; daughter-in-law is not a standard Mercury relation.

hindi: इसलिए सास बहू की बनती नहीं। जिस कुंडली में चंद्रमा और बुध साथ हो गए। सास बहू की बनेगी नहीं।
says: That is why the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law do not get along; in any chart where the Moon and Mercury are together, the saas and bahu will not get on. Moon-Mercury conjunction is read as in-law friction in the home.
cells_derived_method: The house where the two sit decides where the friction shows: 4th in the family home, 7th in the marriage, 2nd in family talk. The sign sets the tone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon and Mercury in Cancer in the 4th (lagna Aries), the Moon in own sign, would give friction around the household and the mother, with emotional talk.
Derived: Moon and Mercury in Gemini in the 7th (lagna Sagittarius) would give clever, talkative friction between the spouse and the mother.
Derived: Moon and Mercury in Virgo in the 2nd (lagna Leo) would give faultfinding, critical family speech at the dining table.

ambiguity: Conjunction only; aspect not mentioned.
classical_check: Silent on in-law friction; the Moon-Mercury conjunction is a recognised classical combination with other results.

gist: A trailing fragment begins the next topic about mother-in-law and daughter-in-law and is cut off at the end of the slice.
Opening fragment of a sentence from the previous slice, telling the audience to leave that matter aside.

hindi: जिस लड़की की कुंडली में चंद्रमा बुध साथ है या एक दूसरे को देख रहे हैं अगर घूम कर के शिफ्ट हो करके आ गए हैं कहीं और तब भी देख रहे हैं
says: Sets the trigger condition for a girl's chart: Moon and Mercury sitting together, or looking at each other by aspect, even if they have drifted into other houses, still count as connected.
cells_derived_method: The Moon-Mercury link is the same in every cell, but the life area it touches follows the house it falls in (4th home and mother, 7th partners, 10th work) and the sign colours the tone (water signs soften, air signs make it talkative, Pisces blurs Mercury).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon joins Mercury in Mercury's own sign in the 4th, so the talkative, restless mind shows up inside the home and mother relationship.
Derived: Moon with Mercury in Pisces in the 7th, so judgement about partners and close one-to-one bonds gets clouded and changeable.
Derived: Moon with Mercury in Virgo in the 10th, so the pairing expresses through analytical, communicative work and the public image.

ambiguity: Phrase 'shift ho kar aa gaye' is vague; read as: mutual aspect still counts when the two are in different houses. Could also mean transit; natal is assumed.
classical_check: Classics treat Moon-Mercury conjunction as clever but fickle; the specific 'girl and female relatives' reading is not a standard classical rule.

hindi: उस लड़की की लड़कियों से बनेगी नहीं मासी नानी ताई चाची बुआ ना किसी फीमेल से नहीं बनेगी उसकी लड़कों से बनेगी
says: A girl with the Moon-Mercury link will not get along with females (mother's sister, maternal grandmother, paternal aunts), and will get along better with boys.
cells_derived_method: Moon stands for women and mother's side; Mercury is neuter and youthful so he reads it as male-leaning company. Which women are strained follows the house: 3rd sisters, 4th mother and maternal line, 7th female partners, 11th female friends.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign with Mercury in the 4th, friction centred on mother and maternal aunts at home.
Derived: pair in the 3rd, so sisters and female cousins are the strained relations.
Derived: pair in the 11th, so girlfriends in her social circle are the difficult ones, boys are easy friends.

ambiguity: He does not say which house; the relative list is general.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text gives this specific outcome.

hindi: अब ये बड़ी भारी चिंता और समस्या हो जाएगी माता पिता के लिए कि अरे लड़की तो भटक गई हमारी खराब हो गई कैसे संभाले
says: Because she mixes with boys instead of female relatives, parents fear she will stray, and this becomes a big worry for them.
ambiguity: Social consequence, not a chart rule by itself.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसके लिए उसका नाक छेदन करो कहते हैं इसकी नाक में नकेल डाल दो
says: Remedy for this Moon-Mercury girl: get her nose pierced, which the elders called putting a rein in her nose.
classical_check: Nose or ear piercing is a customary samskara; no classical Jyotish text ties nose piercing to Moon-Mercury.

hindi: वो नाक में नकेल नहीं था बुद्ध की करेक्शन थी भटकाव ना आए क्योंकि चरित्र से गिरा देगा
says: He explains the old nose-rein saying was really a Mercury correction, meant to prevent wandering which would otherwise damage her character.
ambiguity: Caption writes Budh (Mercury); I take it as Mercury correction.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own interpretation of a custom.

gist: Social comment that society makes a huge fuss about 'character' only for girls.
Audience member asks how the 100-hours system came about; he jokes he cannot count to 100 and asks if it can be reduced.
Garbled exchange about 96 versus 100 hours, with a muddled remark about four counts for two hands and two feet; meaning of the number is not recoverable from captions.

hindi: परमानेंटली कर दो तो भी बढ़िया लेकिन 100 घंटे तो करो दोष तो हटाओ लोग तो परमानेंट कर सकते हैं
says: Remedy dosage: wear the nose piercing for at least 100 hours to remove the Mercury fault; making it permanent is even better and people may do so.
ambiguity: Whether the 100 hours refers to wearing time or a ritual period is not clear in the caption.
classical_check: Silent; the 100-hour figure is not a classical prescription.

hindi: आप देखेंगे पुरानी जो ट्राइब्स है वो सारी की सारी अपने नाक कान छेद के रखते हैं अभी भी
says: Supporting observation: old tribes everywhere still keep their noses and ears pierced, used as evidence that the practice is ancient and purposeful.
classical_check: Silent; anthropological claim.

hindi: किस तरह सेंटर पुरुष के लिए सेंटर स्त्री राइट लेफ्ट कहीं भी करें कोई समस्या नहीं है
says: Where to pierce: centre (septum) is the male position, while for a woman the right or left nostril anywhere is fine, no problem.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled; assignment of centre to men and side to women is my best reading.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर स्त्री भी कहती है मैं सेंटर में कर लूं तो कर लो बहन कोई बात नहीं
says: A woman who wants the centre piercing may have it; he sees no issue with that.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: भैंसों का भैंस और गाय इंडिपेंडेंटली नहीं सोच पाती घोड़ा इंडिपेंडेंट नहीं सोच सकता अकेले लग जाती है
says: Analogy: buffalo, cow and horse are controlled by a nose rope and cannot think independently, so a nose ornament is presented as a thinking-curb.
ambiguity: Sentence end is garbled.
classical_check: Silent; analogy, not a classical rule.

gist: Sarcasm that at marriage the bride is made to wear a nose ring as a trap so her own thinking stops; also says girls have stopped wearing bindi these days.
Garbled half-sentence about men working in an office and what will happen.

hindi: देखो सुंदरता तो बनती ही है स्त्री के लिए। स्त्री को तो सौंदर्य दिया ही है। शुक्र मंगल का खेल है।
says: Beauty and adornment naturally belong to women and nature has given them beauty; he attributes this to the play of Venus and Mars.
ambiguity: Why Mars is named with Venus is not explained; probably Mars as the female-body and attraction factor.
classical_check: Venus as beauty karaka is classical; Mars as a co-factor is his addition.

gist: Garbled lines saying it is up to the woman, that she must herself build a masculine element, and that not doing so is wrong; caption does not show the point.
Comment that woman is physically vulnerable and man physically stronger, so the two are not the same.
Continues the gender comment: neither is superior, challenges in their lives differ, so competing or talking up the contest is pointless.

hindi: चंद्र बुध साथ होने से हमेशा क्लेश होता है।
says: Moon and Mercury together always bring quarrels and discord.
cells_derived_method: Discord falls where the pair sits: 2nd family speech, 4th household, 7th spouse, 10th workplace. Sign flavour matters, as friendly sign Gemini or Virgo gives sharp words, water signs give moody quarrels.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: pair in the 2nd in Gemini, quarrels through harsh, clever speech within the family.
Derived: pair in the 7th in Cancer, moody emotional clashes with the spouse.
Derived: pair in the 10th in Virgo, criticism and arguments at the workplace.

ambiguity: 'Always' is his emphasis; no exceptions are given.
classical_check: Classics say Moon-Mercury gives wit and changeable mind, not 'always quarrels'; he is stronger than the texts.

hindi: सूर्य बुध साथ हो बहुत ज्यादा बढ़िया हिसाब किताब है। 1% भी दिक्कत नहीं।
says: Sun and Mercury together is a very good arrangement, with not even 1 percent trouble.
cells_derived_method: House decides the field: 1st intellect and name, 5th learning, 10th career authority. Sign decides strength: in Leo the Sun is strong but Mercury is hot, in Gemini Mercury is own sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Budhaditya in the 1st in Virgo, sharp analytical intellect that defines the personality.
Derived: pair in the 5th in Gemini, strong education and writing skills.
Derived: pair in the 10th in Leo, authority-based career, though Mercury is close to the Sun.

ambiguity: He later says Mercury is often combust near the Sun, which softens this claim.
classical_check: Budhaditya yoga is classical and praised; but classics also note combustion of Mercury; he partly contradicts himself in the next minutes.

gist: Audience question: if Mercury is exalted and Aditya yoga makes a person famous, what about Mercury being combust.

hindi: सूर्य के प्रकाश में कोई भी ग्रह आता है भयंकर सूर्य सबसे बली है सूर्य किसी से नहीं दबता
says: Any planet that comes into the Sun's light is overpowered; the Sun is the strongest planet and cannot be suppressed by any other.
classical_check: Agrees with combustion (asta) doctrine, though classics give planet-specific degrees.

hindi: सिंह राशि ऐसी है जो कभी डिस्ट्रॉय नहीं होती
says: Leo, the Sun's sign, is a sign that never gets destroyed.
cells_derived_method: A house holding Leo stays protected; its house topic is resilient, e.g. Leo in the 6th resists enemies and debts, Leo in the 8th resists sudden loss.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo in the 6th, the area of enemies and disease holds up and does not collapse.
Derived: Leo in the 8th, the house of upheaval tends to survive shocks.

ambiguity: 'Destroy' is not defined; could refer to the sign's indestructibility in a chart or in general.
classical_check: Silent; not a standard classical statement.

hindi: सूर्य के प्रकाश में अधिकतर बुध रहता ही है और अक्सर अस्त रहता है यानी उसकी जान ही निकली पड़ी होती है। इसीलिए 99% लोग जो हैं एक्सप्रेसिव नहीं है। बहुत कम मैथमेटिशियंस बनते हैं।
says: Mercury is nearly always close to the Sun and often combust, which drains its life; so 99 percent of people are not expressive and very few become mathematicians.
ambiguity: The 99 percent figure is a loose claim, not measured.
classical_check: Mercury is never more than about 28 degrees from the Sun, so being frequently combust is classically correct; the link to expressiveness is his inference.

hindi: अकेला बुद्ध हो बहुत डेंजरस क्योंकि उसे पता ही नहीं करना क्या है। वह जिस घर में बैठ जाता है उस घर के मालिक के अनुसार फल देने लगता है।
says: A lone Mercury is very dangerous because it has no own direction; it behaves according to the lord of whichever house or sign it occupies.
cells_derived_method: Take the lord of the sign Mercury sits in (his word 'ghar' may be sign or house) and read Mercury as that lord's agent: Mercury in Aries acts like Mars, in Taurus like Venus, in Cancer like the Moon.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 3rd in Aries gives results like Mars, bold and combative communication.
Derived: Mercury in the 7th in Taurus behaves like Venus, pleasure and comfort-minded in partnerships.
Derived: Mercury in the 10th in Capricorn acts like Saturn, structured but heavy at work.

ambiguity: 'Ghar ka malik' means the lord of the house; house lord and sign lord differ by lagna, so it could be either.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with the classical rule that a planet gives results of its dispositor.

hindi: अब यह कॉम्प्लिकेटेड बात हो जाएगी। और वो मालिक उसका कहां बैठा है डिपेंड करता है।
says: The picture gets complicated because the result also depends on where that lord himself sits.
cells_derived_method: Two-step chain: find Mercury's dispositor, then read that dispositor's own house and sign. Same Mercury cell can read very differently when the lord is in a kendra versus the 6th, 8th or 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Leo in the 2nd depends on the Sun's own placement; Sun in a strong house lifts speech and wealth.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 9th depends on Jupiter's placement; Jupiter in the 6th or 8th weakens fortune.

classical_check: Agrees with the classical dispositor-chain method.

hindi: चौथा बुध सबसे सर्वश्रेष्ठ होता है। लेकिन उसके कई चीजों का दोष नहीं लगता।
says: Mercury in the 4th is the best placement of all, and many of its usual faults do not apply there.
cells_derived_method: 4th house is home, mother, comfort and education; a content, learned Mercury there. Sign changes polish: in Gemini or Virgo own-sign strength, in Sagittarius a Mercury less comfortable.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 4th, steady education, calm home.
Derived: Mercury in Sagittarius in the 4th, still protected by house but sign is neutral and restless.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 4th, weak sign, so the 'best' claim should be tested against sign.

ambiguity: Second sentence 'kai cheezon ka dosh nahi lagta' is partly garbled; read as faults not applying.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mercury has directional strength in the 1st house, not the 4th; 4th is only a kendra.

gist: Says he will not take up combinations with Rahu and Ketu now; they will be added later.
Pointing at the chart diagram saying Mercury is very good here, good here; houses are not named in the caption.

hindi: यहां वेरी डेंजरस।
says: One particular placement of Mercury, pointed at on the diagram, is called very dangerous; the house is not captured.
ambiguity: Which house he points at is unknown from caption; likely a dusthana, probably linked to the 12th or 6th named next.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां नपुंसकता देता है।
says: At one pointed placement Mercury gives impotence or lack of virility; recorded only as his tradition claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: House not captured in caption. Medical-type claim, flagged and not to be used for diagnosis.
classical_check: Classically Mercury is neuter and some texts link afflicted Mercury to potency issues; no specific house confirmed.

hindi: यहां बुध जो है यह मृत्यु की ओर बुद्धि डाल के रखेगा। बुद्धिमान जरूर बनाता है।
says: At another pointed placement Mercury keeps the mind drawn toward death-related themes, while still making the person intelligent.
ambiguity: House not captured; likely the 8th since it concerns death, but unconfirmed. This is mind-orientation, not a death prediction.
classical_check: Mercury in the 8th is classically said to give research and occult interest, which fits loosely.

gist: More pointing at the diagram: Mercury good here, good here, and a garbled line about 'good or most dangerous' without house numbers.

hindi: हाइली नेगेटिव किसी भी राशि का हो। 12 नंबर का बुध कहीं पर भी बैठा हो बहुत लफड़े वाला है।
says: Mercury in the 12th is highly negative whatever sign it is in, and in any case brings a lot of trouble.
cells_derived_method: 12th is loss, foreign lands, isolation and hidden matters. Sign sets the form: Gemini or Virgo gives anxious overthinking, Scorpio gives secret schemes, Pisces gives dissolution.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 12th, overthinking and sleep-lost worry, expenses through talk and trade.
Derived: Mercury in Scorpio in the 12th, secretive or hidden dealings that bring trouble.
Derived: Mercury in Capricorn in the 12th, dry, heavy thinking and delays abroad.

ambiguity: '12 number ka budh' could mean house 12 or sign 12 (Pisces); he says 'kisi bhi rashi ka' so I read it as house 12 in any sign.
classical_check: Classics also treat Mercury in the 12th as weak, though some texts allow benefit for spiritual or foreign-linked work; his 'highly negative' is stronger.

hindi: लेकिन यहां बैठा तो हाइली डिस्ट्रक्टिव। हाइली हाइली डिस्ट्रक्टिव हो जाता है। बिल्कुल तबाही मचा देता है।
says: At one specific pointed spot, apparently the worst sitting of the 12th-house Mercury, it becomes extremely destructive and wrecks things completely.
cells_derived_method: If the 'here' is a particular sign in the 12th, the debilitated Pisces placement (Mercury in Pisces) is the likely candidate since Pisces is the 12th natural sign and Mercury's fall sign. Test, do not assume.

derived_examples.reading: Derived and unconfirmed: Mercury in its fall sign in the 12th, the stacked weakness and house loss would fit 'total destruction'.

ambiguity: He points at a spot, so the exact sign cell is not captured.
classical_check: Silent; combination of fall plus dusthana is classically bad (neecha in a dusthana).

hindi: तीन और छह नंबर का बुध कहीं पर भी हो तीन नंबर का हाइली फ्री
says: Mercury in the 3rd house is highly free, meaning fine and unrestrained, wherever in sign; 6th is taken up next.
cells_derived_method: 3rd is courage, writing, communication and siblings, a natural Mercury area. Sign tunes it: Gemini or Virgo give strong skill, Cancer gives emotional writing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 3rd, excellent communication, writing and sales ability.
Derived: Mercury in Libra in the 3rd, diplomatic persuasive speech.
Derived: Mercury in Aquarius in the 3rd, inventive, technical communication.

ambiguity: 'Highly free' is unclear; I read it as 'fine/free of dosha'. Also could mean house 3 versus sign Gemini; house assumed since sign 6 Virgo would be strong.
classical_check: Mercury in the 3rd is classically decent for communication; agrees broadly.

hindi: छह नंबर वाले की दृष्टि 12 पे आ जाएगी। यह मोर डेंजरस अगेन
says: Mercury in the 6th casts its 7th aspect on the 12th house, which makes it more dangerous.
cells_derived_method: The 6th-house Mercury looks at the 12th (6th plus six equals 12th), so the 6th (debts, enemies, disease) and the 12th (loss) get linked. Sign sets how: Aries or Scorpio make the fight aggressive, Gemini or Virgo make it a mental, anxious drain.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 6th aspecting the 12th, a mind strained by service and worry, losses through overthinking.
Derived: Mercury in Aries in the 6th, sharp quarrelsome rivals and legal worry, aspect hits expenses in the 12th.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 6th, confused judgement about debts, aspect carries losses to 12th.

ambiguity: Says '3 and 6 number'; I treat as houses because 7th-aspect arithmetic (6 to 12) fits.
classical_check: 7th aspect arithmetic is classical; Mercury in the 6th is usually considered mixed to good in classics (upachaya-like), so 'more dangerous' is his claim.

hindi: डेंजरस बहुत खतरनाक है। इसलिए बुध को सपोर्ट चाहिए।
says: Because a lone Mercury is so dangerous, it needs support from other planets or from remedies.
classical_check: Agrees with the idea that Mercury takes on the nature of its company.

hindi: शुरू 32 साल की ऐज और 32 और 34 के बाद बुध पावर पकड़ता है।
says: Mercury is weak in the early years and takes real power only after about age 32 to 34.
ambiguity: Captions say 32 and 32 and 34; I read it as 32 to 34.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical maturity age of Mercury at 32.

hindi: जैसे ही आपने व्यापार और वाणिज्य शुरू कर दिया, आपके बुध का दोष कम हो जाता है। इसलिए आप किसी किस्म का व्यापार करते हैं, वाणिज्य रखते हैं, बहुत अच्छा है।
says: Starting any trade or commerce reduces Mercury's fault, so doing business of any kind is good.
classical_check: Mercury is classical karaka of trade; supports it.

hindi: बुध का दोष हटाने के लिए क्या-क्या करना है? लेखनी, लिखो, बोलो, डिस्कशन करो।
says: To remove Mercury's fault: write, speak and take part in discussions.
classical_check: Fits Mercury's karakatva of speech and writing; not a listed classical remedy.

hindi: अगर आपका शनि दोष है तो आप यह सब बिल्कुल मत करो। क्योंकि बुध उसी ग्रह के अनुसार चलता है जिसकी दृष्टि में हो।
says: Exception: if you have a Saturn fault, do not do the writing and discussion remedy, because Mercury follows whichever planet aspects it.
cells_derived_method: Check what aspects Mercury; a Saturn aspect or conjunction means talking and debating amplifies Saturn's heavy, negative strain. Same principle applies to Mars (arguments) or Rahu (confusion).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 3rd with Saturn's influence, extra speaking and writing feeds pessimistic, harsh expression.
Derived: Mercury aspected by Saturn from the 4th, work discussions bring burden; better to stay quiet and structured.

ambiguity: 'Shani dosh' is not defined.
classical_check: Aspect-borrowing nature of Mercury is classical; the specific advice is his.

hindi: आप जिसके साथ बिठा दो बुद्धि वैसी हो जाती है। आप यहां सत्संग करने बैठ जाओगे थोड़े दिनों में सत्संग हो जाएगा।
says: Intellect takes the colour of the company it is placed in; sit here doing satsang and soon you become a satsang person.
classical_check: Agrees with Mercury as a planet that takes the nature of those it joins.

hindi: आप 10 क्लास ज्योतिष की कर लोगे। आपके अंदर ज्योतिष का कीड़ा हो जाएगा। आप जो चीज के बारे में बात करोगे इस्लाम की बात करोगे इस्लाम का कीड़ा डाउन हो जाएगा।
says: Example of Mercury's absorbing mind: after ten astrology classes you carry an astrology bug, and if you keep talking about Islam, you pick up that bug instead.
classical_check: Silent; illustration only.

hindi: अगर आपकी बुद्धि पक्की है तो भ्रमित नहीं होगी नहीं तो भ्रमित जरूर होगी।
says: A firmly formed intellect will not be misled by what it listens to; an unformed one surely will be.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हरे रंग की शराब की बोतल घर में नहीं होनी चाहिए।
says: Vastu remedy for Mercury: keep no green liquor bottle in the house.
classical_check: Silent; green is Mercury's colour in tradition, rest is his vastu-link.

hindi: आपके घर के अंदर हवा के रास्ते साफ सुथरे होने चाहिए।
says: Vastu remedy for Mercury: air passages inside the home, such as vents and windows, must be clean and clear.
classical_check: Silent; Mercury is an air-element planet, so the link is plausible within his scheme.

hindi: रस्सी सुतली निवाड़ टूटी फूटी खराब नहीं होनी चाहिए।
says: Vastu remedy for Mercury: no broken or spoiled rope, twine or woven cot webbing should be kept at home.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: खराब घड़ियां नहीं होनी चाहिए।
says: Vastu remedy for Mercury: do not keep stopped or faulty clocks and watches in the house.
classical_check: Silent; general vastu belief.

hindi: आपके पास फटे पुराने नोट है तो उनको संभाल के बंद करके रखो। फटे हुए कागज सारी रद्दी चिथरे कर रखे हैं। यह सब आपके यहां नहीं होने चाहिए।
says: Vastu remedy for Mercury: torn old currency notes should be put away carefully, and torn papers, scrap and shreds must not lie around the house.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अपने नाखून चबाना नहीं होना चाहिए। नाक में उंगली डाल डाल के लोग करते रहते हैं। थूकते रहो हर जगह। नहीं ये सब बुध के दोष हैं।
says: Personal habits that are Mercury faults and cause problems: biting nails, picking the nose and spitting everywhere; he lists them as things to stop.
classical_check: Silent; Mercury governs nails, nose and hygiene in some traditions.

hindi: नॉर्थ का डायरेक्शन आपका बिल्कुल क्लीन साफ सुथरा बढ़िया रखो। काम, मनी ओपोरर्चुनिटीज़ भी वहीं से आती है और बुध का दोष भी हटता है।
says: Keep the north direction of the home spotlessly clean: work and money opportunities come from there, and Mercury's fault is removed.
classical_check: Vastu places Mercury and wealth in the north, which agrees.

hindi: यदि आपने उस डायरेक्शन के अंदर किसी तरह की गंदगी, खराब कचरा बेफालतू की गंदगी का स्टोरेज बना रखा है तो घर में सारे लोग बहस करेंगे।
says: If dirt, garbage or junk is stored in the north direction, everyone in the house will argue.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Mercury as the speech planet in his vastu mapping.

hindi: बुध का महादोष हो जाता है अगर बुध वक्री हो जाए। वक्री वक्री होता ही रहता है।
says: Retrograde Mercury is a major fault; he adds that Mercury goes retrograde very often, so it is common.
cells_derived_method: Retrograde Mercury shows its trouble in the house it holds: 3rd harsh arguing, 7th disputes with partners, 10th workplace friction, whichever sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Mercury in own sign in the 3rd, relentless debating and writing with an edge.
Derived: retrograde Mercury in Libra in the 7th, disputes and second-guessing in partnerships.
Derived: retrograde Mercury in Taurus in the 10th, stubborn argument at work.

classical_check: Classics treat retrograde planets as strong (cheshta bala), so calling it a major fault differs from the texts.

hindi: यह तेज बोल बोलेगा व्यक्ति। वक्री वाला बहस बहुत करेगा और सुनेगा किसी के बाप की नहीं।
says: With retrograde Mercury the person speaks loudly and fast, argues a great deal and listens to nobody.
cells_derived_method: Style of arguing changes with sign: Aries blunt, Gemini nonstop, Scorpio cutting; house names the audience: 2nd family table, 7th spouse, 10th colleagues.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Mercury in Aries in the 2nd, blunt shouting arguments at the family table.
Derived: retrograde Mercury in Scorpio in the 7th, cutting, stubborn verbal fights with the spouse.

classical_check: Silent.

gist: Sentence cut off at the end of the slice: 'especially for girls...' with no content.

hindi: ध्यान रखना। अगर आपकी कुंडली में बुध वक्री है कहीं भी बैठा है। वो तो स्पेसिफिक बात हो गई।
says: Warning that a retrograde Mercury anywhere in the chart is a specific condition that needs attention; the effects that follow apply whichever house it sits in.
cells_derived_method: Retrograde Mercury acts through the house it occupies: 2nd harsh family speech, 4th domestic arguing, 7th partner disputes, 10th workplace talk. Sign nature changes the tone (Aries blunt, Cancer moody, Capricorn dry).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Mercury in Leo in the 2nd, proud, commanding speech inside the family.
Derived: retrograde Mercury in Sagittarius in the 7th, preachy, blunt talk toward the spouse.
Derived: retrograde Mercury in Pisces in the 10th, confused and moody communication in career.

ambiguity: 'Specific baat' is a loose aside; read as 'this is a particular case to watch'.
classical_check: Classics usually treat a retrograde planet as strong; calling retrograde Mercury a fault is his own approach.

hindi: तो उस लड़की की शादी के बाद एक ही प्रॉब्लम होगी छूटते ही कि बहन तू चुप नहीं रह सकती। तुझे बोले बिना चैन नहीं पड़ता है। यही तेरे जीवन का नर्क है
says: A girl with retrograde Mercury will, soon after marriage, face one core problem: she cannot stay quiet and has no peace without speaking, and this becomes the hell of her married life.
cells_derived_method: Marriage friction is read from the 7th and from Mercury's house. Retrograde Mercury in the 7th speaks straight at the spouse; in the 2nd it hits the in-laws at the table; in the 12th it appears in the bedroom.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Mercury in own sign in the 7th, constant verbal back-and-forth with the husband.
Derived: retrograde Mercury in Scorpio in the 2nd, cutting family talk that wounds in-laws.
Derived: retrograde Mercury in Virgo in the 12th, private nagging and criticism that spoils intimacy.

ambiguity: Addresses girls, but the same would apply to any retrograde Mercury person.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: क्योंकि नपुंसक है सेक्स लाइफ खत्म कर देगा। पति पत्नी के बीच रोमांस जिन खत्म कर देगा।
says: Mercury is neuter by nature, so an afflicted or retrograde Mercury kills the couple's sex life and romance; recorded as his tradition claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Intimacy damage is strongest when Mercury afflicts the 7th or 12th; in the 5th romance is hit; Venus-ruled signs soften it, Mercury's own signs make it talk instead of touch.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: afflicted Mercury in Virgo in the 7th, criticism replaces romance between the pair.
Derived: afflicted Mercury in Gemini in the 12th, bed-pleasure side over-mentalised and cooled.
Derived: afflicted Mercury in Libra in the 5th, romance becomes talk and debate, less heat.

ambiguity: 'Napunsak' is a sensitive, medical-sounding word; treated as a traditional karaka statement, no diagnosis.
classical_check: Classics call Mercury a neuter planet; the leap to sexual dysfunction is his own.

hindi: जिसे कहते हैं मुंह बना के बैठ गए वो बुध है। इसलिए बहुत डेंजरस स्थिति बन जाती है।
says: The sulking, pouting face that someone puts on is Mercury at work, and that is why the situation becomes dangerous in marriage.
classical_check: Silent; this karaka assignment is his own.

hindi: पुरुष को सबसे बड़ा सत्याप होता है। स्त्री ने मुंह बना लिया। बुद्ध नपुंसकता की ओर ले जा रहा है तो वो अपने पुसत्व के लिए रोता है। फिर वो पुरुष बाहर भागता है।
says: The husband's biggest distress is a wife who sulks; if Mercury pushes toward impotence he grieves over his manhood and then the man runs outside the home, to be read as a tendency to seek outside relationships.
ambiguity: 'Bahar bhagta hai' likely means extramarital escape but is not stated explicitly. Medical-type claim, flagged.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बाहर भागता है तो लेडी का मुंह और बनता है और ज्यादा घर में नर्क होता है।
says: When the husband strays outside, the wife sulks even more and the home turns into more of a hell, a downward spiral.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसीलिए बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है संवाद। बोल बोलते रहे बातचीत के द्वारा ही रिॉल्व होगा।
says: Remedy for Mercury-caused marital trouble: keep up open dialogue, because things get resolved only through talking.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Remark that however many court cases you file, disputes finally get settled by sitting across a table.

hindi: आपका बुध यदि वक्री है तो आपको बिना सोचे समझे जब तक राशि का दोष नहीं है पन्ना पहनना ही पहनना है।
says: Gem remedy: if Mercury is retrograde, wear an emerald without second thought, provided there is no sign-related fault with the Mercury signs.
cells_derived_method: The 'sign fault' check depends on the houses of Gemini and Virgo for that lagna: if they fall in 6, 8 or 12 the gem needs guidance.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna has Gemini in the 3rd and Virgo in the 6th, so the gem decision needs the guidance caveat he gives.
Derived: Mercury retrograde in the 10th in Capricorn, with no sign fault, so he would say wear the emerald.

ambiguity: 'Rashi ka dosh' not defined; read as the Mercury-ruled signs sitting in dusthana houses.
classical_check: Classics advise testing a gem and checking if the planet is a functional benefic; blanket advice is stronger than the texts.

hindi: यहां यहां और यहां अगर तीन नंबर की राशि है तो आपका पन्ना विदाउट गाइडेंस आप नहीं पहन सकते।
says: If sign number 3 (Gemini) falls in certain pointed houses, you must not wear an emerald without guidance.
cells_derived_method: The pointed houses are not captured; the likely ones are the dusthanas. Gemini in the 6th means Capricorn lagna with Mercury ruling a bad house, Gemini in the 8th means Scorpio lagna, Gemini in the 12th means Taurus lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived and unconfirmed: Gemini in the 6th, a gem for the lord of the house of disease and debt strengthens that very house, hence caution.
Derived and unconfirmed: Gemini in the 8th, strengthening Mercury enlarges the 8th house matters.
Derived and unconfirmed: Gemini in the 12th, expense and loss matters grow if Mercury is energised.

ambiguity: Which houses he points to is missing from the caption; sign 3 could also mean house 3.
classical_check: Classics also warn against gems for lords of dusthanas, so this agrees with the cautious tradition.

hindi: यह साइड इफेक्ट मारेगा ही मारेगा।
says: An emerald worn in the cautioned case without guidance will certainly give side effects.
ambiguity: Refers to the previous sentence about unguided wearing.
classical_check: Agrees with classical caution on gems for malefic lords.

hindi: चार पांच रत्ती का छह रत्ती का पन्ना पहनो।
says: Emerald weight to wear: about 4 to 6 ratti.
classical_check: Common modern guideline is about 3 to 6 ratti, so roughly agrees.

hindi: पन्ना 5000 का भी आता है। 5 लाख का भी आता है। सस्ता पन्ना काम नहीं करेगा।
says: Emeralds range from about 5,000 rupees to 5 lakh, and a cheap emerald will not work.
ambiguity: Purchase guidance, recorded only as what he said, not advice.
classical_check: Classical texts demand a flawless gem, which is expensive, so this agrees.

hindi: इसमें काला लाइन नहीं होनी चाहिए। क्रैक नहीं होना चाहिए।
says: Quality check for the emerald: no black lines and no cracks in the stone.
classical_check: Agrees with classical gem flaw lists.

hindi: सबसे बढ़िया जामियन और कोलंबियन है। जामियन माइंड का बढ़िया पन्ना पहनना चाहिए।
says: Best emerald origins are Zambian and Colombian; a good Zambian-mined stone is recommended.
ambiguity: 'Zamian mind' is read as Zambian mined.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not name modern origins.

hindi: पांच छह रत्ती का पहन लो काफी है। बड़ा पहन लो बड़ा पहन लो जो अफोर्ड कर सकता है।
says: Five to six ratti is enough, but a bigger one is better if the person can afford it.
classical_check: Classics say a heavier stone gives more effect, so this is consistent.

gist: Audience remark that he recommends very expensive remedies and costs.

hindi: हां तो वन टाइम है क्योंकि ज्यादा बर्बाद नहीं होगी।
says: His reply on cost: the gem is a one-time expense, and the money is not wasted over the years.
ambiguity: Sentence is partly garbled; reading is cost not wasted because it is once.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सस्ते उपाय बता दिए। छोटे-छोटे घड़ा या फलाना कर दो ढमकाना काम होगा। नो डाउट काम होगा। परमानेंट नहीं होगा।
says: Cheap small remedies such as giving a pot or similar do work, no doubt, but their effect is not permanent.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Analogy about permanent measures like childhood vaccination against polio and small pox versus eating almonds for life or taking paracetamol each time, used to argue that permanent fixes beat repeated small ones.

hindi: परमानेंट आपने परमानेंट चश्मे को सेट करके रखा नंबर नहीं बढ़ेगा स्टोन परमानेंट पहनो पता नहीं कब छ महीने साल में दशा फिर बदले
says: Wear the gemstone permanently, like permanent spectacles, because the dasha can change again in six months or a year and you cannot know when.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice where gems are often worn for a particular dasha period.

hindi: अब ये कहा जाता है कि जी आपने तो स्टोन पहना दिया नुकसान हो गया। यह दशाएं यह किसी के पल्ले नहीं पड़ता।
says: People blame the stone when harm happens, but the real cause is a changed dasha, which most people do not understand.
classical_check: Classics also say that gem results depend on the running dasha, so partly agrees.

hindi: कोई स्टोन नहीं पहनाता कि इस घर के स्वामी को आपने यहां पहना दिया, वह पहना दिया। ऐसे काम नहीं करता।
says: Nobody prescribes stones by the logic of putting the lord of a particular house here or there; that is not how gemstones work.
ambiguity: Sentence is vague; I read it as him rejecting placement-by-house-lord reasoning for gems, replaced by the next idea.
classical_check: Differs from the classical rule of choosing gems by lagna and house lordship.

hindi: आप यह मान के चलो कोई भी ग्रह अपने आप में जहां का मालिक है। बुध मान लो तीन नंबर, तीन नंबर का, छह नंबर का मालिक है। छह नंबर के लिए भी उपाय होता है। बुध के थ्रू हो जाता है। कोई बुराई नहीं है।
says: Treat each planet as the lord of whatever it rules; for example Mercury as lord of the 3rd and 6th can be used to fix 6th-house matters too, with no harm.
cells_derived_method: With Mercury ruling the 3rd (Gemini) and the 6th (Virgo) the lagna is Aries. The same logic works for any lord: take its two houses and fix both through that planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for Aries lagna, strengthening Mercury helps courage, siblings and writing in the 3rd.
Derived: for Aries lagna, strengthening Mercury also helps with debts, service and rivals in the 6th, as he claims.

ambiguity: 'Teen number, chhah number' could be houses 3 and 6, matches Gemini and Virgo houses for Aries lagna.
classical_check: Differs: classics usually avoid strengthening the lord of the 6th, and a 6th lord's gem is normally not recommended.

hindi: और बुध यहां पड़ा हुआ है। यहां पड़ा हुआ है या यहां पड़ा हुआ है। तो यह बुध की समस्या क्या है? इसका मालिक शराब पी के यहां पड़ा हुआ है। इसके मालिक को जगाओ।
says: When Mercury lies in some house, the real problem is that its own lord (dispositor) is lying drunk elsewhere in the chart, so wake up that lord to fix Mercury.
cells_derived_method: Find Mercury's sign lord and see where it sits; the more weakly placed that lord (6th, 8th, 12th, debilitated), the more it needs the remedy. Mercury in Aries means Mars is the one to wake; in Pisces means Jupiter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Aries in the 5th, the real remedy goes to Mars and its placement.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 9th, wake Jupiter, the dispositor.

ambiguity: The houses where Mercury lies are pointed at, not named.
classical_check: Agrees with the dispositor idea in classical readings.

hindi: स्टोन कभी पावर नहीं बढ़ाता। स्टोन कभी कम नहीं करता। स्टोन कभी स्टोन ग्रह को जागृत करता है। उठ रहे
says: A stone neither adds power to a planet nor reduces it; it only awakens the planet.
ambiguity: Caption has a stray final word.
classical_check: Differs from classical view that gems strengthen the planet's rays.

hindi: हां स्टोन जागृत करता है। स्टोन इस घर के अंदर बुध बैठा है। ये तो नाश कर देगा।
says: Repeats that a stone only wakes the planet; so if Mercury sits in a bad house, waking it will destroy that house's matters.
cells_derived_method: A woken Mercury amplifies whatever house it sits in: in a dusthana (6, 8, 12) it amplifies trouble; in a kendra or trine it amplifies good.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: woken Mercury in the 8th in Scorpio, secrecy, crisis and upheaval grow.
Derived: woken Mercury in the 5th in Gemini, learning and intelligence grow.

ambiguity: 'Is ghar' is pointing; house not captured. I assume a bad house, from 'nash kar dega'.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical caution against energising planets in dusthanas.

hindi: भले ही 12 नंबर नीच का बुध हो लेकिन तीन नंबर को और छह नंबर को सेट करने के लिए आपको पन्ना पहनना पड़ेगा।
says: Even when Mercury sits in the 12th in its fall sign, you still need to wear an emerald to set right the 3rd and 6th houses it rules.
cells_derived_method: For Aries lagna, Pisces is the 12th and Mercury ruling the 3rd and 6th falls there; the emerald targets the houses it lords, not its placement.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna with debilitated Mercury in the 12th, the emerald is still prescribed for the houses 3 and 6.

ambiguity: '12 number neech ka' read as 12th house in Pisces; 12 could be sign number only.
classical_check: Differs: classically a gem for a debilitated 6th lord in the 12th is questioned; he goes against that.

gist: Audience asks which book this is written in; he says no book has this yet, every book is written by some person, and tells them to try it and see.

hindi: आपका मैथ्स वीक होगा। आप बहस बहुत ज्यादा करोगे। तेज बोलोगे, चिकचिक करोगे।
says: With a weak Mercury, maths will be weak, you will argue too much, speak fast and keep up petty quarrelling.
cells_derived_method: Which area is hit shows in the house: 4th school maths, 3rd talking, 7th spouse arguments. Sign colour: Aries sharp, Gemini nonstop.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: weak Mercury in Aries in the 4th, sharp quarrels at home and weak school maths.
Derived: weak Mercury in Gemini in the 3rd, relentless fast talk and bickering.

ambiguity: The subject 'weak Mercury' is implied, not said.
classical_check: Mercury as karaka of maths is classical.

hindi: बुध अस्त है तो बच्चा पेपर ही नहीं करके आ सकता। 100 के 100 नंबर का। वो कहेगा मम्मा 20 नंबर का छूट गया। वो अस्त है। असंभव हो ही नहीं सकता।
says: With combust Mercury a child cannot score full marks; he always comes home saying he missed 20 marks, which he calls the sign of combustion.
cells_derived_method: House gives the field: 4th school marks, 5th exams and intelligence, 10th work. Combust Mercury in the 5th shows exam slips; in the 2nd it shows speech slips.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: combust Mercury in Leo in the 5th, bright but careless in exams, dropping marks at the end.
Derived: combust Mercury in Aries in the 4th, school learning interrupted by restless attitude.

ambiguity: Caption writes 'dast' for 'ast'; read as asta (combust).
classical_check: Combust Mercury weakening intellect is classical; the exact marks claim is his illustration.

hindi: आप हिसाब कर रहे हो। हिसाब करते करते आप कहोगे क्या था? दोबारा कर रहे हो। नोट गिन रहे हो घर 51 पे 52 था। 51 था फिर गिन रहे हो। वो अस्त है।
says: Combust Mercury shows as calculation mistakes: you lose the thread while counting, redo the sum, and recount notes after forgetting whether it was 51 or 52.
cells_derived_method: Affected area follows the house: 2nd money counting, 7th partnership accounts, 10th work accounts. Sign tunes the style: Virgo over-checks, Sagittarius is careless.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: combust Mercury in Virgo in the 2nd, constant recounting and doubt over money.
Derived: combust Mercury in Sagittarius in the 10th, sloppy figures at work.

ambiguity: 'Dast' is a caption error for 'ast'.
classical_check: Silent; illustration of Mercury's combust effect.

hindi: वक्री है तो आपके बस का ही नहीं बैठेगा। आप में पेशेंस ही नहीं हो सकती किसी हालत के अंदर और आपका मुंह बना रहेगा।
says: With retrograde Mercury you will have no patience under any circumstances and will keep a sulking face.
cells_derived_method: Impatience shows where Mercury sits: 3rd with siblings, 7th with spouse, 10th at work. Fixed signs make the sulk last longer; mutable signs make the talk run on.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Mercury in Taurus in the 7th, stubborn silent sulking with the spouse.
Derived: retrograde Mercury in Gemini in the 10th, restless impatience with colleagues.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बच्चा बच्चा कौन है? एंटी एजिंग। खेल रहा है।
says: Mercury is the child, the youthful and anti-ageing planet that keeps playing.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is classically the youthful prince, ever young.

hindi: ख़राब बुध क्या है? मुंह बना हुआ ढंग से क्यों नहीं बना? इधर देखना।
says: A bad Mercury is a sulking, sour face on a person who does not compose a pleasant expression.
ambiguity: Last words 'idhar dekhna' are an instruction to the audience.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इतना मुंह बनवाता है यह। यानी आपके अंदर का बचपना खत्म कर देगा।
says: A bad Mercury makes you sulk this much and kills the childlike playfulness inside you.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वाणिज्य व्यापार कैसे करेंगे? नहीं नहीं इंसान को सीरियस होना चाहिए। सीरियस होना।
says: Argues that you cannot do trade and commerce without playfulness, so the idea that a person must be serious all the time is wrong.
ambiguity: Rhetorical speech; the 'serious' voice is an imagined objector.
classical_check: Mercury as karaka of trade is classical.

gist: Joke that one should be serious only on a hospital bed, and that everyone coming back from a hospital suddenly becomes wise.

hindi: आप बुद्ध हैं। अपने परिवार अपने घर में बचपना नहीं मरने दो।
says: Remedy: you are Mercury, so do not let the childlike spirit die in your family and home.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपको बृहस्पति बनना है। बुध उसका कहना मानता है।
says: To fix Mercury become like Jupiter, because Mercury obeys Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: A Jupiter aspect or conjunction on Mercury steadies it; a Jupiter 5th, 7th or 9th aspect on Mercury's house is the helpful pattern.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 3rd with Jupiter's 9th aspect from the 11th, talk becomes wise and guided.
Derived: Mercury in the 7th with Jupiter aspecting from the 1st, partnership communication becomes gentle.

classical_check: Silent as a rule; Jupiter is Mercury's enemy in classical friendship tables, so he differs from the texts.

hindi: बृहस्पति की शैतान के घर जाके शैतानी करके सत्यानाश पीट के भी अल्टीमेटली बृहस्पति उसे क्षमा करता है और बुध फिर भी काबू रहता है।
says: Even if Mercury goes mischievous and wrecks things in a devil's house, Jupiter finally forgives it and Mercury stays under control.
ambiguity: Metaphor; 'devil's house' is not defined.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बुध ही आपको पॉलिटिशियन बनाता है। पॉलिटिकल कैरियर
says: Mercury is the planet that makes a person a politician; it governs a political career.
classical_check: Classically Sun and Saturn are political karakas; Mercury for speech and negotiation fits only partly.

hindi: अगर आपके पास बुध का डिस्ट्रक्शन है, ख़राबी है, वक्री है, अस्त है, दबा हुआ किसी ग्रह से।
says: Lists the ways Mercury is troubled: destroyed in strength, flawed, retrograde, combust, or pressed down by another planet.
classical_check: Combustion and affliction are classical; retrograde as a fault is his own.

hindi: किसी की कुंडली के अंदर तीन नंबर का बुध यहां है। भले ही नवांश में है। कुंडली के साथ नवांश भी और मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली है उसमें भी और बुध यहां बैठ गया है। तो, यह व्यक्ति अपनी पत्नी या पति से दुनिया भर का क्लेश करेगा।
says: Example: when Mercury sits in a particular house in the chart, also in the navamsha, and also in his one-two-three method chart, the person will quarrel endlessly with the spouse.
cells_derived_method: He later gives the reason as Mercury sitting in the 12th from the relevant house. The spouse house is the 7th, whose 12th is the 6th, so Mercury in the 6th would quarrel with the spouse; if he means 'three number' that would fit the mother (4th) instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 6th, the 12th from the 7th, damages the spouse bond; in Gemini the quarrel is verbal.
Derived: Mercury in Scorpio in the 6th, bitter, stubborn quarrels with the spouse.

ambiguity: The house he points at ('yahan') is not captured; 'teen number ka budh' may mean the 3rd house, but the 12th-from-7th logic suggests the 6th. Needs checking against video.
classical_check: The 12th-from-a-house idea is classical (bhavat bhavam style), but this application is his own.

hindi: दुनिया भर का क्लेश इतनी भैंस क्योंकि अपने घर से 12वा है।
says: The reason for the spouse quarrel: Mercury is placed twelfth from its own house, here meaning the house of the relation concerned.
cells_derived_method: Planet or lord in the 12th from a house damages that house: Mercury in the 6th damages the 7th, in the 3rd damages the 4th, in the 11th damages the 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Virgo in the 6th is 12th from the 7th, so partner matters suffer.
Derived: Mercury in Aquarius in the 3rd is 12th from the 4th, so mother and home comfort suffer.
Derived: Mercury in Libra in the 11th is 12th from the 12th, a mild effect on expense matters.

ambiguity: 'Apne ghar se 12va' could mean 12th from Mercury's own sign house; read as relative to the house of the relation. Caption is garbled.
classical_check: The 'twelfth from a house harms it' rule is classical.

hindi: यहां तीन नंबर का राशि है और बुध यहां बैठा है। यह व्यक्ति अपनी मां से दुनिया भर का क्लेश करेगा। दुनिया भर की बहस करेगा। तंग करेगा। परेशानी पैदा करेगा।
says: In this second pointed case Mercury is in the sign number 3 position and the person will quarrel endlessly with the mother, argue, harass and create trouble.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in the 3rd is the 12th from the 4th house of mother, so the mother relation and home comfort take the hit. Sign sets the style: Gemini talkative, Aries combative, Scorpio bitter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Aries in the 3rd, fierce open arguing with the mother.
Derived: Mercury in Scorpio in the 3rd, buried grudges and sharp words toward the mother.
Derived: Mercury in Aquarius in the 3rd, detached, ideological clashes with the mother.

ambiguity: 'Teen number ki rashi' may be sign Gemini or just house 3; either fits the 12th-from-4th logic as mother.
classical_check: Silent as a rule; the 12th-from-4th harm is a classical device.

hindi: हर हालत में प्रॉपर्टी जमीन जायदाद इसकी क्या रहेंगी? बीमार। 12वां घर बीमार है। बीमार रहेंगे। इसको प्रॉपर्टी का सलूशन मिलेगा नहीं। पन्ना पहनना ही पड़ेगा।
says: Property, land and real estate will remain sick because Mercury is in the 12th from the 4th; the person will not get a property solution and must wear an emerald.
cells_derived_method: 4th house stands for property and land, so Mercury in the 3rd (12th from it) drains property matters; other planets in the 3rd behave similarly, and sign colours the cause.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 3rd in own sign, property deals stall in paperwork and talk.
Derived: Mercury in Capricorn in the 3rd, property delayed by heavy obstacles and slow processes.

ambiguity: 'Sick 12th house' needs the reading that the 12th from the 4th is meant, i.e. the 3rd house.
classical_check: The 12th from the 4th as loss of property is classical logic.

gist: Pointing at the diagram: sign number 3 here and Mercury sits retrograde or not retrograde, leave it; Mercury sits here and here. House numbers are not in the caption.

hindi: यह घर को जगह इसका मालिक सोया पड़ा है। मरा पड़ा है। इस घर का मालिक अपने से आठवां चला गया है। यह भी मृत्यु स्थान है।
says: The lord of a house is asleep or dead when it goes to the 8th from its own house, which is also a place of death.
cells_derived_method: Count 8 from the house the lord rules: lord of 3rd in the 10th, lord of 4th in the 11th, lord of 7th in the 2nd. Such a lord is called asleep, and its house matters need waking.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lord of the 3rd placed in the 10th (8th from 3rd), 3rd-house matters sleep, courage and siblings are not helped.
Derived: lord of the 4th placed in the 11th (8th from 4th), home and comfort matters sleep.

ambiguity: 'Mrityu sthan' here is the 8th counted from the lord's own house, not the chart's 8th house.
classical_check: Agrees with classical shashtashtaka and 6/8 relation as an unfavourable relation between a house and its lord.

hindi: यह अपने से यहां पर छठा चला गया है। यहां पर छठा चला गया है। आपको पन्ना पहनना चाहिए।
says: The lord placed in the 6th from its own house is also weak, and in that case you should wear the emerald.
cells_derived_method: Count 6 from the house the lord rules: lord of 3rd in the 8th, lord of 4th in the 9th, lord of 7th in the 12th. The gem is meant to wake the lord of that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lord of the 3rd in the 8th (6th from 3rd), 3rd-house matters struggle until the lord is woken.
Derived: lord of the 7th placed in the 12th (6th from 7th), partner matters weak and drained.

ambiguity: Counting from the lord's own house is inferred; the caption is partly garbled.
classical_check: The 6/8 relation is classical; the gem remedy for it is his.

hindi: दशा राहु की चल रही है। दशा को छोड़ दो।
says: Even if the Rahu dasha is running, set the dasha aside when deciding on the emerald.
ambiguity: Whether he says to ignore the dasha for gem choice or to ignore it for this example is unclear.
classical_check: Differs from the classical advice to check the running dasha lord before a gem.

hindi: याद रखें जीवन के अंदर दशाएं बदलती रही। अभी शनि बदला है कल। बदल रहा है। शनि तो 36 बार बदला है। मंगल बदला, राहु बदला। जिंदगी तो वैसी ही चल रही है।
says: Dashas keep changing through life, Saturn, Mars and Rahu periods have come and gone many times, yet life carries on the same, so do not be shaken by a dasha change.
ambiguity: 'Shani 36 times' is loose; may mean Saturn transits or dasha changes. No fixed number is meant literally.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पिछले 20 साल से जिंदगी वैसे ही झंड चल रही है। जो चल रही थी। पिछले 6 महीनों से वैसे ही चल रही है। 20 साल से बच्चे ऐसे कहना ही नहीं मान रहे। तो राहु केतु मंगल तो बदलते रहे।
says: Many people see their life stuck in the same bad pattern for years, even though Rahu, Ketu and Mars periods kept changing, which shows that dasha changes alone do not fix a basic chart problem.
ambiguity: Whether 'badalte rahe' means dashas or transits is not clear; context suggests dashas.
classical_check: Differs from classical emphasis on dasha as the main timing tool; he ranks the natal chart above it.

hindi: सबसे प्रमुख कुंडली सेट करो। फिर दशाओं पर आओ।
says: Priority order: fix the natal chart first with remedies, and only then look at the dashas.
classical_check: Differs from the usual practice of reading dasha along with the chart.

hindi: दशा तो कई किस्म की देखते हैं। अष्टोत्री, वेशोत्री, राशि की, योगिनी दशा पता नहीं कौन-कौन सी देखते हैं देखने वाले।
says: Astrologers use many dasha systems such as Ashtottari, Vimshottari, sign-based (rashi) dashas and Yogini; he is not going into which one.
ambiguity: 'Veshottari' is a caption slip for Vimshottari.
classical_check: All named systems exist in classical literature.

hindi: लेकिन गोचर सबके लिए समान है। यह सेम चलेगा।
says: Transit is the same for everybody, so it works the same way for all people at a given time.
ambiguity: He means the planets' positions are common; their house effect still varies by each person's lagna and moon sign.
classical_check: Classical gochara is read from the Moon sign, so the effect is personal; his statement is about sky positions only.

hindi: आपके तीन नंबर के राशि को जगाना है तो बुध उस घर को जिंदा करेगा, सेट करेगा।
says: To awaken the sign number 3 (Gemini) house in your chart, Mercury, its lord, will bring that house alive and set it right.
cells_derived_method: Whatever house Gemini falls in, its topic gets revived by Mercury's remedy: Gemini in the 7th means partnerships, in the 10th means career, in the 4th means home.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini in the 7th, an emerald or Mercury remedy revives spouse and partnership matters (lagna is Sagittarius).
Derived: Gemini in the 10th, Mercury remedy revives career matters (lagna is Virgo).
Derived: Gemini in the 4th, Mercury remedy revives home and mother matters (lagna is Pisces).

ambiguity: 'Teen number ke rashi' could be the house number 3; I take it as sign 3 as the 'ghar' language shows sign-as-house usage.
classical_check: Agrees with strengthening a house through its lord.

hindi: उसके पश्चात जिस ग्रह के साथ बुध बैठ के अगर शनि के साथ है, मंगल के साथ है, कोई और वक्री हो गया तो उसका स्टोन डलवाना है।
says: After Mercury's stone, also put the stone of whichever planet Mercury sits with, such as Saturn or Mars, or of any other planet that is retrograde.
ambiguity: 'Daalwana' is stone-setting; whether all stones together or in sequence is not said.
classical_check: Differs: classical advice avoids gems of natural enemies like Saturn together with Mercury's emerald in some cases; he gives no caution here.

hindi: स्टोन क्यों डलवाना है? क्योंकि जिंदगी भर की करेक्शन है।
says: Reason for stones: they are a correction meant to last the whole life.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Criticism of pandits who give a small remedy for 500 or 1000 rupees so people keep returning every 15 days, 2 months or 6 months, like repeated doctor visits.
Doctor analogy: people take 1000-rupee medicines for ten years but avoid the surgeon who asks 4 lakh, and worsen the condition.

hindi: इसलिए मोटा इलाज एक बार करो।
says: Conclusion of his analogy: do one big, thorough remedy once rather than many small ones.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: More analogies about building a good house once and marrying a good girl for life, none of which concern a chart rule.
Joke dialogue where the daughter wants a prince with a white horse and refuses a plumber.
Closing of the analogy: nobody asks for a second-hand motorbike at the price of a new one.

hindi: तो जिंदगी भर के लिए एक अच्छा उपाय करो।
says: Take one good lifelong remedy instead of repeated small fixes.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Argues surgeons are called thieves because they charge a lot, but they are seen only once so no pension-like repeat visits are needed.

hindi: और ग्रह का पॉइंट समझिए। वो एक ही बार में चढ़ावा लेता है। बुध क्या है? धन। सारा कैश, सारा रोकड़ा बुद्ध है।
says: Planet point: a planet takes its offering in one go; and Mercury stands for money, all cash and liquid funds are Mercury.
classical_check: Mercury as karaka of trade and commerce is classical; he narrows it to cash.

hindi: अब डॉक्टर को भी बोल दिया आपने कमांड दे दी कि डॉक्टर तो चोर है। अब आपको सर्जन भी चोर ही मिलेगा। आपने कहा नहीं देवता है भगवान है। आपको डॉक्टर में भगवान मिल जाएगा।
says: Since Mercury is the planet of speech and command, whatever you declare about doctors, thief or god, is what you will meet; your own words set the experience.
classical_check: Silent; a belief-based principle tied to Mercury's speech karaka.

gist: Says people have made surgeons into thieves but they save you from death and are nothing less than God.

hindi: इसलिए महंगे को लोग सिर्फ पैसे से नापते हैं जबकि आप धन को जब फेंक देते हैं तन मन धन धन पे बलि चली जाती है और बाकी सब ठीक हो जाता है।
says: People judge an expensive remedy only by price, but when you throw away money, body, mind and money, the sacrifice falls on the money and everything else gets fine.
ambiguity: Garbled sentence; read as money taking the sacrifice in place of body and mind.
classical_check: Silent; resembles the daan or offering idea.

hindi: आपके स्नायु रोग हड्डी सारे के सारे मस्तिष्क की मांसपेश नसें ये सारी की सारी बुध है।
says: Nerve disorders, bones, brain, muscles and nerves all belong to Mercury; recorded as a karaka list, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Bones are not a classical Mercury item (Saturn); health claim, no diagnosis implied.
classical_check: Mercury as karaka of nerves and brain is classical; bones differ (Saturn).

hindi: इसलिए बुद्धि भ्रष्ट यदि है तो बुध के उपाय चाहिए।
says: If the intellect is corrupted or confused, Mercury remedies are needed.
classical_check: Agrees with Mercury as karaka of intellect.
