hindi: आपको नाक छिदवाना है। ये एक वन ऑफ़ द यूनिवर्सल उपायों में से है।
says: Piercing the nose is one of the universal remedies for Mercury.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मूंग की दाल दान करनी है। मूंग की दाल धर्म स्थान में दान करो। 9 किलो दो ज्यादा देना चाहे दे दे।
says: Mercury remedy: donate green gram dal at a place of worship, 9 kg, more if one wishes.
classical_check: Moong is a classical Mercury grain for donation.

hindi: ढाक के पत्ते आते हैं। ढाक का पत्ता होता है। बुध माना जाता है इसको। इसको कच्चे दूध से धो के जल प्रवाह नदी में जमुना में कर दें।
says: Mercury remedy: take dhak (palash) leaves, regarded as Mercury's, wash them with raw milk and immerse them in a flowing river such as the Yamuna.
classical_check: Silent; palash is more usually linked to the Moon or Sun in tradition.

hindi: आग के पौधे से शादी कराई जाती है। सूर्य बुध का कॉम्बिनेशन है।
says: A symbolic marriage to the aak (madar) plant is arranged, because that plant is a Sun and Mercury combination.
ambiguity: Caption writes 'aag ke paudhe', which is read as 'aak'.
classical_check: Arka vivaha is a known traditional remedy, usually for Mars or manglik; linking it to Sun-Mercury is his own.

hindi: किसी की शादी की खराबी है। सातवें घर में लड़कों के लिए बॉयज बॉय के लिए है। सातवें घर में बुध नीच का है। कोई भी ग्रह नीच का है। सूर्य नीच का है। आंख के पौधे से शादी कराओ।
says: For boys with a marriage problem, when the 7th house holds a debilitated planet, such as Mercury or the Sun, do the plant marriage with the aak plant.
cells_derived_method: Any debilitated planet in the 7th qualifies: Mars in Cancer, Moon in Scorpio, Jupiter in Capricorn, Venus in Virgo, Saturn in Aries. The Sun in Libra in the 7th fits Aries lagna; Mercury in Pisces in the 7th fits Virgo lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in its fall sign in the 7th (Aries lagna), authority clash and pride in marriage, plant marriage prescribed.
Derived: Mercury in its fall sign in the 7th (Virgo lagna), confused talk and mismatch with the spouse, plant marriage prescribed.
Derived: Jupiter in its fall sign in the 7th (Cancer lagna), reduced marriage blessing, same remedy by his general rule.

ambiguity: Says 'boys' only; unclear if girls need a different step. Caption writes 'aankh ke paudhe' for aak.
classical_check: Arka vivaha is classically for severe marital affliction, mainly Mars; extending it to any debilitated planet is his own.

hindi: अक आंकड़ा आंखें ऐसे शब्द अलग-अलग है। उससे उसकी शादी करा दो। शादी होने से ठीक पहले। तब आपकी शादी का हिसाब किताब सेटल रहेगा।
says: The aak plant goes by several local names; marry the person to it just before the real wedding, and then the marriage accounts stay settled.
classical_check: Silent on timing; consistent with arka vivaha practice before the wedding.

hindi: 12 नंबर बुध यहां बैठा है। कभी भी अपनी पत्नी या पति को रुपया, कैश, कागज किसी भी किस्म का हैंड टू हैंड मत दो। बुध टच हुआ है।
says: With Mercury in sign number 12, sitting in the 7th house, never hand cash, money or papers directly into the spouse's hand, since Mercury gets touched.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Pisces in the 7th means Virgo lagna. The same hand-to-hand money idea applies to a weak Mercury elsewhere that shares the 7th, e.g. Mercury in the 7th with a harmful planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo lagna with Mercury in fall in the 7th, direct cash handover to the spouse leads to disputes over money and papers.

ambiguity: '12 number' is clarified by the audience reply as the 7th house, so it is sign 12 in house 7. Earlier in the series '12 number' sometimes meant house 12.
classical_check: Silent; this is a vastu-like practical rule.

gist: Audience asks how one would know the effect after giving the money.
Banter that the wife can never be greedier than him, and a joke about asking for alms in Brahmin style.
Audience asks if the rule about not giving money to the partner holds for the 12-number Mercury sitting in any house.

hindi: किसी भी हाउस में बैठा हुआ है। ना सेवंथ हाउस। सेवंथ हाउस में।
says: Clarification: the hand-to-hand cash restriction applies only when that Mercury sits in the 7th house, not in any house.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपका बच्चा है। 12 नंबर यहां बैठा है। आपको नेचुरली सेक्स के द्वारा बच्चे नहीं होंगे।
says: With the 12-number Mercury placed in the child house, you will not have children by natural conception; stated as his tradition claim, not a medical statement.
cells_derived_method: Child matters are read from the 5th house; Mercury in Pisces in the 5th means Scorpio lagna. The same logic applies to a weak Mercury in the 9th with the 5th from 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio lagna with Mercury in fall in the 5th, children come late or need support, as claimed.
Derived: Cancer lagna with Mercury in fall in the 9th, the 5th from the 5th, a weaker secondary indicator for children.

ambiguity: 'Yahan' is the child house; I took it as the 5th. Fertility claim flagged as non-medical.
classical_check: Mercury in the 5th is classically associated with few children or delayed issue, so partly agrees.

hindi: गया जाओ पितृ शांति करो।
says: Remedy for this childlessness pattern: go to Gaya and perform pitru shanti.
classical_check: Pitru shanti at Gaya for childlessness is classical.

hindi: आईवीएफ कराओ एक बार आईवीएफ दो बार आईयूआई कम से कम फेल होगा ही होगा और उसके पैसे भरो
says: Predicts that IVF or IUI will fail at least once or twice before it works, so one must pay for the attempts; this is his claim only, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Medical-treatment prediction; recorded only as what he said and not to be used for medical decisions.
classical_check: Silent; assisted conception is not in classical texts.

hindi: पैसे पे डालना पड़ेगा बुध पैसा कागज नोट हां जी सब पैसे दिए मेरे पैसे हैं तुम जाके भाभी को दे दो या मम्मी को दे
says: Workaround: since Mercury is money, paper and notes, hand the money over through a third person, such as telling the spouse's relative to pass it, rather than hand to hand.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled and the sentence runs into the next chunk; meaning is my best reading.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Garbled objections and dialogue about handing money to someone, that person being a stranger who keeps influencing the house; the point is not recoverable.

hindi: पैसे के लेनदेन की बात नहीं है। केस स्पेसिफिक बात हो रही है कि ऐसी स्थिति हो तो गड़बड़ है।
says: Clarifies that this is not a general rule about money dealings; it is case-specific and applies only to charts with that placement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब आपका बुध 12 नंबर का यहां पड़ा हुआ है। 12 नंबर का बुध आपका धर्म स्थान में है। यहां आपने कैश दिया धर्म स्थान में तो आपकी जिंदगी नर्क हो जाएगी। आपने नीच का बुध प्लेस कर दिया धर्म स्थान में।
says: Case: Mercury in sign 12 (its fall) in the 9th house of religion; if you give cash at a religious place, your life turns into hell, as you have effectively placed a debilitated Mercury in the dharma house.
cells_derived_method: 9th is dharma, temple and fortune. Mercury in Pisces in the 9th means Cancer lagna. Money given at a religious place feeds the debilitated Mercury there; other Mercury cells would react differently.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer lagna with Mercury in fall in the 9th, cash donations in temples bring harm instead of merit, as claimed.
Derived: Mercury in its own and exalted sign in the 9th (Capricorn lagna), the same donation would not carry this penalty.

ambiguity: 'Dharm sthan' read as the 9th house; could also be the physical temple.
classical_check: Silent; classics do not prohibit donations in this way.

hindi: बृहस्पति को साइड कर देगा। साइड पेन देगा। यह घुटना है।
says: Mercury placed in the 9th pushes Jupiter, the natural 9th-house karaka, aside, and gives side pain, which he identifies with the knee.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's house topics (dharma, father, fortune) lose support when Mercury occupies them; the body part he names, the knee, is the 9th house region. Sign decides how strongly: Pisces is Jupiter's own sign, so Mercury is awkward there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mercury in Jupiter's own sign in the 9th, fortune and father matters slip, with knee-side discomfort per his claim.

ambiguity: Health item, tradition claim only.
classical_check: Knee is classically linked to the 10th or Saturn, not the 9th; differs.

hindi: घुटने की हड्डी के बीच में जॉइंट खत्म हो जाएगा आपका। हड्डी है। यह जॉइंट खत्म कर देता है बुध। यह प्रॉब्लम कर देगा।
says: Mercury's affliction can wear away the knee joint; recorded as his tradition claim, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: Medical-type claim, flagged; whether it is limited to the 9th placement is not stated.
classical_check: Differs: bones and joints belong to Saturn in classical texts.

hindi: बुध के पास इंटेस्टाइन है। आपका पेट ही साफ नहीं होगा। आप हर समय कैसी कब्ज से परेशान रहोगे? दस्त भरी कब्ज। यानी कब्ज जब भी रिलीज होगी ऑलवेज लूज मोशन होगा।
says: Intestines belong to Mercury, so an afflicted Mercury leaves the stomach never clean, with constipation that, when released, always gives loose motions; his tradition claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Health claim, flagged, not to be used for diagnosis.
classical_check: Mercury governing the bowels and nervous system is classical in medical astrology.

hindi: इंटेस्टाइन में प्रॉब्लम है। कड़च कड़च चल रहा है। चर्निंग होती रहती है। पेन होता है। ये इंटेस्टाइन बुध के पास है आपके।
says: Gut trouble with churning and cramping pain is Mercury's department, because the intestines are Mercury's; recorded as a karaka claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Health item, tradition claim only.
classical_check: Agrees: bowels and nervous system are classical Mercury significations.

hindi: जिनका इस घर में होगा वो कुछ चीज़ लेके पैसे से चीज़ दे दे पैसा नहीं देना रुपया नहीं देना
says: Those who have Mercury in this pointed house should give an item bought with money rather than giving cash or rupees directly.
ambiguity: 'Is ghar' is the 7th house from the earlier case; not explicitly named in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: 12 नंबर का बुध यहां पर है आपका अनजान लोगों में आपने कैश बांटा आपकी जिंदगी नर्क है
says: With the 12-number Mercury in this placement, distributing cash among strangers makes your life a hell.
cells_derived_method: Charity to strangers matters in the 9th (dharma) or 11th (gains) areas; Mercury in Pisces in the 9th means Cancer lagna, in the 11th means Taurus lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in fall in the 9th (Cancer lagna), cash handed to strangers in the name of dharma backfires.
Derived: Mercury in fall in the 11th (Taurus lagna), cash given to friends and acquaintances is lost without return.

ambiguity: House of the placement is pointed, not named; 12-number is read as the sign Pisces.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कमर से नीचे पैर तोड़ देगा ये कमर से नीचे का हिस्सा ये घुटने हैं साइड का पेन है
says: This Mercury placement damages the lower body from the waist down, the legs and knees, with side pain; recorded as a tradition claim, not medical.
ambiguity: Health claim; lower-body link may come from Pisces being the feet sign.
classical_check: Pisces rules the feet in the natural zodiac, which loosely fits.

hindi: लीवर भी इसके पास है अगर बृहस्पति का दोष होता है तो ग्रेड वन फैटी लिवर क्यों है सबको इंटेस्टाइन अपसेट बुध का और बृहस्पति का दोष
says: The liver is also in this scheme; with a Jupiter fault comes fatty liver, and the common gut upset reflects a fault of both Mercury and Jupiter. Health claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Whether liver belongs to Mercury or Jupiter is blurred in the caption; he ties the liver to Jupiter's fault.
classical_check: Liver is classically Jupiter's; the gut is Mercury's, so the pairing agrees.

hindi: आपका पीलिया बिगाड़ देगा जुपिटर का दोष चाहिए उसके अंदर तभी तो हेपेटाइटिस होते हैं। ए बी सी डी जितने होते हैं।
says: Jaundice and hepatitis of all types need a Jupiter fault inside the chart; recorded as his claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Health claim, flagged.
classical_check: Jupiter as karaka of liver is classical; the specific rule is his.

gist: Audience asks if one may receive but not give; he jokes about how nicely people put it.

hindi: जैसे सेवंथ हाउस में है। अगर कहीं भी है ना मरने दो ना उसको। ठीक है। पैसे आ रहे हैं आने दो।
says: If it is in the 7th house, or anywhere, receiving money is fine; let the money come, only giving cash by hand is the issue.
ambiguity: Garbled; read as permission to accept money.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब पत्नी को कैश दे ना लेकिन अगर पत्नी हमें कैश दो उसके पास रख दो।
says: Do not hand cash to the wife, and if she hands you cash, leave it with her instead of taking it into your own hand.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled; the second half may mean something else.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर आपकी पत्नी का बुध नीच का है और उसे आपसे तलाक चाहिए तो मैं उसे उपाय बताऊंगा। पति को अपनी झूठी हरी दाल खिलाओ।
says: If the wife's Mercury is debilitated and she wants a divorce, the remedy is to feed the husband her own leftover green dal.
ambiguity: Wife's own chart is the basis; whether it is the same for a husband's Mercury is not said.
classical_check: Silent; it resembles a folk bonding remedy.

gist: Comic reaction to what he just advised: everyone will go and feed it.

hindi: तलाक नहीं होगा जब तक ग्रह बिगड़े नहीं हुए। नवंश में दोष नहीं है। खूब झगड़ा होगा।
says: Divorce will not happen as long as the planets are not badly spoilt and there is no fault in the navamsha; there will be plenty of quarrelling instead.
cells_derived_method: Divorce needs affliction of the 7th and Venus in both D1 and D9; with only Mercury weak the result is verbal quarrels. A clean navamsha 7th keeps the marriage intact.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 7th but a clean navamsha, so quarrels but not separation.
Derived: harsh Mars-ruled 7th with navamsha afflicted too, where the divorce risk would rise on his logic.

ambiguity: 'Navansh mein dosh nahi hai' is read as a condition, not a fact for all.
classical_check: Agrees with the idea that D9 confirms marital outcomes.

hindi: और कौन सा वाला झगड़ा होगा? हे हाथ वाला नहीं होगा। वो मंगल का होता है।
says: The quarrel will not be physical, hand-raising fighting, because that kind belongs to Mars.
classical_check: Mars as karaka of physical violence is classical.

hindi: चमड़ चमड़ चमड़ चबड़ चबड़ आई मेरे काम खा गई ये तू मेरे काम खा गया। ये बुध की लड़ाई है।
says: Endless nagging and bickering, the kind where each says you ate up my work, is Mercury's type of fight.
classical_check: Silent; Mercury as speech karaka fits.

hindi: शुक्र की लड़ाई कौन सी है? मुंह फेर के सो गए।
says: Venus's kind of fight is turning your face away and going to sleep, the silent cold shoulder.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Promises to discuss the types of fights separately later.
Garbled question about which fight is best, with a muddled answer about beating and ugliness.

hindi: वह तो दोष काफी खराब हो जाता है। प्लूटो जैसे की हो तो वह कत्ल कर देता है। जान से मार देता है।
says: When the fault is of Pluto's kind it becomes very bad and can lead to killing; recorded as his claim about Pluto's violent nature, not a prediction for anyone.
ambiguity: Context is the type of fight; Pluto is the extreme case. A death-related claim, flagged.
classical_check: Silent; Pluto is not in classical astrology.

gist: Repeats that such a fault can lead to murder.

hindi: अगर लग्न में 12 नंबर राशि है। लग्न में 12 नंबर राशि बैड। नॉट गुड। लेकिन उसमें जुपिटर देखना पड़ेगा।
says: If the ascendant is sign number 12, Pisces, it is bad, not good, but you must check Jupiter in it before judging.
cells_derived_method: Pisces in the 1st puts Mercury as lord of the 4th and 7th, weak in its fall when it sits in the lagna; Jupiter's strength and placement then decides the outcome, e.g. Jupiter in the 1st, 5th or 9th protects.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces lagna with Mercury in the 1st in fall, personality unsettled; Jupiter in lagna would shield it.
Derived: Pisces lagna has Virgo in the 7th, so Mercury sitting there is exalted and own-sign, which reverses the bad reading for partnerships.

ambiguity: '12 number rashi in lagna' is read as Pisces lagna; the 'bad' context follows the Mercury fall discussion.
classical_check: Differs: Pisces lagna is ruled by Jupiter and is classically considered a benefic lagna.

hindi: साथ में कोई और प्लनेट बैठा है। क्योंकि बुध की सबसे बड़ी खासियत है। दूसरे के हिसाब से बदल जाता है। वो दूसरे के अनुसार चलेगा वो।
says: Also check which other planet sits with Mercury, because Mercury's biggest trait is that it changes to match the other planet and acts according to it.
cells_derived_method: Mercury with Mars acts combative, with Venus pleasing, with Saturn heavy and serious, with Jupiter wise; the house adds the field.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury with Mars in the 3rd, sharp, aggressive writing and speech.
Derived: Mercury with Venus in the 7th, charming and negotiating communication with partners.
Derived: Mercury with Saturn in the 10th, disciplined, serious business talk.

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury takes the nature of the planet it joins.

hindi: हरे रंग का जो कद्दू होता है जो अंदर से खोखला हो उसका हलवा बना करके धर्म स्थान में दो। ये वैसे ही देते रहो नियम से कोई बुराई नहीं है।
says: Remedy: make halwa from a green pumpkin or gourd that is hollow inside and give it at a religious place, and keep giving it regularly, there is no harm.
ambiguity: Which vegetable he means is uncertain, a green hollow gourd.
classical_check: Silent; green items are Mercury's by tradition.

hindi: अब बुध चाहे नौ नंबर का है चाहे बुध 12 नंबर का है। एक समान दोष मान के चलो ये बर्बाद कर देगा खत्म। ये खराब कर देगा।
says: Whether Mercury is in sign 9 (Sagittarius) or sign 12 (Pisces), treat the fault as the same, since it ruins the matter either way.
cells_derived_method: Both are Jupiter-ruled signs in the 4th-from-Mercury relationship; Mercury there is awkward. Sagittarius in the 1st or the 4th, Pisces in the 7th give different life areas.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Sagittarius in the 1st, scattered thinking and over-promising.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 7th, confused partnership dealings.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 4th, unclear home and emotional matters.

ambiguity: 'Nau number' is sign 9 and '12 number' sign 12; both are Jupiter signs; which houses he points at is not shown.
classical_check: Classically Mercury is debilitated in Pisces but only neutral to uncomfortable in Sagittarius; calling them the same fault is his claim.

hindi: बुध दोनों राशियों में ही प्रॉब्लम क्रिएट करता है। लेकिन इन राशियों के जो मालिक है केतु और बुध ये नाराज नहीं होते इससे
says: Mercury creates problems in both of those signs, yet the lords of these signs, named as Ketu and Mercury, do not get upset by this.
ambiguity: Caption garbled on who the lords are; Pisces may be Ketu's in his scheme, but 'Mercury' as lord of these signs does not fit Sagittarius.
classical_check: Differs: lord of Sagittarius is Jupiter, of Pisces Jupiter (or Ketu in his scheme).

hindi: बुध एक खास बात है। बुध नपुंसक ग्रह है और दुर्गा माता की तरह है। दुर्गा के भक्त देवता भी हैं और राक्षस भी हैं।
says: Mercury is a neuter planet and like Goddess Durga, whose devotees include both gods and demons, so it is acceptable to all.
classical_check: Neuter nature of Mercury is classical; the Durga comparison is his.

hindi: बुध ग्रह अगर यहां बैठ गया है तो देवता हो चाहे राक्षस शुभ ग्रह हो चाहे पाप ग्रह हो सब की बुद्धि से बनती है। आप अपनी बुद्धि लेके कहीं भी चले जाओ। सब जगह बनती है।
says: Mercury gets along with the intellect of every planet, gods or demons, benefic or malefic, so wherever you take your intellect you can find a fit.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is neutral toward most planets in classical friendship tables.

hindi: आप सब सुन सकते हो, सब बात कर सकते हो। गंदा कर लो, अच्छा कर लो, फालतू के चुटकले कर लो, ज्ञान की बातें कर लो। बुद्ध हर जगह एडजस्ट करता है और ये परिवर्तित होता है।
says: Mercury lets you listen to anyone and talk about anything, dirty or good, jokes or wisdom; it adjusts everywhere and keeps changing.
classical_check: Mercury as the adaptable, mutable planet is classical.

hindi: तो ये दैत्यों का भी दोस्त है और राक्षसों का भी दोस्त है। लफड़ा सिर्फ ये है कि चंद्रमा का नाश करता है।
says: Mercury is a friend of both demon camps, and its only trouble is that it destroys the Moon.
cells_derived_method: Moon-Mercury contact harms the Moon's matters: mother, mind, emotions. The house shows where, e.g. 4th mind and mother, 1st mood, 7th spouse's mood.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury joining Moon in the 4th, peace of mind and mother's comfort suffer.
Derived: Moon with Mercury in the 1st, restless, overthinking mood.
Derived: Moon with Mercury in the 7th, spouse's mind is anxious and critical.

ambiguity: 'Daityon aur rakshason' repeats the same group; likely he meant gods and demons.
classical_check: Classically the Moon is friendly to Mercury while Mercury is enemy to the Moon; his claim of Mercury destroying the Moon matches that one-sided enmity.

hindi: मरकरी एक ऐसी वो मेटल है लिक्विड मेटल है कि अगर उसको सल्फ्यूरिक एसिड में मिला दो यानी मंगल में तो मंगल के साथ मिक्स ही नहीं होती।
says: Mercury the metal is a liquid that does not mix with sulphuric acid, which he equates with Mars, so Mercury and Mars do not blend.
ambiguity: Chemistry analogy; the sulphuric acid to Mars link is his own.
classical_check: Classically Mars and Mercury are mutual enemies, so the conclusion agrees.

gist: Analogy that fire cannot be taken into space, with unclear connection.

hindi: अगर पेट में चला गया मरकरी तो आपकी किडनी डैमेज करता है। किडनी में क्या है? पानी ब्रेन में पानी आपका डैमेज होता है।
says: Swallowed mercury metal damages the kidney and the water in the brain, used to show Mercury's link to kidney and brain water; his claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Mixes chemistry with astrology.
classical_check: Silent; kidney is classically Venus or Mars region.

hindi: इसलिए आपके जो अपशब्द है ना बुरे शब्द डर के मारे किडनी सिकुड़ जाती है। और बुरी बात सुनने, क्लेश करने, बहस करने से माथा गर्म हो जाता है।
says: Bad words and fear make the kidney contract, and hearing ugly talk, quarrelling and arguing heat up the head.
ambiguity: Health claim, flagged.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए आपके बुद्ध वाणी के द्वारा आप कुछ भी अच्छा बुरा करो ना करो आपकी किडनी और ब्रेन का लॉस होएगा होएगा। हर हालत में होगा
says: Through Mercury's speech, whether your talk is good or bad, kidney and brain take a loss in any case.
ambiguity: Health claim, flagged.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अगर यह एक्टिवेटेड रहता है यानी बोलते रहते हैं तो जल्दी मरते नहीं। आपको मरने नहीं देगा। क्योंकि शनि का परम मित्र है, प्लूटो का परम मित्र है।
says: A Mercury kept active by constant talking keeps you from dying early, since Mercury is the closest friend of Saturn and Pluto, the death planets; a general longevity claim, not a prediction.
ambiguity: Longevity claim, flagged as non-predictive.
classical_check: Mercury is a friend of Saturn classically; the longevity link is his own.

hindi: आपने देखा होगा बूढ़े लोग हे भगवान बोलते ही रहते हैं। ये चुप नहीं होते। मरते नहीं है वो। केतु है जवान, बुद्ध है वाणी। बुद्ध कह रहा है मैं तो जवान हूं।
says: Evidence he offers: old people who never stop talking do not seem to die, because Mercury, the voice, keeps feeling young.
ambiguity: 'Ketu is young' is unclear; probably a caption error for Mercury as the youthful planet.
classical_check: Mercury as the ever-youthful planet is classical.

hindi: इसलिए आपकी वाणी के ऊपर आपने यदि मौन ले लिया तो शनि अच्छे से एक्टिवेट होता है। और शनि जो है लक्ष्मी है।
says: Taking silence over your speech activates Saturn properly, and Saturn is Lakshmi, the wealth giver.
ambiguity: Saturn as Lakshmi is his own framing.
classical_check: Differs: classically Venus is the Lakshmi karaka; Saturn rules longevity and labour.

hindi: अगर मन का मौन आपने सीख लिया मन में अलग चल रहा है।
says: Mere outward silence is not enough; inner silence of the mind is what counts, otherwise the mind keeps running something else.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk and is partly garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कुछ-कुछ मुंह से सिर्फ बोल नहीं रहे तो आप धनवान नहीं बन पाओगे। धनवान बनना है तो आपको बुध और शनि की मिक्सिंग चाहिए।
says: Wealth does not come merely from keeping the mouth shut; to become rich you need Mercury and Saturn mixed together.
cells_derived_method: Mercury-Saturn links in the 2nd, 10th or 11th house tie speech and discipline to money and career; sign affects the quality: Capricorn and Aquarius favour it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury with Saturn in the 2nd in Capricorn, steady wealth through disciplined speech and trade.
Derived: Mercury with Saturn in the 11th in Aquarius, gains through networks and technical business.
Derived: Mercury with Saturn in the 10th in Virgo, wealth via accounts, analysis and service.

ambiguity: 'Mixing' could mean conjunction, aspect, or only combining their behaviours.
classical_check: Mercury-Saturn friendship is classical and the pairing is seen as good for business.

hindi: शनि पुरुष नपुंसक है। बुध स्त्री नपुंसक है। यह दोनों ग्रह जब जुड़ जाते हैं आपस में तो नपुंसक भी पैदा होते हैं।
says: Saturn is the male-neuter and Mercury the female-neuter; when the two join, even neuter persons can be born; recorded as his gender-karaka claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Sensitive reproductive claim, flagged.
classical_check: Classics call both Saturn and Mercury neuter and relate their combination to such births, mostly via the 5th house.

hindi: नहीं तो जो व्यक्ति है स्त्री है चाहे पुरुष है उनको संतान संतति नहीं देगा। स्पर्म काउंट उड़ा देगा। एग नहीं देगा। सेक्स लाइफ नहीं लेने देगा।
says: Otherwise this combination denies children to both men and women, cutting sperm count, giving no eggs and spoiling sex life; his tradition claim, not medical.
cells_derived_method: Check the 5th house and the 7th: the combination in the 5th denies children directly, in the 7th hurts intimacy, in the 8th and 12th affects reproduction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn with Mercury in the 5th in Capricorn, children delayed or denied.
Derived: Saturn with Mercury in the 7th in Aquarius, cool and distant intimacy.
Derived: Saturn with Mercury in the 12th in Gemini, bed pleasures reduced.

ambiguity: Medical-type claim, flagged; he does not give a specific house.
classical_check: Saturn and Mercury in the 5th are classically linked to fewer children; the specific physical claims are his.

hindi: जो लोग ये कहते हैं ना मुझसे सुना नहीं जा रहा। मैं नहीं सुन सकता। मैं नहीं देख सकते। उनके आंखों और कानों को खराब कर देता है। और उनको अकेला रखता है लोनली।
says: People who keep saying they cannot bear to hear or see something will have their eyes and ears damaged by Mercury and end up lonely; his claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Health claim, flagged.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: धीरे-धीरे देखेंगे उनकी फिजिकल लाइफ डाउन होनी शुरू हो जाती है। इसलिए आपको कभी नहीं करना चाहिए। मेरे से नहीं सुना जाता। मेरे को मत बोलो। आपकी सेक्सुअल लाइफ डिस्टर्ब नहीं डिस्ट्रॉय हो जाएगी।
says: Do not ever say 'I cannot listen to this, do not tell me'; it slowly drags physical life down and ruins the sexual life; a don't labelled tradition.
ambiguity: Health and sexual claim, flagged.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ये इसके सीक्रेट्स हैं। आपके व्यवहार के द्वारा ही ये चीज़ सेटल होती हैं।
says: These are Mercury's secrets, and it is through your own behaviour that these things get settled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तोते की सेवा करो। हरी मिर्च खिलाओ। हिजड़ों को कुछ खिलाओ, पिलाओ।
says: Mercury remedies: serve a parrot, feed it green chillies, and give food and drink to eunuchs.
ambiguity: It is unclear whether the green chilli is for the parrot or a separate act.
classical_check: Parrot service and charity to eunuchs for Mercury are traditional remedies.

hindi: अपनी औररा चेक करनी है तो गाय माता को देखो पालक खाती है आपके हाथ से कि नहीं खाती है। आपको खुद पता लग जाएगा
says: A self-test: offer spinach to a cow and see whether she eats it from your hand; if she does not, it shows the state of your own Mercury aura.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the end; the conclusion about the planets in your body is missing.
classical_check: Silent; folk test.

hindi: इंटरेक्ट करने की शक्ति कितनी है। बुध मंगल इनकी चेकिंग होती है कि आपकी ओरा कैसी है।
says: Your power to interact with others, and the state of your aura, is judged by checking Mercury and Mars.
ambiguity: Start of the sentence is cut from the previous chunk; Mars may be a caption slip.
classical_check: Silent; aura reading is not a classical Jyotish topic.

hindi: ऐसे लोगों के हाथ से कुछ भी पेड़ या पौधा लगा के देखे अगर वो ग्रो कर गया मींस ओरा ठीक है। मर गया मींस आपकी ओरा ही सत्यानाश है।
says: Aura test: have the person plant a tree or sapling; if it grows the aura is fine, if it dies the aura is badly ruined.
classical_check: Silent; folk test.

hindi: पहले नजर उतारो। और सूर्य से नजर उतरती है नमक से। सूर्य इसका पापा है। नमक सूर्य है।
says: First remove the evil eye; the evil eye is removed with salt because salt is the Sun, and the Sun is the father of Mercury in his scheme.
ambiguity: 'Isska papa' is read as Sun being Mercury's father in his scheme.
classical_check: Silent; salt as the Sun is not classical, and Mercury is traditionally Moon's son.

hindi: तीन बार सिर के ऊपर से एंटीक्लॉकवाइज घुमाओ। पानी के अंदर डालो।
says: Procedure for removing the evil eye: wave the salt anticlockwise three times over the head and drop it into water.
classical_check: A common folk practice; not in classical Jyotish texts.

gist: A stray phrase about the Moon called 'uncle Chanda', context lost.
Audience asks whether talking nonsense for mind-body, as in 'Singh', is connected to Mercury.

hindi: बुध से कनेक्टेड है। यही वो इलाका है जिसको काट के राहु अलग और केतु अलग किया गया। देवताओं के जो समुद्र मंथन के समय पर और उस समुद्र मंथन में जो जोड़ है वो यही है। बुद्ध यही है।
says: Yes, it is connected to Mercury; Mercury is the joint region where the demon was cut so that Rahu and Ketu became separate, the junction point of the churning of the ocean.
ambiguity: The 'neck joint' reading is implied but not stated.
classical_check: Mythology of Svarbhanu split into Rahu and Ketu is classical; linking the joint to Mercury is his own.

hindi: ब्रह्मा और विष्णु ये दोनों पुरुष है। नर माने जाते हैं। शिव जो है वो स्त्री है। और वो यही वो जोड़ है।
says: Brahma and Vishnu are counted as male, Shiva is called female, and Mercury is the joint between these, a point of male-female meeting.
ambiguity: Calling Shiva female is unusual; may mean Shakti or the Ardhanarishvara form; caption garbled.
classical_check: Silent; mythological framing.

hindi: विष्णु ने भी मोहिनी रूप में आकर के ही कार्य किया था। सारा जो असुरों से अमृत को छीना वो मोहिनी रूप में लिया। विष्णु रूप में नहीं ले सकते थे।
says: Vishnu had to take the Mohini form to snatch the nectar from the demons, which he could not do in his male form, showing that Mercury's neuter or feminine nature does what male force cannot.
ambiguity: The Mercury link is implied, not stated in this sentence.
classical_check: Mohini story is from the Puranas, accurate; Mercury link is his own.

hindi: इसलिए बुध का शुक्र के साथ बहुत जबरदस्त युति होती है क्योंकि इसका एग्जैक्ट फॉलोइंग प्लनेट शुक्र है।
says: Mercury and Venus form a very strong conjunction because Venus is the exact planet that follows Mercury in his planetary order.
cells_derived_method: The pair gives skill with words, style and money; house names the field and sign decides dignity: Venus own in Taurus or Libra, Venus fallen in Virgo with Mercury strong.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign with Mercury in the 1st in Taurus, charming personality, attractive speech.
Derived: pair in the 7th in Libra, diplomatic, pleasant partner and trade dealings.
Derived: pair in the 10th in Virgo, Mercury strong but Venus weak, skilful work with strained comfort and relationships.

ambiguity: 'Following planet' is by distance from the Sun in his order of planets.
classical_check: Mercury-Venus conjunction is classically considered good for arts and trade.

hindi: आप बढ़िया कपड़े पहने, बढ़िया सुंदर परफ्यूम लगाएं वो शुक्र के लिए आप बढ़िया शब्द बोले, बढ़िया बातें करें।
says: For Venus wear good clothes and fine perfume, and for Mercury speak good words and have good conversations.
classical_check: Perfume and clothes as Venus remedies are traditional.

hindi: लेकिन अगर बुध में दोष है बोलने नहीं देगा। बैठा खराब स्थान के ऊपर है। दृष्टि किसी ग्रह की गलत है या वक्री है।
says: But if Mercury is faulty it will not let you speak well, the fault being a bad house placement, a wrong planet's aspect or retrogression.
cells_derived_method: Bad placements for Mercury in his usage are 12th and 6th, aspected by Mars or Saturn; the speech issue shows in the 2nd or 3rd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 12th in Libra, speech turns inward and holds back.
Derived: Mercury in the 6th in Aries, speech becomes combative, picking quarrels.

ambiguity: 'Kharab sthan' is not defined; the 12th and 6th are assumed from earlier talk.
classical_check: Agrees with affliction by house, aspect and retrogression, though retrograde as fault is his own.

hindi: वक्री दोष को तो सीधा सेट कर दो ना पन्ना पहन के।
says: A retrograde Mercury fault can be set right directly by wearing an emerald.
classical_check: Differs from the classical caution about checking the lord and dasha before a gem.

hindi: पन्ना लाइन वाला ना हो। कलर ग्रीन होना चाहिए। क्रैक ना हो।
says: Quality needs for the emerald: no inclusion lines, a true green colour, and no cracks.
classical_check: Agrees with classical gem flaw lists.

hindi: क्रैक है तो यह पंडित लोग कहते हैं आपके ऊपर कुछ होना था। इसने अपने पे ले लिया। नहीं वो तेल पिलाया हुआ पन्ना है। घटिया है इसलिए फट गया है।
says: When an emerald cracks, pandits say it took the harm meant for you; he rejects that and says it was an oil-treated, poor-quality stone that simply split.
classical_check: Differs from the common pandit belief; matches the gemmological fact that oiled emeralds can crack.

hindi: आपको बढ़िया पन्ना लेना है। 100 साल वाला पन्ना लो ना महंगा ही तो आएगा। बच्चे पैदा पांच साल के लिए थोड़ी करते हैं। पूरी जिंदगी के लिए तो करते हैं।
says: Buy a good emerald that lasts a hundred years even if expensive, like children, who are had for a lifetime and not just for five years.
ambiguity: Purchase guidance, recorded only as what he said.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Audience comment that many people boast big talk; he jokes 'we feed it ghee and almonds'.

hindi: वो शनि का लफड़ा है। अच्छा वो बुध का वो तो बुध तो वर्ण ही है मात्र।
says: Boasting and tall talk is Saturn's problem, not Mercury's, since Mercury is only the letters and sounds, the raw words.
ambiguity: Caption is choppy; the Mercury-as-varna point is my best reading.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नजर ओरा खत्म कर देता है शनि यह बुध का लफड़ा सिर्फ यह है कि आप बोल बोल के अपना रिश्ते खराब कान खराब आकाश तत्व खराब यह कर लेते हो
says: Saturn is what destroys the aura and evil-eye matters, while Mercury's trouble is only that by talking too much you spoil relationships, ears and the sky element.
ambiguity: The two sentences run together; first part about Saturn is partly garbled.
classical_check: Mercury governs ears and the air or sky element in tradition, which agrees.

hindi: व्यापारी ऐसे बात करता है कि आपको मीठी ही बात करेगा वही सफल है वो यही कहेगा भाई साहब आप ही तो भगवान हो थे कहां अब तक
says: The trader speaks only sweet words and flatters the customer as God, and that is why he is successful, showing the Mercury way of speech.
classical_check: Mercury as the merchant planet is classical.

hindi: सब पुरुषों को जाकर के साड़ी की दुकान पे काम करना चाहिए स्त्रियों को साड़ी बेचने की जॉब करे छ महीना आप में इतनी पेशेंस आ जाएगी आपकी पत्नी आपको खुद नौ लाखा हार ला के देगी।
says: Remedy for impatience: men should work six months in a sari shop selling to women, which builds so much patience that even the wife will bring gifts and never complain.
ambiguity: Partly humorous; read as a serious patience-building suggestion with a joke on the gift.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Shop story about the customer who says she has come only to look and not to buy, and the salesman's complaint.

hindi: ये पेशेंस चाहिए। ये बुध है। बुध मोस्ट इंपेशेंट।
says: What is needed is patience, which is a Mercury lesson, because Mercury is the most impatient planet.
classical_check: Silent; it follows from Mercury being the quickest planet.

hindi: 88 दिन में गुर चक्कर मार रहा है। सूर्य के साथ बैठा है। आत्मा को घिरा हिलाता रहता है लगातार। इसीलिए बुध जो है बच्चा भी खुद गुरा में है। इंपेशेंट बहुत ज्यादा है।
says: Mercury goes round the Sun in 88 days, always close to it and whirling continuously, so it is impatient, like a child that is itself restless.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled in the middle; the 88-day figure is clear.
classical_check: The 88-day orbit is astronomically correct; the impatience inference is his.

hindi: आप किसी से भी कैलकुलेशन का कुछ काम दीजिए। थक गया तो मींस बुध गया।
says: Test of Mercury: give anyone a calculation task; if the person gets tired quickly, it means Mercury is gone, that is, weak.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपका बुध डिस्टर्ब नहीं है। आपकी बुद्धिमता डिस्टर्ब नहीं है। आप खुद को कमांड दोगे नींद आएगी।
says: If you do not tire, your Mercury and intelligence are undisturbed, and you can command yourself to sleep and it will come.
ambiguity: Link to the previous test is inferred.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बुद्धिमता डिस्टर्बड है ना? कान में आवाज लगाओ। हमारे क्लास के लगा लो और बहुत स्लो वॉल्यूम करके लेट जाओ। बस नाभि पे सांस का ध्यान दो। देखो नींद आ जाएगी क्योंकि बुध शांत हो गया।
says: Remedy for a disturbed mind: put earphones on at very low volume with the class audio, lie down and keep attention on the breath at the navel; sleep comes because Mercury has calmed.
ambiguity: 'Tuge laga lo' is read as earphones.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मन चंचल है। चंद्रमा इससे भी चंचल है। अभी उसकी बात कभी करेंगे तो बात होगी।
says: The mind is restless, and the Moon is even more restless than Mercury; the Moon will be dealt with another time.
classical_check: Moon as the fastest planet and mind karaka is classical.

hindi: यह दुर्गा माता है। बहुत स्थिर है। शेर की सवारी है। इसलिए आपको यह मान के चलना है कि आप बुद्धि के द्वारा शेर को भी टेम कर सकते हो।
says: Mercury is likened to Goddess Durga riding a lion, so you should believe that with intelligence you can tame even a lion.
ambiguity: 'Very steady' contradicts his earlier fast-restless Mercury; probably he refers to the goddess, not the planet.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अपनी जुबान वाणी के द्वारा आप ये बनियों से मित्रता करो बनियों से सीखो राम राम जी नमस्कार जी यही करके चलते हैं और उसी में जिंदगी सेट है
says: Remedy: befriend merchants and learn their courteous speech and greetings, because their whole life is set on that.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Audience asks if someone with Mercury in the 7th house can donate or offer money at a temple or gurudwara.

hindi: बुध सातवें घर में राशि तो चाहिए ना 12 नंबर राशि में कैश नहीं दे सकते 11 नंबर राशि सातव घर में उसका कोई लेन देन नहीं है यहां पर 12 नंबर आएगी ही नहीं
says: Mercury in the 7th depends on the sign: with sign 12 (Pisces) one cannot give cash, but with sign 11 (Aquarius) as the 7th house there is no such restriction since sign 12 does not come in that chart.
cells_derived_method: Aquarius as the 7th house means Leo lagna, where Pisces is the 8th and Mercury can still sit there; Pisces in the 7th is Virgo lagna. So the restriction concerns Mercury's sign, not the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 7th (Virgo lagna), cash donations and handouts should be avoided.
Derived: Mercury in Aquarius in the 7th (Leo lagna), no cash restriction on his rule, but Mercury can still lie in Pisces in the 8th.

ambiguity: His 'sign 12 will not come' ignores that Mercury could sit in Pisces in another house of an Aquarius-7th chart; he may think of a one-sign-per-house layout. Also multi-sign houses would let both signs touch the 7th.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Aside about fruit being yellow inside but green outside, and a joke that first the saffron one came out, then the green one.

hindi: वो बुध के बाद बृहस्पति ही है। पीला रंग आएगा आम का अंदर से बाहर से हरा होता है। आखिर में अंतत तो मनुष्य को ज्ञान पे जाना ही है। और वो ज्ञान पे जाने के पश्चात ही सही बुद्धि काम करती है।
says: After Mercury comes Jupiter, as a mango is green outside and yellow inside; in the end a person must reach knowledge, and only then does the intellect work correctly.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter as the planet of wisdom is classical.

hindi: जितने यह बुध के दोष आ जाते हैं, वक्रत्व होता है या कोई और अस्त हुआ या किसी ग्रह के कारण से कुछ सिस्टम बना। हम वक्री अस्त की बात इसलिए करते हैं क्योंकि यूनिवर्सल है।
says: Mercury's faults come as retrogression, combustion or some other planet's influence; he treats only retrograde and combust because they are universal, readable in every chart.
classical_check: Combustion is classical; treating retrograde as a fault is his own.

hindi: बाकी ग्रहों की बात समझना बहुत टेढ़ी खीर है। बहुत सी कुंडलियां घुमानी पड़ती है। नवांश देखना पड़ता है। मुन्ना भाई की कई कुंडलियां आती है। केपी देखना है। चलित देखना है। यह बहुत खिचड़ी है।
says: Judging the other planetary faults is very tricky because many charts must be rotated: navamsha, his one-two-three charts, KP and chalit; it becomes a khichdi, so he leaves them for a detailed course.
ambiguity: 'Munna Bhai kundli' is his nickname for the 1-2-3 chart method.
classical_check: Using navamsha and bhava chalit alongside D1 is classical; KP is a later system.

gist: Says other faults need a very detailed course and the rest will come with practice, the sentence ends in the next chunk.

hindi: सबसे बड़ी बात है बच्चों का आशीर्वाद लो। आप बच्चों का आशीर्वाद नहीं लेते हैं। बच्चों को झिड़क देते हैं। बुध नाराज हो जाता है।
says: Biggest remedy: take the blessings of children; if you scold and shoo children away, Mercury gets angry.
classical_check: Silent; Mercury as the child karaka fits.

hindi: इसलिए व्यसन करते हैं। फालतू की बातें करना व्यर्थ अनर्गल काम नहीं होना, पैसा नहीं कमा पाना यह बुध के दोष हैं। और पैसा संसार की सबसे बड़ी ताकत है।
says: Addictions, idle talk, futile work and being unable to earn money are Mercury faults, and money is the biggest power in the world.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Audience question: if Mercury is wrongly placed, will taking children's blessings affect it negatively.

hindi: नहीं ठीक करेगा। ठीक करेगा।
says: Answer: it will not harm; the blessing of children will fix even a wrongly placed Mercury.
ambiguity: Short reply with no reasoning.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अपने से छोटों को आप लड़ रहे हो, डांट रहे हो, झगड़ा कर रहे हो, पीट रहे हो, बुध नेगेटिव हो जाएगा।
says: Don't fight, scold, quarrel with or beat those junior to you, because Mercury turns negative.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपकी खुद हड्डियों में तकलीफ होगी, कान आंख की प्रॉब्लम विशेष पकड़ेगा और आंत पेट। डॉक्टर पकड़ नहीं पाएंगे।
says: Result of an angry Mercury: your own bones will ache, ear and eye troubles will catch you, and intestines and stomach too, with doctors unable to diagnose; his claim, not medical.
ambiguity: Health claim, flagged.
classical_check: Ears, intestines and nerves are Mercury's classically; bones are Saturn's.

hindi: बुध के दोष के अंतर्गत आपको आयुर्वेदिक मेडिसिन सूट नहीं करेगी। आप रामदेव बाबा रामदेव के उपाय इलाज करोगे। बुध का दोष है तो ठीक ही नहीं होंगे।
says: Under a Mercury fault Ayurvedic medicine will not suit you, and even following a famous yoga teacher's remedies will not cure you, so you will not recover; his claim only, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Health claim naming a public figure; recorded as spoken, no endorsement either way.
classical_check: Silent; classics link herbs to Mercury and would not say they fail.

hindi: पन्ना सूट करता तो पहनो। बाकी के उपाय करो। देखो कैसे सेट होता है।
says: If the emerald suits you, wear it, and do the other remedies as well, then see how things settle.
classical_check: Agrees with testing a gem before committing.

hindi: धांसू आग की तरह सेट होगा। आपको आयुर्वेद आयुर्वेद ठीक कर देगा। बुध दोष आयुर्वेदिक ठीक नहीं करेगा।
says: Ordinary ailments Ayurveda will cure, but ailments caused by a Mercury fault Ayurveda will not cure; with the right remedies things will fall into place powerfully. Health claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: First sentence is a flourish continuing the earlier point; Ayurveda contrast is the clear claim.
classical_check: Differs: Ayurveda and Jyotish were traditionally combined and herbs belong to Mercury.

gist: Audience remark that the earlier talk about silence answers how to fix Mercury.

hindi: एक चुप 100 सुख कहते हैं ना शायद हजार सुख कहते होंगे।
says: Quotes the proverb that one silence brings a hundred comforts, perhaps a thousand, as support for keeping silent as a Mercury remedy.
classical_check: Silent; a folk proverb.

gist: Banter on marriage: how many comforts it holds, that it is not about society but about the wife, and that one should settle things with the wife, not outside.
Remark that getting a girlfriend is easy but settling things with the wife is hard, followed by a pun on 'gods' in plural.
Audience points out an apparent contradiction: once he said speaking is needed, another time that you should know what you speak.

hindi: आप बृहस्पति के अंतर्गत है आप सिर्फ यूं ही लग गए हो युद्ध करेंगे मार देंगे मर जाएंगे खून तो बर्बाद खुद भी कट जाओगे
says: Speech must come under Jupiter's guidance of knowledge; if you simply jump into wild talk you land in wars, bloodshed and ruin, and you too get cut down.
ambiguity: Garbled sentence; 'you are under Jupiter' is my reading of how he reconciles speaking and knowing.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो वो भी कटेगा आप नष्ट करना सीखोगे तो बोल के ही होता
says: The other side is also cut; if you learn to destroy, it is done through speech alone, so words are the weapon.
ambiguity: Caption is choppy and joins the previous sentence.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Audience asks what happens if Mercury is in the 12th house with the 9th sign and multiple planets also join: which one will Mercury follow.

hindi: वो तो जिस ग्रह की बल है कुंडली में स्थापित को है
says: Mercury follows whichever planet is strongest and established in the chart.
cells_derived_method: Find the planet with the highest strength among those aspecting or joining Mercury, plus its sign lord, and read Mercury as that planet's agent. Mercury in Sagittarius in the 12th follows Jupiter unless a stronger planet joins it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Sagittarius in the 12th (Capricorn lagna) follows Jupiter if Jupiter is strong, otherwise follows the strongest conjunct planet.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 9th (Cancer lagna) with a strong Saturn aspect follows Saturn in outcome, not Jupiter.

ambiguity: 'Bal' strength is not defined here; the next lines point to degree-based strength.
classical_check: Agrees with the general rule that a planet follows the stronger planet joining or aspecting it.

gist: Garbled remark that planets keep shifting through houses and signs keep rotating, and that this is no joke.

hindi: चंद्रमा आपके साथ कर्क राशि में किसी भी राशि में हो चंद्र बुध साथ होगा बहस होगी
says: Whatever sign the Moon is in, even its own sign Cancer, if Moon and Mercury are together there will be argument.
cells_derived_method: Sign changes the flavour but not the outcome: Cancer makes it emotional quarrel, Gemini or Virgo verbal sparring, Scorpio bitter.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign with Mercury in the 4th, arguments over home and mother, emotionally charged.
Derived: Moon with Mercury in the 2nd in Gemini, quarrelsome speech with the family.
Derived: Moon with Mercury in Scorpio in the 8th, deep, secret and bitter disputes.

ambiguity: Repeats the earlier rule, now adding that the Moon's own sign does not cancel it.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Moon in its own sign softens the combination.

hindi: ये पुरुष है स्त्री का यदि चंद्र बुध साथ है तो उसकी बहस होगी स्त्रियों से बनेगी नहीं उसकी
says: Restating for a woman's chart: if Moon and Mercury are together, she will argue with women and will not get along with them.
cells_derived_method: Which women are affected follows the house: 3rd sisters, 4th mother, 7th female partners, 11th female friends.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: pair in the 3rd in Virgo, constant arguing with sisters and female cousins.
Derived: pair in the 11th in Gemini, friction with female friends, easier with male ones.

ambiguity: Start of the sentence is garbled ('ye purush hai'); the chart is a woman's.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सूर्य बुध साथ बहुत अच्छी बात है उससे कोई नुकसान नहीं है
says: Sun and Mercury together is a very good thing and brings no harm.
cells_derived_method: Same Budhaditya reading everywhere; house gives the field (1st self, 5th mind, 10th career) and sign gives tone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign with Mercury in the 5th, confident learning and creative intelligence.
Derived: Sun exalted with Mercury in the 10th in Aries, authority and quick decisions at work.

ambiguity: Contradicts his own earlier remark that Mercury is often combust with the Sun.
classical_check: Budhaditya yoga is classical and praised; combustion is the usual caveat.

hindi: कुंडली में सारे ग्रह देखने पड़ते हैं बल से डिग्री के थ्रू देखा जाता है
says: All planets in the chart must be examined, and their strength is judged through their degrees.
ambiguity: Sentence runs across two chunks.
classical_check: Degree-based strength (avastha, shadbala parts) is classical.

hindi: चंद्रमा की डिग्री छोटी होती है ज्यादा होती है उस पे है
says: The Moon's strength depends on whether its degree is small or large within the sign.
ambiguity: He does not say which end is stronger for the Moon.
classical_check: Classically the Moon is strongest in the middle degrees of its sign by waxing, not by a fixed degree.

hindi: बृहस्पति सिर्फ आधी डिग्री या 5 डिग्री तक मैक्सिमम पावरफुल है फिर बूढ़ा हो जाता है सूर्य 10 तक होता है शनि 23 तक होता है मंगल 28° तक पावरफुल रहता है ये सब अलग-अलग है यूनिवर्सल रूल ही तो नहीं है
says: Each planet has its own power window by degree: Jupiter strongest only up to about 5 degrees, the Sun up to 10, Saturn up to 23, Mars up to 28, then they age; there is no universal degree rule.
ambiguity: Whether the windows are from the start of the sign and for all signs is not said; the numbers come from noisy captions.
classical_check: Differs: classical baladi avastha uses 6-degree bands by odd or even sign and the same for all planets, not planet-specific windows.

gist: Says the whole difficulty is that these rules differ planet by planet, repeated twice.
Audience asks about the earlier puja and Navratri talk: can those whose chart makes puja negative pay a pandit to perform it on their behalf.

hindi: पूजा पाठ अगर नेगेटिविटी है तो मत करो। वो खुद नहीं कर रहे। पंडित जी से करवा रहे हैं। तो करवा रहे हैं उन्हीं की लगेगी। पूजा पाठ करनी है और करवानी ही नहीं है।
says: If puja is negative for your chart, do not do it and do not get a pandit to do it for you either, since the effect still falls on you.
ambiguity: 'Unhi ki lagegi' is read as the effect landing on the person who pays; chart condition is the one named next.
classical_check: Differs from the common practice of having pujas performed by priests when one cannot do them.

gist: Says the question of puja negativity will be taken up in the class on the 9th house.

hindi: अगर बुध आपके नाइंथ हाउस में नीच का बैठा हुआ है तो हर हालत में पूजा पाठ मत करो।
says: If Mercury sits debilitated in the 9th house, never do puja or ritual worship under any circumstances.
cells_derived_method: 9th house is dharma, rituals and fortune; a Mercury in its fall in Pisces there (Cancer lagna) turns ritual into harm. Mercury in Virgo in the 9th (Capricorn lagna) would not carry this ban.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer lagna with Mercury in fall in the 9th, ritual worship and religious spending become harmful by his rule.
Derived: Capricorn lagna with Mercury strong in Virgo in the 9th, the prohibition does not apply.

ambiguity: 'Neech ka' means Pisces, the fall sign of Mercury.
classical_check: Differs: classics generally recommend puja for a weak 9th lord.

hindi: नीच का बैठा है खराब बैठ गया बुरी राशि का हो गया रेट्रोग्रेड हो गया अस्त हो गया में तो कई चीजें बन सकती है लेकिन नीच एक स्पेसिफिक उसी में अगर बैठ गया है तो आप पूजा पाठ करोगे आपका नाश होना ही है
says: Mercury can be bad in many ways, such as fallen, in a bad sign, retrograde or combust, but the puja ban is specific to the debilitated case in the 9th, where doing puja means certain ruin.
ambiguity: Sentence spans two chunks; 'nash hona hi hai' is his hyperbole.
classical_check: Differs from classical advice for remedies of a debilitated planet.

hindi: आप कैश लोगों को दोगे वापस आना ही नहीं है धर्म के नाम पे धर्म स्थान में कुछ बनवाओगे आपका सत्यानाश होना ही होना है
says: With that placement, cash lent to people never comes back, and building anything in the name of religion at a religious place will ruin you.
cells_derived_method: Money going out in the 9th in Pisces fits a 2nd-from-8th leak: lending (11th gains) and religious spending (9th) both lose value for Cancer lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer lagna with Mercury in fall in the 9th, loans to relatives or friends are not repaid and donation-led construction brings ruin.

ambiguity: Applies to the same 9th-house fallen Mercury case.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति आपको लगे कि मेरा पैसा मर जाता है मेरा 90% काम होता है फिर अटक जाता है मैं बात बोलता हूं मैं पूरी नहीं कह पाता मेरी बात उस टाइम कहनी थी बाद में ध्यान आती है
says: Symptoms of a faulty Mercury: money gets stuck, 90 percent of the work is done and then jams, you cannot finish what you say and recall the right word only afterwards.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पैसे गिने पता नहीं कहां गायब हो गए चोरी हो गए फिटकरी से कुल्ले स्टार्ट कर दो
says: If money seems to vanish when counted or gets stolen, start gargling with alum water.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Audience asks which planet alum belongs to.

hindi: फिटकरी बुध है रोज कर बुध है
says: Alum (phitkari) belongs to Mercury; do it daily.
classical_check: Silent; not in classical karaka lists.

hindi: कोई भी उपाय 40 दिन चलता है 28 नक्षत्र है 27 नक्षत्र है 28वां अभिजीत और 12 राशियां ये हो गए 40 ऐड ऑन कर लो 42 43 दिन टोटल कोई काम कर लो वो उपाय सिद्ध हो गया
says: Any remedy runs for about 40 days: 27 nakshatras plus Abhijit make 28, plus 12 signs is 40; add a couple of days for 42 or 43, after which the remedy is considered complete.
ambiguity: Arithmetic is 28 plus 12 equals 40; the extra 2 or 3 days is unexplained.
classical_check: The 40-day (mandala) practice is traditional; the nakshatra plus sign derivation is his own.

hindi: फटकरी से कुल्ले करना शुरू करो बस थोड़ा आउट अब जो थूक निकला है फटकरी का निकला है वो बुद्ध है आपके अंदर से नेगेटिव बुध निकाल रहा है
says: Gargle with alum and spit it out; the spit that comes out is Mercury itself, so you are expelling the negative Mercury from inside you.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: फटकरी मुंह सुखा देती है दांत का दर्द इत्यादि सब कुछ है फटकरी आपको ये जलन हो रही है पोटाश एलम लगाते हैं हम इसके ऊपर फिटकरी डिसइ्फेक्टेंट है।
says: Alum dries the mouth, helps toothache and burning, is used as potash alum and acts as a disinfectant; a practical note, not medical advice.
ambiguity: Health uses of alum are folk claims, flagged.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: 43 दिन आपके काम होने थोड़े बहुत शुरू हो जाएंगे। परमानेंट तो कह नहीं सकते कितना बड़ा दोष है। लेकिन ये उपाय है। परमानेंट इलाज के लिए तो स्टोन चाहिए।
says: After 43 days of gargling some of your work will begin to happen; it may not be permanent depending on the size of the fault, and for a permanent cure a gemstone is needed.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दांत तो ठीक हो ही जाएंगे। दांतों का इलाज फटकरी सही है।
says: As a side result the teeth will get fine, since alum is the right treatment for teeth; a folk health claim only.
ambiguity: Health claim, flagged; not medical advice.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Audience relays a question: since Sikhs give daan, can paying tax to the government be counted as daan.

hindi: गवर्नमेंट तो छीन रही है टैक्स देना कौन चाहता है? कमाल है। दान है ही नहीं वो तो गवर्नमेंट छीन रही है।
says: Tax is not charity because the government takes it by force and nobody gives it willingly; daan must be voluntary.
ambiguity: Planet link is not stated here; Jupiter is added from the following talk on daan.
classical_check: Classical dana requires willing giving, so it agrees.

gist: Rant that people would shoot the government if they could, and that the government does not see anything.

hindi: दान तो उन लोगों को हो गया। दान मींस देने वाला ही नहीं है। देने वाला ही नहीं है। लेने वाला नहीं है।
says: True daan means there is no giver and no receiver; the sense of the two selves disappears.
ambiguity: The first words refer to what Sikhs do.
classical_check: Agrees with the Gita ideal of detached giving.

gist: Praises the audience's remark as beautiful and jokes that the seat is lost now.

hindi: दान देने वाला ही नहीं है। देने का भाव ही नहीं है। मैं कौन हूं तो देने वाला वो देना है। और दिया हम दे ही क्या सकते हैं?
says: There should be no feeling of giving at all, asking who am I to give and what can we truly give.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled; may be the audience member's sentence he endorses.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of giving without ego.

hindi: कार सेवा में नहीं देखा आपने। कौन किस गाड़ी से उतर के लग गए। हमारे बृहस्पति का है ना ये।
says: In kar seva, volunteer service at the gurudwara, people step out of their cars and simply join in; this selfless service is Jupiter's domain.
classical_check: Jupiter as karaka of dharma and guru-service is classical.

hindi: इसलिए लफड़ा सारा का सारा क्या किया। उन्होंने बृहस्पति को कुर्सी पे बिठा दिया। गुरु की पूजा करो।
says: The Sikh way settled the whole matter by seating Jupiter, the guru, on the throne and worshipping the guru.
ambiguity: Reading of 'Brihaspati ko kursi pe bithaya' as seating the guru principle is mine.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: काम दे सकते हैं। हां तो अनजान को है ना उनका रूल बुक यही तो है ना कि अनजान को जाएगा आपको जाना ही पता ही नहीं है किसको दे रहे हैं
says: Their rulebook is that giving goes to an unknown person, so you may give service or work, without knowing whom you are giving to.
ambiguity: Whether 'kaam de sakte hain' is an audience question about giving work in place of money is unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मामा जी को नहीं दिया आप गुरुद्वारे में देंगे हां भैया दियो जरा चीनी दियो बाऊजी कौन सी वाली तेरे पास ₹20 किलो वाली है 50 वाली है 20 वाली दे दे वजन बराबर घर के लिए 5 किलो वाल तोल दियो 50 वाली वो दान नहीं है वो खाना पूर्ति है
says: Giving the cheap 20-rupee sugar to the gurudwara while buying the 50-rupee one for the home is not daan but mere formality.
ambiguity: Role-play monologue; the quality-match rule is the point.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical rule that dana should be of good quality and of what one values.

hindi: अभी तक आपका 12वा भाव शुद्ध नहीं हुआ आठवें घर का पेन सारा पेन आठवां घर है सारी बीमारी छठा घर है। यही तो हम और उपाय बताते क्या है?
says: Until now your 12th house has not been purified through such giving; all pain belongs to the 8th house and all illness to the 6th, and giving is the remedy he keeps pointing to.
cells_derived_method: The 12th (expense, release) is cleansed by giving; the 8th brings suffering and the 6th disease, so the sign in each of these houses shapes the form: Capricorn in the 6th is chronic illness, Gemini in the 8th nervous strain, Libra in the 12th losses through partners.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 6th (Leo lagna), slow chronic ailments, remedy by service and giving.
Derived: Gemini in the 8th (Scorpio lagna), nervous and speech-related strain.
Derived: Libra in the 12th (Scorpio lagna), expenses tied to partners and balance, to be offset by giving.

ambiguity: 'Bhav shuddh' is not defined; read as the 12th house being cleansed through daan.
classical_check: 6th for disease and 8th for suffering are classical; cleansing the 12th by giving is his own addition.

hindi: मोटे मोटे दान या मोटे-मोटे स्टोन या मोटे-मोटे दान। लोग कहते हैं महंगा बड़ा है। पर जिसने कर लिया वो कहता है देवता है भगवान है।
says: Remedies that involve big donations or big (costly) gemstones look expensive to onlookers, but he says the people who actually did them call the result divine; he is defending costly, substantial remedies over token ones.
ambiguity: Which planet or gemstone is meant is not stated; this is general remedy philosophy.
classical_check: Classical texts prescribe dana and ratna by planet and by capacity; they do not insist on the costliest form, so this is his own emphasis.

gist: Garbled caption plus rhetorical questions: would you wear a cheap dress or accept a cheap gift from someone, and would you ask god for a cheap house.

hindi: अरे जब महंगा पसंद है तो भगवान को क्यों दे रहे हो सस्ता? जिस मामा से सारा मांग रहे हो उस मामा को कचरा दे रहे हो और उससे मांग रहे हो कि तू बेस्ट दे।
says: His reasoning for costly remedies: you want the best for yourself, so offering the deity something cheap while asking for the best result is inconsistent; the quality of the offering should match the size of the ask.
ambiguity: 'Mama' here is slang for the divine or for the cosmos as the giver, not a literal uncle.
classical_check: Classical dana rules value shraddha and fitness of the gift over price; this partly differs from a price-matching view.

gist: He jokes that the divine is not stupid, was not born yesterday, knows everything, and is greedy too.
Starts a story about a client who recently got caught in a loop over some specialty; caption cuts off mid-sentence.
He fixed something for a client in under five minutes and says he does not give more time; clients have attitude.
He asks the client to do remedies, the client's people did them, and he says once told the person needs nothing more and should go away; jokes about a Rs 11 fee.
Big industrialist client keeps asking him to arrange remedies; he says get them done outside and your life will be fine.
Client insists he arrange costlier remedies; he says go ahead, then she demands 1000 crore and he is irritated.
He says he does not attend greedy clients; if spending 10 lakh could bring 1000 crore he would do it himself. This is about business attitude, and any return promise is not advice to follow.

hindi: आप किसी इंसान की ग्रीड को संतुष्ट कर ही नहीं सकते। उसका बुद्धि डिस्टर्बड है। और वो बुध कैसे सेट होगा? जब कोई बृहस्पति सेट करके देगा
says: Greed cannot be satisfied and signals a disturbed intellect, which he reads as a disturbed Mercury; Mercury gets settled only when Jupiter (guru, wisdom, blessing) sets it right.
cells_derived_method: Mercury shows buddhi and greed shows up where Mercury is afflicted; the area of life follows Mercury's house, for example finance or speech, while Jupiter's house shows where correction comes from. Sign dependent: Mercury in Pisces (debilitated) is more confused than in Virgo (exalted).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 2nd with Jupiter-ruled Pisces gives muddled money thinking, and a Jupiter-type guide would be the corrective.
Derived: exalted Mercury in the 11th is sharp about gains; greed appears only if afflicted, not by position alone.
Derived: Mercury in its own sign in the 6th, a calculating mind in debts and rivals, greed tilts toward bargaining.

ambiguity: Whether he means Jupiter aspecting Mercury or a Jupiter-type person acting on the native is not clear.
classical_check: Classical texts give Mercury as intellect and Jupiter as wisdom; Jupiter correcting Mercury is a modern reading, not a direct classical rule.

hindi: क्योंकि बृहस्पति अहंकार है। इसीलिए हिंदू लोग लड़ते रहते हैं आपस में। आपस में जयचंद हमारे यहां इसीलिए है।
says: He calls Jupiter ahankar (ego) and uses it to explain why people of one community keep fighting among themselves and produce betrayers; Jupiter as ego is his own karaka assignment.
cells_derived_method: Where Jupiter sits shows where pride and self-importance concentrate: house 1 self-pride, house 10 pride in status. Sign changes the style: Jupiter in Leo is royal pride, in Capricorn debilitated pride that is hollow.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 10th in Aries is pride in rank and leadership, quarrels with equals at work.
Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 4th gives hollow pride about home and lineage.
Derived: Jupiter in the 9th in Leo is pride in dharma and beliefs, rigid in religious views.

ambiguity: The sociological claim about a community is opinion; only Jupiter as ego is the astrological statement.
classical_check: Differs: classical karakatva gives Jupiter as wisdom, dharma, guru, children; ego belongs to the Sun.

gist: He says it is not only one religion but ego everywhere, one idea one dharma.
Political commentary on a national leader's mass appeal for unity and his remark that he calls it hypnosis.
Continues the commentary on a mass religious gathering, 60 crore people bathing, and the idea of caste identity fading.
He says he has taken classes in hypnosis and that wave creation fills the head with one idea; people report loss and gain.
More on caste differences vanishing during the large gathering; nobody refuses to attend on grounds of caste.

hindi: यह खोपड़ी यह है बुद्ध। बहरूपिया जादूगर यह बुद्ध है। यह है बुद्धिमानी। कुछ नहीं करा सब कर दिया। आपने खोपड़ी बदल दी।
says: He assigns the skull and mind to Mercury, calls Mercury the shape-shifting magician and the seat of cleverness, and says changing people's thinking changes everything without any physical act.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's house shows where one changes minds or masquerades; sign gives the manner. Mercury in a fixed sign is stubborn thinking, in a dual sign flexible thinking.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 3rd is persuasion through speech, writing and media.
Derived: exalted Mercury in the 7th is analytical, reshapes the partner's or clients' thinking through detail.
Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 12th is illusion and confusion, magician turning into a deceiver of the self.

ambiguity: Budh here is Mercury, caption writes Buddh; the skull as Mercury is his extension of buddhi.
classical_check: Classically Mercury governs intellect, speech, trade and trickery, so it agrees; the skull assignment is his own.

hindi: जब चंद्रमा के साथ इसका दोष हो जाता है तो शककी बना देता है। और सीधा चरित्र पे शक करते हैं।
says: When Mercury forms a fault (affliction or combination) with the Moon, the person becomes suspicious and directly doubts others' character, especially a partner's.
cells_derived_method: Doubt falls on the area of Moon-Mercury's house: in the 7th it is the spouse's character, in the 5th children or lovers, in the 10th colleagues. Sign shapes intensity: Mercury in Cancer, Moon's own sign, makes it emotional.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Mercury in Gemini in the 7th gives spouse-focused doubt, mind racing on talk and messages.
Derived: Moon and Mercury in Cancer in the 5th gives emotional suspicion toward children or romantic partners.
Derived: in the 10th in Virgo, nitpicking suspicion toward colleagues' conduct.

ambiguity: 'Dosha with the Moon' is not defined: conjunction, aspect, or enmity-based affliction is unspecified.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Moon-Mercury yoga mostly as wit and trading skill, and Mercury is an enemy of the Moon in some tables; the suspicion result is his experience, not a classical rule.

hindi: पति और पत्नी स्त्री ज्यादा करती है क्योंकि चंद्रमा स्त्री ग्रह है। वो शक कर करके ही जिंदगी नर्क कर देती है। फिर मैनिफेस्ट हो जाता है।
says: Between spouses the wife doubts more because the Moon is the feminine planet; constant suspicion turns the home life miserable and what is feared ends up manifesting.
cells_derived_method: Moon's house and sign decide how strongly it shows: a Moon in the 7th or 4th puts it in the home; Moon in a water sign increases emotionality.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Moon in the 4th gives deep insecurity at home and persistent doubt.
Derived: Moon in its own sign in the 7th is attachment-driven vigilance over the partner.

ambiguity: A gender generalization; the astrological content is only Moon as feminine and as the source of doubt when afflicted.
classical_check: Classical texts call the Moon a feminine planet and mother karaka; the self-fulfilling manifestation idea is modern and not classical.

gist: Joke about the wife saying I knew it, I am an astrologer too, and many such astrologers appearing in the market.
Moves to the next audience question; a viewer asks that if a person has a malefic planet and does its remedy for future success, will he be successful.

hindi: रेमेडी ठीक कर लेता तो हो जाएगा। नहीं करता तो खराब हो जाएगा।
says: His answer: if the person does the remedy correctly it will work, and if he does not do it things will worsen; success depends on actually carrying out the remedy.
ambiguity: The caption is ambiguous on whether this is the questioner's phrasing or his reply; the next lines suggest he is answering with a condition.
classical_check: Classical texts present remedies as mitigating, not guaranteeing; an outright success promise goes beyond them.

hindi: हमें क्या पता रेमेडी बताएगी ना वो? तो ये तो इन्होंने सोच लिया रेमेडी करी। रेमेडी करी कैसे? मैंने बताया ना
says: He questions whether the remedy was really done properly: the person merely assumes he did it, but how it was done decides the result, and an astrologer cannot know that from outside.
ambiguity: Caption garbled; reading is that the manner of doing the remedy matters more than the claim of having done it.
classical_check: Classical texts stress correct procedure, mantra count and shraddha for a remedy to bear fruit, so it agrees.

gist: Quotes how people call the doctor a thief and scoundrel as an analogy.

hindi: आपने अभी भी बृहस्पति डिस्ट्रॉय किया है। इलाज के बाद भी आप ठीक नहीं होंगे। आशीर्वाद नहीं मिलेगा।
says: Disrespecting or cheating the priest or guru destroys Jupiter, and a remedy done that way will not cure you; the blessing needed for the remedy to work is not received.
cells_derived_method: The harm lands where Jupiter sits and rules: if Jupiter is in the 9th, fortune and guru blessing; in the 5th, children and merit; in the 2nd, wealth and speech.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 9th, if the guru is slighted, the blessing channel that normally protects fortune is blocked.
Derived: exalted Jupiter in the 5th, disrespect to teachers is said to reduce the merit that supports children.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 2nd, family wealth and speech suffer if the guru's due is withheld.

ambiguity: The medical-sounding phrase is about remedy outcomes, not a health diagnosis; no medical claim is endorsed.
classical_check: Classical texts mention guru-nindā and withholding dakshina as sins that weaken Jupiter's results; this agrees broadly.

gist: Mimics a client who calls the priest a thief and a loot-maker and gives a discounted Rs 50 dakshina.
A remark comparing firmness of belief in other communities and quoting Duryodhana as confident of heaven; a comment on faith, not Jyotish.
Mimics a host haggling the priest's 11000 dakshina down while having spent 1.25 crore on the wedding tent.

hindi: अब आपको भी हम 11000 दें कम लगा लो सोचो आप बृहस्पति नाराज कर रहे हो अभी बृहस्पति बुलाया
says: Haggling the priest's dakshina is the same as angering Jupiter; he asks the listener to imagine being paid too little themselves, to show you are upsetting Jupiter just when you invited it.
ambiguity: Part of the chain of caption ends mid-sentence into the next chunk.
classical_check: Classical dana rules call for dakshina commensurate with means, so haggling contradicts them; agrees in spirit.

gist: People say they matched the horoscope and consulted the priest, so why bother; they would have done it themselves.

hindi: लेकिन राजा पैदा कर सकते हो तुम। अवतार पैदा हो सकता है। अब जुपिटर इग्नाइट ही नहीं कर रहे।
says: Caption is rough: he implies that despite the priest being ignored, great children (a king, an avatar) could still be born, but Jupiter is not being activated; his point is that Jupiter's ignition is what is missing.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter activation shows through house 5 (children) and 9 (fortune); sign decides strength: Jupiter in Cancer or Sagittarius ignites easily.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 5th is strong potential for noble children if not disrespected.
Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 9th has the potential blocked and needs more correction.

ambiguity: Sentence order in the caption is broken; low certainty on the intended point.
classical_check: Classical texts link Jupiter strength with noble progeny, silent on the word ignition.

gist: Says Jupiter will be discussed in detail in the Jupiter class, so he defers it.
A viewer comment that Sanatan is a bit too technical.
He says the technicality was forgotten, yet scientists are produced from it, and asks why our culture is so rich and brainy.
Claims interstellar travel is in the Gita, Mahabharata and old texts and mentions Hanuman statues found in Mexico; not an astrology rule.

hindi: बुद्ध है नारद। नारद नहीं है। नारायण नारायण ना करना धरना कुछ नहीं प्रकट हो गए। इधर की उधर लगा ली।
says: Mercury (Budh) is like Narada: moves freely between all worlds, appears anywhere, does nothing himself and passes news from one side to the other, so Mercury is the messenger and go-between.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's house shows where one acts as a go-between or spreader of talk: the 3rd media and messages, the 7th brokering between partners, the 11th network connections. Sign changes style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Mercury in the 3rd is a precise messenger and reporter.
Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 7th is a broker or mediator in partnerships.
Derived: Mercury in the 12th in Sagittarius is a distant messenger, foreign contacts, bridging across borders.

ambiguity: The caption says 'Budh hai Narad. Narad nahin hai' in one line; read as the comparison to Narada followed by a negation joke.
classical_check: Mercury as messenger and trader is classical; the Narada comparison is his own image.

hindi: और किसका नाम लेता है? बृहस्पति का। नारायण नारायण अमर है।
says: Narada (his image for Mercury) keeps chanting Narayan, whom he equates with Jupiter; so Mercury is the planet that always invokes and stays tied to Jupiter, and the chant is called immortal.
cells_derived_method: A Mercury-Jupiter link (conjunction, mutual aspect or exchange) in a house gives the Narada pattern in that house's topic: 2nd house speech and teaching, 5th house learning and mantra, 9th house scripture.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury with Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 9th, a scripture-talking, teaching mind.
Derived: Mercury (debilitated) with Jupiter in own sign in the 5th, learned but unsteady intellect rescued by the guru principle.
Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 2nd with Jupiter, an eloquent, persuasive speaker.

ambiguity: Caption is choppy; 'whose name does he take' is read as a rhetorical question answered with Jupiter.
classical_check: Classically Narayan is Vishnu and Mercury is Vishnu-linked as a graha deity, but Jupiter as Narayan is his own association; Mercury and Jupiter are not natural friends in classical tables.

gist: Repeats that Narada shows intergalactic travel by appearing anywhere at will.

hindi: जिस व्यक्ति का बुध इतना स्ट्रांग हो जाए कि वो अपने नारायण साथ रख के चले। सोचो वो दुनिया बदल सकता है। वरदान दे सकता है।
says: If a person's Mercury becomes so strong that he carries his own Narayan with him (Jupiter's grace), that person can change the world and can grant boons.
cells_derived_method: Strength of Mercury depends on sign (Virgo exalted, Gemini or Virgo own, Pisces debilitated) and house (1, 4, 7, 10 angular strong). The area where the boon power operates follows the house: 3rd media, 10th career and public influence, 5th mantra and teaching.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Mercury in the 10th, public influence through words and intellect, strongest version of his claim.
Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 3rd, power of speech and writing to move many people.
Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 8th, he would call this the weak form where the boon power is blocked and needs the guru.

ambiguity: 'Narayan' with him is read as a strong Jupiter link or divine grace; he does not say a required Jupiter position.
classical_check: Classically strong Mercury gives intellect and speech skill; a boon-granting claim is mythic, not a classical rule.

gist: Retells the myth of Narada cursing Vishnu for taking the girl he wanted, so that Vishnu would be separated from his wife and helped by monkeys, which became Ram and Hanuman.

hindi: ये है नारद की शक्ति। ये है बुद्ध की शक्ति। ये है वरदान और श्राप देने की शक्ति है बुध में। बहुत पावरफुल है ये।
says: Drawing the lesson from the myth: Narada's power is Mercury's power, namely the ability to bless and to curse, and Mercury is very powerful for that reason.
cells_derived_method: Where Mercury sits shows where words act like boon or curse: 2nd house family speech, 7th house partner's words, 10th house authority's words. Sign changes the force: Mercury in Aries is sharp and cutting, in Taurus it is soft and valuable.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 2nd in Aries, sharp words in the family can act like a curse.
Derived: Mercury in the 10th in Taurus, steady and valued words from a position of authority.
Derived: Mercury in the 7th in Scorpio, a partner's piercing words that stick.

ambiguity: None for the planet; the boon-and-curse power is mythic.
classical_check: Boon and curse power is attributed in classical stories to sages and speech, not formulated as a Mercury rule.

gist: Takes the next audience question: whether thyroid trouble is caused by a bad Mercury and how to fix it.

hindi: जो थायरॉइड की समस्या है वो बुध की खराबी की वजह से ही होती है। थायराइड की ठीक कैसे करें? दवाई लो।
says: The questioner asks, and he accepts, that thyroid trouble is a Mercury affliction result; his practical answer is to take medicine. Recorded as his claim about the planet-body link, not as a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Mercury afflicted in the 2nd (throat), or aspecting the 2nd house or 2nd lord, or Mercury weak in a sign like Pisces, is the pattern a Mercury-throat reading would look at.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 2nd is the textbook weak-Mercury-throat placement under this tradition.
Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 6th, a throat and nerves reading would depend on affliction to the lord, not on position alone.

ambiguity: Whether this is the question's wording or his statement is unclear; he does not disagree. No medical advice is endorsed beyond his 'take medicine'.
classical_check: Classical texts link Mercury to the throat and nervous system broadly; thyroid specifically is a modern naming.
